2048.summary:
2048 is a number puzzle that looks tiny but keeps your brain busy for a long time. Tiles with numbers sit on a small square grid, and every move slides all of them in the same direction at once. When two tiles with the same number bump into each other, they join into one tile worth double. Two and two make four, four and four make eight, and so it goes, all the way up to the big goal in the name.

What makes 2048 so catchy is that each move is quick, but the grid fills up fast if you are careless. You need to think a few steps ahead, keep space open and plan where your biggest tile should live. It mixes simple math with planning, so it is a nice pick for kids who like logic puzzles. The game is played with the mouse, and a round can be as short or as long as you like.
2048.how_to: Your goal in 2048 is to merge matching number tiles until you build a tile showing 2048. Use the mouse to slide the tiles up, down, left or right. Every tile moves as far as it can in that direction, and two equal tiles that touch become one bigger tile. After each move a new small tile shows up, so the board slowly gets crowded. The round ends when no move can merge or shift anything.
tips: Pick one corner and try to keep your biggest tile parked there.
Avoid the direction that pulls your biggest tile out of its corner unless you have no other choice.
Build a chain of numbers that get smaller as they move away from the corner, so merges line up nicely.
Do not rush; look at where the new tile could appear before you slide.

faq.q: How do you play 2048?
faq.a: Slide all tiles in one direction with the mouse and merge equal numbers into bigger ones. Keep going until you reach the 2048 tile or run out of moves.

faq.q: Is 2048 good for learning math?
faq.a: It is a fun way to practice doubling numbers and planning ahead, because every merge doubles a tile's value.

stickman-hook.summary:
Stickman Hook is all about swinging. A bendy little stickman flies through the air, grabs onto hook points and swings forward like an acrobat. Each stage is a short ride from the start to the finish, and the trick is to let go at just the right moment so you sail far enough to catch the next hook instead of dropping out of the level.

The game uses only the mouse, so anyone can pick it up in seconds. The challenge comes from timing: let go too early and you fall short, too late and you swing the wrong way. Stickman Hook feels relaxed when things go well and funny when your stickman flops around after a bad jump. It sits in the arcade and adventure family, and it is a good choice when you want quick rounds that still need a steady hand and good rhythm.
stickman-hook.how_to: Get your stickman from the start of each stage to the finish by swinging between hook points. Everything is done with the mouse: you use it to grab and let go, and also to click through the menus. Watch how high and fast your stickman is moving before you release, then aim to catch the next hook. If you fall, simply try the stage again.
tips: Let go when your stickman is swinging upward and forward, not when he is dropping.
Watch the shape of the swing for a moment before you release on a new stage.
Short, calm swings are often safer than wild, huge ones.
If a stage feels tricky, try a different release point each attempt until you find the right one.

faq.q: How do you play Stickman Hook?
faq.a: You use the mouse to make your stickman swing from hook to hook and let go at the right moment to reach the finish.

faq.q: Is Stickman Hook hard?
faq.a: The controls are very simple, but good timing takes practice, so later stages get more challenging.

drive-mad.summary:
Drive Mad puts you behind the wheel of a small car on a track packed with ramps, bumps and wobbly obstacles. The job sounds easy: get to the finish line. The catch is that the car can tip over if you go too fast or land badly, and then the level is over. So Drive Mad is less about top speed and more about control.

Each track is built like a little stunt course, and part of the fun is figuring out how fast you should drive over each piece. Sometimes you need a burst of speed to clear a gap, and sometimes you need to creep forward or even back up a bit. Drive Mad works with the keyboard, the mouse or a tap on the screen, so it suits different players. It is a racing and driving game for kids who enjoy physics, careful driving and trying again until a tricky level finally works.
drive-mad.how_to: Your aim in Drive Mad is to reach the finish of every track without flipping your car. To drive forward, press W, D, X, the up arrow or the right arrow, or click the mouse. To roll backward, press S, A, Z, the down arrow or the left arrow. On touch screens you can tap. Ease off the gas before jumps and bumps so your car lands on its wheels.
tips: Speed is not always your friend; slow down before big drops.
Use the backward keys to rock your car and fix its balance in the air.
Watch the shape of the track ahead before you hit the gas.
If you keep flipping in the same spot, try that part with a slower start.
Short taps on the forward key give you finer control than holding it down.

faq.q: How do you drive in Drive Mad?
faq.a: Use W, D, X, the up or right arrow or a mouse click to go forward, and S, A, Z, the down or left arrow to go backward.

faq.q: What happens if my car flips in Drive Mad?
faq.a: The run ends and you try the level again, so it pays to drive carefully.

basket-random.summary:
Basket Random is basketball turned silly. Each side has wobbly players who flop and jump around, and you control them with just one key. Because the players move in such a goofy way, every shot is a little surprise. The first side to score five points wins the match.

The randomness is the whole joke: the court, the players and even the ball can change between rounds, so you never play the same match twice. You can take on the computer or sit next to a friend and play Basket Random as a two-player game on one keyboard. Since there is only one button per player, younger kids can join in right away, while older players can work on timing their jumps for better shots. Touch controls are also supported, so it works on phones and tablets too. It is a quick, noisy, laugh-out-loud sports game.
basket-random.how_to: Score baskets until your side reaches five points. Player 1 uses the W key and Player 2 uses the up arrow key; each one key makes your players jump and reach for the ball. Timing matters more than speed, because pressing at the right moment helps your players grab the ball and throw it toward the hoop. On phones and tablets, you can play with touch controls instead.
tips: Do not mash your key; well-timed presses work better.
Watch how the ball bounces before you jump for it.
Get used to each new court and ball, since they can change every round.
When playing a friend, try to jump just after they do to steal the ball.

faq.q: Can two players play Basket Random?
faq.a: Yes. You can play against a friend on one device, with Player 1 on W and Player 2 on the up arrow key.

faq.q: Can I play Basket Random on my phone?
faq.a: Yes, the game supports touch controls on phones and tablets.

faq.q: How do you win Basket Random?
faq.a: The first side to score five points wins the match.

moto-x3m.summary:
Moto X3M is a motorbike stunt racer full of ramps, loops and tricky obstacles. You pick a bike, put on a helmet and ride through off-road courses while the clock runs. The faster you finish, the better your result, but rushing can send your rider flying off the bike.

Every level in Moto X3M has its own set of things to ride over and around, so you have to learn each course a bit before you can master it. Landing jumps is the big skill: if your bike tips at the wrong angle, you crash. Doing flips is not just for show either, because stunts help you shave time off your run. Moto X3M is played with the keyboard and also works on phones and tablets. It is a great fit for kids who like speed, stunts and beating their own best times.
moto-x3m.how_to: Ride to the end of each course as fast as you can without crashing. Press the up arrow to speed up and the down arrow to brake. Use the left and right arrows to tilt your bike forward or back so you land your jumps on both wheels. WASD keys work too. Do flips in the air to gain time, but make sure you finish the flip before you touch the ground.
tips: Lean your bike so both wheels touch down at the same time when you land.
Only flip when you have enough height to finish the turn.
Brake before tricky obstacles instead of racing into them blind.
Replay a level to learn where the hazards are, then go for a faster time.

faq.q: Can I play Moto X3M on my phone?
faq.a: Yes, Moto X3M works on phones and tablets as well as on a computer.

faq.q: What are the controls in Moto X3M?
faq.a: Use the up arrow to accelerate, the down arrow to brake and the left and right arrows to balance; WASD works too.

faq.q: Why should I do flips in Moto X3M?
faq.a: Flips and other stunts help you gain time, which improves your result for the level.

slope-game.summary:
In the Slope game you guide a rolling ball down a long, steep track that keeps changing as you go. The path is randomized, so no two runs look exactly the same. At first the ball moves at a calm pace, but the farther you get, the faster it rolls, and soon you need quick reactions just to stay on the track.

Red blocks and other obstacles pop up along the way, and touching them ends your run, as does rolling off the edge. Your score grows with every bit of distance, which makes the Slope game a classic chase for a new high score. It is a simple racing-style game with one clear goal and a fast rhythm, perfect for short breaks. Because each run starts fresh, you can always try one more time to beat your best distance.
slope-game.how_to: Roll your ball as far down the slope as you can. Steer it left and right to stay on the track, dodge the red blocks and avoid falling off the edges. The ball speeds up the longer you survive, so your reactions need to get quicker as the run goes on. The game explains its controls as soon as it starts, so check them on the first screen.
tips: Stay near the middle of the track so you have room to react.
Look ahead at the path instead of staring at the ball.
Make small steering moves; big swerves can push you off the edge.
Red blocks are the main danger, so plan your path around them early.

faq.q: How do you play the Slope game?
faq.a: Steer a rolling ball down a random track, avoid red blocks and edges, and try to go as far as possible.

faq.q: Does the Slope game get harder?
faq.a: Yes, the ball keeps speeding up the farther you go, so it gets tougher over time.

tiny-fishing.summary:
Tiny Fishing is a calm and cozy fishing game with a clever upgrade loop. You cast your line, guide the hook as it sinks, and pull up as many fish as you can on the way back. Every fish you bring to the surface turns into cash, and that cash buys better skills and new hooks for your next cast.

The fun of Tiny Fishing comes from watching yourself improve. A short line at the start only reaches a few fish, but after a few upgrades you dive deeper and haul up much bigger catches. There is also a nice bonus: the game keeps earning cash for you even after you leave, so coming back feels rewarding. It is played with the mouse and needs no fast reflexes, which makes it a friendly pick for younger kids and anyone who wants a relaxing game.
tiny-fishing.how_to: Catch as many fish as possible on each cast and use your earnings to upgrade. First click the spinner to set how far you cast. While the hook travels, hold the mouse button and drag sideways to steer it toward fish. Once the line comes back up, you are paid for every fish on it. Spend the cash between casts on upgrades and new hooks.
tips: Spend early cash on upgrades that help you catch more fish per cast.
Move the hook toward groups of fish rather than chasing single ones.
Come back later to collect the cash the game earned while you were away.
Try to time the spinner well, since a good cast helps you reach more fish.

faq.q: How do you play Tiny Fishing?
faq.a: Click the spinner to cast, then hold and drag sideways to steer the hook and catch fish. Sell your catch and buy upgrades.

faq.q: Do you earn money in Tiny Fishing when you are not playing?
faq.a: Yes, the game keeps earning cash for you even after you leave.

basketball-stars.summary:
Basketball Stars is a quick shooting game where every throw counts. You aim the ball at the hoop and try to sink shot after shot. There is no long match or team to manage here, just you, the ball and the basket, which makes it easy to jump into for a few minutes.

The rules are strict in a fun way: miss once and you have to start over. That turns every throw into a small challenge and makes a long streak feel exciting. Your main target is a new personal best, so each round is a chance to go a little further. Basketball Stars is played with simple clicks, and the partner notes say you can also swipe on a smartphone or tablet. It is a good pick for sports fans who like short, focused rounds and a steady test of timing.
basketball-stars.how_to: Score as many baskets in a row as you can. On a computer, click at the right moment to shoot the ball toward the hoop. On a touch screen you can slide your finger to set the direction of the ball. Each basket adds to your score, but a single miss means you start again from zero, so aim carefully before every shot.
tips: Take a moment to aim instead of shooting as fast as possible.
Notice the timing that worked on your last good shot and repeat it.
Keep calm after a long streak; that is when misses usually happen.
Set yourself small goals, like beating your score by just one basket.

faq.q: How do you play Basketball Stars?
faq.a: Click at the right time, or swipe on a touch screen, to shoot the ball into the hoop. Keep scoring without missing.

faq.q: What happens if I miss in Basketball Stars?
faq.a: A miss ends your streak and you have to start over.

monkey-mart.summary:
Monkey Mart lets you run your very own supermarket as a cute monkey. You plant fruit, fill shelves with bananas, corn and other goods, and work the cashier desk as customers wander in to shop. Keeping the store stocked and the line moving is the heart of the game.

As money comes in, Monkey Mart opens up more to do. You can upgrade your monkey, unlock new work stations and hire extra workers who help with the busy jobs. Little by little your small shop grows into a bigger, smoother business. It is an idle management game, so it rewards planning more than fast fingers, and you can see your progress in every new stand you open. Monkey Mart is a fun choice for kids who like shop games, collecting and watching something they built get bigger.
monkey-mart.how_to: Your job is to keep your supermarket running and growing. Move your monkey with the WASD keys or the arrow keys. Walk to the fields to gather crops, carry products to the right stands, and head to the cashier desk to take payments from customers. Use your earnings to upgrade your monkey, open new work stations and hire helpers.
tips: Keep the most popular stands full so customers do not leave empty-handed.
Do not forget the cashier desk; customers waiting there means money waiting for you.
Hiring workers early frees you up to handle other jobs.
Plan your walking route between crops, stands and the till to save time.

faq.q: How do you move in Monkey Mart?
faq.a: Use the WASD keys or the arrow keys to walk your monkey around the store.

faq.q: What do you do in Monkey Mart?
faq.a: You plant crops, stock shelves, serve customers at the cashier and use your money to upgrade and grow the store.

hole-io.summary:
Hole IO is a city-eating game with a funny twist: you are a hole in the ground. Everything that fits inside you drops in, from small objects at first to bigger things as you grow. The more you swallow, the larger your hole becomes, and the more of the city you can gobble up.

The game is competitive, so you are not alone on the map. Other holes are growing too, and size matters: bigger holes can win out over smaller ones. That gives Hole IO a nice mix of exploring the streets and keeping an eye on your rivals. Rounds are short and easy to understand, which makes it a friendly entry into .io-style games. You play with the mouse, steering your hole around corners and across open squares to find the best spots to feed.
hole-io.how_to: Grow your hole by swallowing as much of the city as you can. Use the mouse to steer the hole around the map. Start with small things that fit, then go after bigger objects once your hole has grown. Watch out for other players' holes and try to be the biggest one when the round ends.
tips: Clear small objects first; they help you grow quickly at the start.
Head for areas full of items rather than empty roads.
Stay away from holes that are larger than yours.
Once you are big, go after larger objects to grow even faster.

faq.q: How do you play Hole IO?
faq.a: Move your hole with the mouse and swallow objects in the city to grow bigger than the other players.

faq.q: Is Hole IO multiplayer?
faq.a: Yes, it is an online game where you compete against other holes.

basketball-legends.summary:
Basketball Legends is a lively basketball game where you pick a team and hit the court for fast one-on-one style action. You can enter a tournament against the computer or jump into quick matches against a friend on the same keyboard. Dunks, three-pointers and a bit of rough play are all part of the show.

One feature to watch is the super shot bar at the top of the screen. When it fills up, you can fire a special dunk from anywhere on the court, and it always goes in. You can also block your opponent or slap the ball away to win possession. Basketball Legends mixes real basketball ideas with over-the-top moves, so matches feel energetic and a bit wild. It suits sports fans and anyone who likes a friendly head-to-head contest at home.
basketball-legends.how_to: Score more points than your opponent before the match ends. Player 1 moves and jumps with the WASD keys and uses X, Z and V for slapping, throwing and dunking. Player 2 moves and jumps with the arrow keys and uses K and L for the action moves. Fill the super shot bar at the top of the screen to unlock a special dunk.
tips: Save your super shot for a tight moment in the match.
Use slaps and blocks to take the ball when your opponent tries to shoot.
Mix up dunks and long shots so your rival cannot predict you.
Practice in quick matches before entering the tournament.

faq.q: Can two players play Basketball Legends?
faq.a: Yes. Player 1 uses WASD with X, Z and V, and Player 2 uses the arrow keys with K and L.

faq.q: What is the super shot in Basketball Legends?
faq.a: When the bar at the top fills up, you can use a special dunk from anywhere on the court.

tunnel-rush.summary:
Tunnel Rush throws you into a spinning 3D tunnel full of colorful hazards. You race forward at high speed while barriers appear in front of you, and your only job is to dodge them. The walls swirl and flash, so it feels a bit like flying through a giant kaleidoscope.

Each level brings a new pattern of obstacles, and some barriers even move, so you need to guess where they will be a moment later. Tunnel Rush looks frantic, but you usually have a little more time than you think to slip past each gap. There is also a two-player mode where two racers go side by side on the same screen to see who lasts longer. It works with the keyboard and on phones and tablets. If you enjoy reaction games and want to train quick eyes, this one is a great test.
tunnel-rush.how_to: Survive as long as you can by dodging every barrier in the tunnel. Press the left and right arrow keys, or A and D, to move left and right around the tunnel. Press Space to pause or restart. Look for the open gap in each obstacle and steer into it early, especially when barriers are moving.
tips: Look for the gap as soon as an obstacle appears and start moving early.
Moving barriers are easier if you aim for where they are going, not where they are now.
Stay calm; there is often more time to dodge than it seems.
Use Space to pause if you need a quick break.

faq.q: Can two players play Tunnel Rush?
faq.a: Yes, there is a two-player mode where you race side by side on the same screen.

faq.q: Can I play Tunnel Rush on my phone?
faq.a: Yes, Tunnel Rush works on phones and tablets as well as computers.

faq.q: What are the controls for Tunnel Rush?
faq.a: Use the left and right arrow keys or A and D to move, and Space to pause or restart.

planet-clicker.summary:
Planet Clicker is a simple clicker game where every click helps something grow. You tap away with the mouse, collect points and spend them on upgrades that make each click worth more. It is the kind of game where small steps add up, and watching your numbers climb is a big part of the fun.

Because the gameplay is endless, there is no final level to rush toward. You decide how long to play and which upgrades to pick next. That makes Planet Clicker a relaxed choice for short breaks or for kids who like slowly building up a big score. It also teaches a bit of planning, since choosing the right upgrade at the right time helps you grow faster. If you enjoy clicker games with a calm pace, Planet Clicker is easy to start and easy to come back to.
planet-clicker.how_to: The goal is to keep growing your score by clicking. Use the mouse to click and earn points, then spend those points on upgrades that boost your progress. Pick upgrades that raise your earnings so each click counts for more. The game has no fixed ending, so you can play for as long as you like.
tips: Buy upgrades early, because they make every later click more valuable.
Compare upgrade prices and pick the ones that help you most for the cost.
Take short breaks; clicker games reward steady play, not speed alone.

faq.q: How do you play Planet Clicker?
faq.a: Click with the mouse to earn points and spend them on upgrades that help you earn more.

faq.q: Does Planet Clicker have an ending?
faq.a: No, it is an endless clicker, so you can keep playing and upgrading.

paper-io-2.summary:
Paper.IO 2 is an online territory game where you paint the map in your own color. Everyone starts with a small patch of land. You leave your area, draw a trail across open ground and return home to turn that loop into new territory. The bigger your area gets, the higher you climb.

There is a risk every time you head out. Inside your own land you are safe, but outside you drag a tail behind you, and if an enemy crosses it, you are out. That makes Paper.IO 2 a smart mix of greed and caution: big loops grab lots of land but leave you exposed for longer. You can also cut other players' tails to knock them out. The game works with the mouse or with the WASD and arrow keys, and it is a quick, competitive game for kids who like strategy with speed.
paper-io-2.how_to: Grab as much of the map as you can. Steer with the mouse or with the WASD or arrow keys. Leave your area to draw a line, then come back to your land to fill the shape you made. Do not let rivals touch your trail while you are outside, and try to cross their trails to beat them.
tips: Make small, safe loops at first, then bigger ones when no one is nearby.
Always know the shortest way back to your own land.
Watch enemies that come close while your trail is out.
Look for a chance to cut an enemy's tail when they wander far from home.

faq.q: Is Paper.IO 2 multiplayer?
faq.a: Yes, it is an online game where you compete against other players for territory.

faq.q: What are the controls in Paper.IO 2?
faq.a: You can steer with the mouse or with the WASD or arrow keys.

eggy-car.summary:
Eggy Car is a gentle-looking driving game with one fragile problem: there is an egg balanced on your car. You want to cover as much distance as you can over rolling hills without letting the egg slide off and crack. It sounds simple, but the egg wobbles with every bump.

Eggy Car uses physics, so speed and slopes really matter. Go too fast over a hill and the egg flies off; go too slow up a steep slope and you might roll back. Mixing gas and brake in just the right amounts is the whole skill. The controls are minimal, which makes it easy for younger kids to try, while the distance chase keeps older players hooked. Eggy Car plays well on a computer with the arrow keys and on phones or tablets with on-screen pedals. It is a single-player game that is perfect for quick runs.
eggy-car.how_to: Cover as much distance as you can while keeping the egg on board. On a computer, use the arrow keys to accelerate and brake. On a phone or tablet, tap the pedals on screen to speed up or slow down. Ease off the gas at the top of each hill and brake gently on the way down so the egg stays in place.
tips: Slow down before the top of a hill so the egg does not get launched.
Use gentle, short presses instead of holding the gas all the time.
On steep slopes, keep a steady speed rather than stopping and starting.
Watch the egg, not just the road, so you notice when it starts to slide.

faq.q: Can I play Eggy Car on my phone?
faq.a: Yes. On phones and tablets you tap the on-screen pedals to accelerate and brake.

faq.q: How do you play Eggy Car?
faq.a: Drive over hills using the arrow keys or the pedals and try to go as far as you can without dropping the egg.

rodha.summary:
Rodha is a speedy action platformer starring a bouncy ball. You pick from 9 different characters, each with its own personality, and roll through 60 levels packed with jumps and danger. The world has a clean, minimalist look, which makes it easy to see what is coming at you.

And plenty is coming. Cannons, moving saws and other traps are placed to end your run, so each level is a little puzzle of timing and movement. Rodha is the kind of game where you fail, learn the pattern and then glide through on the next try. It works with the keyboard and on touch screens, so you can play on a computer, a phone or a tablet. With its short levels and growing challenge, Rodha is a good fit for kids who like platformers that test quick thinking.
rodha.how_to: Guide your ball character to the end of each of the 60 levels. Press A and D, or the left and right arrow keys, to move. On a touch screen you can simply tap the screen instead. Watch the timing of cannons and saws, wait for a safe gap and then move through quickly.
tips: Pause for a second at the start of a level to see how traps move.
Moving saws follow patterns, so watch them before you go.
Try different characters to find the one you enjoy most.
If you keep failing, break the level into small parts in your head.

faq.q: How many levels does Rodha have?
faq.a: Rodha has 60 levels to play through.

faq.q: Can I play Rodha on my phone?
faq.a: Yes, Rodha works on phones and tablets, and you can tap the screen to play.

narrow-one.summary:
Narrow One is a 3D archery game where teams battle to capture each other's flag. Instead of guns, every player has a bow and arrows, so careful aim and quick reactions decide each fight. The action takes place in a castle arena with walls, paths and hiding spots to explore.

Teamwork is a big part of Narrow One. While some players push toward the enemy flag, others can defend their own base or cover teammates with arrows from a distance. You can invite friends to play together, which makes matches even more fun. Because the bow takes a moment to draw, every shot feels earned, and landing a long hit is very satisfying. Narrow One is played with the keyboard and mouse, and it also has touch controls for mobile. It is a great choice for older kids who enjoy team games and aiming challenges.
narrow-one.how_to: Help your team capture the enemy flag in the castle arena. Move with the WASD keys. To shoot, hold the left mouse button to draw your bow and release it to fire an arrow. On mobile, use the touch indicator on the screen. Work with your teammates to attack, defend your own flag and hit opponents before they reach you.
tips: Hold the shot a little longer for a stronger, straighter arrow.
Aim slightly ahead of moving players.
Use walls and corners for cover while you line up shots.
Do not all rush the flag; someone should defend your base.

faq.q: Can I play Narrow One with friends?
faq.a: Yes, you can invite friends to join you in team matches.

faq.q: How do you shoot in Narrow One?
faq.a: Hold the left mouse button to draw the bow and release it to shoot. On mobile, use the touch controls on screen.

soccer-random.summary:
Soccer Random is a wacky football game where nothing stays the same for long. Each team has bouncy, floppy players, and you control them with a single key. Shots fly in odd directions, players tumble around, and goals often come from pure chaos, which is exactly the point.

The game keeps switching things up. One round you might be on an icy field, the next on a beach, and the ball, players and goals can all change too. The first side to score five goals wins. You can play Soccer Random against the computer or against a friend on the same device, which makes it a great pick for siblings or friends sitting side by side. Touch controls are supported, so phones and tablets work as well. It is short, funny and easy to learn, but timing your kicks still takes a bit of skill.
soccer-random.how_to: Score five goals before your opponent does. Player 1 presses W and Player 2 presses the up arrow key; that single key makes your players jump and kick. Press at the right time to send the ball toward the goal. On phones and tablets you can use touch controls. Get used to each new field, because the surface and ball can change every round.
tips: Time your jump for when the ball is close, not far away.
Icy and sandy fields change how players move, so adjust your timing.
Sometimes waiting a moment is better than jumping right away.
In two-player games, try to reach the ball just before your friend.

faq.q: Can two players play Soccer Random?
faq.a: Yes. Player 1 uses W and Player 2 uses the up arrow key on the same device.

faq.q: Can I play Soccer Random on a tablet?
faq.a: Yes, the game supports touch controls on phones and tablets.

faq.q: How do you win in Soccer Random?
faq.a: The first side to score five goals wins the match.

electron-dash.summary:
Electron Dash is a fast maze game powered by magnets. Instead of running and jumping like a normal hero, you move by switching your charge. Opposite charges pull you in, and matching charges push you away. That means you can launch off walls, swing around magnetic pillars and drift through tight corners.

Each maze asks you to collect all the coins and reach the finish zone, all while the timer is still ticking. Traps are scattered around, so you need to plan your path while you are already flying. Electron Dash takes a few tries to get used to, but once the push and pull clicks, it feels smooth and fun. The game works on phones and tablets as well as computers, and it is a good fit for kids who like physics puzzles with a bit of speed. Think fast, then let the magnets do the work.
electron-dash.how_to: Grab every coin and get to the finish zone before the clock hits zero. You steer with the slider along the lower edge of the screen. Move it left for a negative (blue) charge and slide right for a positive (red) charge. Let go to return to neutral. Opposite charges attract you toward magnets, and matching charges repel you, which you can use to launch yourself across the maze.
tips: Use repel to launch yourself quickly across open spaces.
Switch to attract near pillars to swing around corners.
Let go of the slider when you need to drift without being pulled.
Plan a route that grabs coins on the way, so you do not run out of time.

faq.q: How do you control Electron Dash?
faq.a: Use the slider along the lower edge of the screen: left for a blue negative charge, right for a red positive charge, and let go for neutral.

faq.q: Can I play Electron Dash on my phone?
faq.a: Yes, it works on phones and tablets as well as computers.

faq.q: What is the goal in Electron Dash?
faq.a: Collect all the coins and reach the finish zone before the timer runs out.

line-rider.summary:
Line Rider is a drawing puzzle where your pencil builds the track. A small rider is waiting to slide down to a flag, and it is up to you to draw the lines that get them there. When your path is ready, you start the ride and watch whether your design works.

That moment of watching is the best part of Line Rider. A smooth curve can send the rider zooming along perfectly, while a line that is too steep or too bumpy can send them tumbling. You can try again as often as you like and tweak your drawing until it works. There are coins to catch too, so you can challenge yourself to collect as many as possible on the way. It is a creative, single-player game for kids who like drawing, experimenting and a little bit of physics.
line-rider.how_to: Draw a path that carries your rider all the way to the flag. Use the mouse to draw lines on the screen. When you are happy with your track, press Space to start the rider and watch them slide. If they crash or stop, adjust your lines and try again. Shape the track so it also passes through as many coins as you can.
tips: Draw smooth curves; sharp corners often make the rider crash.
Start with a simple path to the flag, then add detours for coins.
Give the rider enough slope to build speed, but not so much that they fly off.
Watch each failed ride carefully to see exactly where it went wrong.

faq.q: How do you play Line Rider?
faq.a: Draw a track with the mouse, then press Space to send the rider down it toward the flag.

faq.q: Is Line Rider good for kids?
faq.a: Yes, it is a calm drawing puzzle that encourages creativity and trying new ideas.

golf-orbit.summary:
Golf Orbit gives golf a playful, over-the-top twist. Instead of careful putts on a quiet green, you power up a shot and blast the ball across wild courses filled with quirky obstacles. The key tool is the power meter, which decides how hard you hit.

Getting the power just right is the challenge in Golf Orbit. Too little and your ball stops short, too much and it might fly past where you want it. As you play, you earn rewards and can customize your golfer, which adds a fun sense of progress. The tone is light and silly, so it is easy to enjoy even if you have never played real golf. Golf Orbit sits in the casual sports category and works well for short sessions. The game shows its controls when it starts, so you can jump right in.
golf-orbit.how_to: Hit the ball with the right amount of power to get it through each course toward the green. Watch the power meter and stop it at a good level before the shot. Avoid the obstacles along the way and use your rewards to customize your golfer. A quick guide to the controls pops up when you begin, so check the opening screen to see how to shoot.
tips: Watch the power meter rise and fall a few times before you commit.
Remember which power level worked on each type of shot.
Look at the obstacles first and plan where you want the ball to land.
Use your rewards to try new looks for your golfer.

faq.q: How do you play Golf Orbit?
faq.a: Use the power meter to choose how hard to hit, then send the ball across the course past obstacles.

faq.q: Can I customize my golfer in Golf Orbit?
faq.a: Yes, you earn rewards and can customize your golfer as you play.

house-of-hazards.summary:
House of Hazards is a funny race through an ordinary apartment that is anything but safe. Each player has a list of everyday tasks to finish, but the house is full of traps. Lamps fall, cabinets swing, and your rivals are watching, ready to set those traps off at the worst possible moment for you.

That is what makes House of Hazards so much fun: you are trying to get your own jobs done while also messing up everyone else's. Timing a trap just as an opponent walks by is very satisfying. After each round, a wheel of fortune spins to set the rules of the round that follows, which keeps matches fresh. The game is played on the keyboard, and a multiplayer option lets you take on a friend. It is a great pick for two players who like silly competition and quick, chaotic rounds.
house-of-hazards.how_to: Finish all your tasks in the apartment before your opponents do. Move through the rooms with the keyboard and avoid dangers such as lamps that drop and cabinets that swing. When a rival is near a trap, trigger it at the right moment to slow them down. After each round, check the wheel of fortune to find out how the next one will work. The game shows the exact keys when it starts.
tips: Learn where the traps are so you can avoid them and use them.
Trigger traps when rivals are right next to them, not too early.
Do not stop for too long; keep moving toward your next task.
Check the wheel's rule each round, since it can change your plan.

faq.q: Can two players play House of Hazards?
faq.a: Yes, switch on the multiplayer option to compete with a friend.

faq.q: How do you play House of Hazards?
faq.a: Use the keyboard to complete tasks around the house while dodging traps and setting traps for your opponents.

diep-io.summary:
Diep.io is an online tank battle where you start small and grow into something powerful. You roll around the arena in a basic tank, fight other players and earn the strength to upgrade. Each upgrade lets you choose how you want to play, so your tank slowly becomes your own design.

Every round of Diep.io feels a bit different, because the other players change and their tanks do too. Some like to rush in close, others prefer to keep their distance, and part of the fun is reading what your opponents are up to. Being smart matters as much as being quick: picking your fights and adapting your upgrades can win you the match. Diep.io is an .io game, so it is easy to start and can be enjoyed by beginners and experienced players alike. The game shows its controls when you start.
diep-io.how_to: Grow your tank by battling and upgrade it into a stronger type. Drive around the arena, shoot at opponents and avoid taking too much damage. As you get stronger, choose upgrades that match how you like to play, whether up close or from far away. The controls are shown right at the start, so take a quick look before your first battle.
tips: Avoid big, strong tanks while you are still small.
Pick one play style and choose upgrades that support it.
Keep moving; standing still makes you an easy target.
Watch how other players fight and adapt your plan.

faq.q: Is Diep.io multiplayer?
faq.a: Yes, it is an online game where you battle other players.

faq.q: How do you get stronger in Diep.io?
faq.a: You earn upgrades as you play and use them to turn your basic tank into a stronger one.

red-ball-4.summary:
Red Ball 4 is a rolling, bouncing platform adventure with a planet to save. Evil minions plan to squash the world into a square, and only a brave round ball can stop them. Your hero rolls and jumps through a dangerous factory full of machines and traps.

Along the way you collect stars and deal with the square bad guys. Jumping on enemies works well, but bumping into a sharp corner does not, so you need to be careful how you approach them. Some areas have moving laser beams, which means precise rolling and good timing. Red Ball 4 is a classic-style platformer that feels easy to learn but gets trickier as you go deeper. It is played with the arrow keys and is a nice fit for kids who like adventure games with a clear hero and a clear mission.
red-ball-4.how_to: Roll your ball to the goal of each level and grab the stars on the way. Use the arrow keys to roll left and right and to jump. Land on top of enemies to defeat them, but avoid touching their sharp corners. Watch out for moving lasers and wait for a safe moment before you roll past.
tips: Jump on enemies from above instead of rolling into them.
Wait for lasers to move away before you go through.
Go back for stars you missed if it is safe to do so.
Use small jumps for precise landings on narrow platforms.

faq.q: How do you play Red Ball 4?
faq.a: Use the arrow keys to roll and jump through each level, collect stars and defeat enemies by jumping on them.

faq.q: What is the story of Red Ball 4?
faq.a: Evil minions want to turn the planet into a square, and your ball sets out to stop them.

iron-snout.summary:
Iron Snout is a cartoon fighting game where a brave pig stands up to a pack of wolves. Wave after wave of attackers comes running in, and you punch, kick and flip to keep them away. Wolves also throw axes and other things, so you need to dodge as well as fight.

The best part of Iron Snout is how fast and smooth the action feels. All you need are the arrow keys, but the timing of each move decides whether you knock a wolf out or get hit. You can play in Classic mode or try Sudden Death for an extra challenge. The cartoon style keeps things light, so it feels more like a slapstick show than a serious fight. Iron Snout is a good choice for kids who like action games with simple controls and plenty of quick reactions.
iron-snout.how_to: Defend your pig against waves of wolves for as long as you can. Use the arrow keys to jump and hit wolves on each side. Press the direction a wolf is coming from to strike it, and jump to dodge thrown axes and other objects. Keep reacting quickly, because the wolves keep coming from both sides.
tips: Hit wolves as they come close, not too early.
Jump to avoid thrown projectiles instead of trying to hit them all.
Keep your eyes on both sides of the screen.
Try Sudden Death mode once you are comfortable in Classic mode.

faq.q: How do you play Iron Snout?
faq.a: Use the arrow keys to jump and hit the wolves that attack your pig, and dodge anything they throw.

faq.q: What modes does Iron Snout have?
faq.a: You can play solo in Classic mode or in the tougher Sudden Death mode.

blockpost.summary:
BLOCKPOST is a first-person 3D shooter set in a chunky, blocky world. You pick a weapon from your arsenal, drop into a map and take part in fast team battles. The look is simple and colorful, but the action moves quickly and rewards good aim.

There is a lot to explore in BLOCKPOST. The game offers seven modes, more than 20 maps and more than 100 different firearms, so you can keep switching things up. Every match earns you coins, and the more you play, the higher you level up, which helps you get stronger over time. It plays on a computer with the mouse and keyboard and also works on phones and tablets. Because it is a shooter, it fits older kids best, especially those who enjoy blocky games and like improving their aim match after match.
blockpost.how_to: Join a match, choose your weapon and help your side win the battle. Shoot with the left mouse button and aim with the right mouse button. Press Space to jump and use the number keys to change weapons. Play matches to collect coins and level up, then try the different modes and maps to find your favorite.
tips: Use the right mouse button to aim before you fire for better accuracy.
Switch weapons with the number keys to match the distance of your target.
Learn each map's layout so you know where to find cover.
Keep playing matches to earn coins and level up.

faq.q: What are the controls in BLOCKPOST?
faq.a: Left mouse button shoots, right mouse button aims, Space jumps and the number keys change weapons.

faq.q: Can I play BLOCKPOST on my phone?
faq.a: Yes, it works on phones and tablets as well as on a computer.

faq.q: How many maps and weapons does BLOCKPOST have?
faq.a: It has more than 20 maps, seven game modes and more than 100 different firearms.

worms-zone.summary:
Worms Zone takes the classic snake idea and adds a big splash of color. You guide a hungry worm around bright zones, eating as you go and growing longer and longer. The bigger you get, the more space you take up, and the more careful you need to be.

There are rival worms around, so Worms Zone is a constant mix of chasing food and staying out of trouble. You can speed up, collect power-ups and plan your path to grow faster than everyone else. Customizing your worm adds a personal touch, so your little creature can look the way you want. The goal is simple: become the longest worm. It is a relaxed but competitive arcade game that suits kids who loved snake games and want something more colorful. The game explains its controls when it starts.
worms-zone.how_to: Grow your worm as long as possible by eating food around the map. Steer your worm through the colorful zones, collect power-ups and avoid crashing into rivals. Balance speed with caution: moving fast helps you grab more, but it also makes mistakes easier. The controls are shown right at the start, so check them before your first round.
tips: Stay away from bigger worms until you have grown.
Grab power-ups when they are close and safe to reach.
Do not speed up near crowds of other worms.
Circle around open areas where food is easy to collect.

faq.q: How do you play Worms Zone?
faq.a: You steer a worm around the map, eat to grow longer and avoid rivals while trying to become the longest worm.

faq.q: Can I customize my worm in Worms Zone?
faq.a: Yes, the game lets you customize how your worm looks.

tentrix.summary:
TenTrix is a calm block puzzle played on a 10x10 grid. Shapes come in, and you place them on the board to fill complete lines. When a line is full, it clears away and you score points. It feels a bit like the famous falling-block games, but with its own rules.

The big twist in TenTrix is that the shapes cannot be rotated. You have to use each piece exactly as it arrives, which means planning ahead is much more important. Leaving the right gaps, keeping the board tidy and thinking about what might come next is the key to a long game. There is no rush to finish, so you can take your time and think. According to the publisher, TenTrix plays on both computers and mobile devices. It is a great pick for kids who like puzzles, patterns and keeping things neat.
tentrix.how_to: Place the shapes on the 10x10 board to fill whole rows or columns and clear them for points. Remember that you cannot turn the shapes, so look at each piece and find a spot where it fits as it is. Keep space open for larger pieces and try not to leave single holes. The controls appear on screen when the game begins.
tips: Keep an open area free for big shapes.
Fill lines that are almost complete first.
Avoid leaving single empty squares that few shapes can fill.
Since pieces cannot rotate, think about where each shape fits before placing it.

faq.q: Can you rotate the blocks in TenTrix?
faq.a: No, the shapes in TenTrix cannot be rotated, so you must place them as they are.

faq.q: How big is the TenTrix board?
faq.a: The board is a 10x10 grid.

hills-of-steel.summary:
Hills of Steel is a tank battle game with bouncy, realistic physics. You drive a steel tank across hilly battlefields, firing at enemy tanks and trying not to flip over on the bumps. Defeated enemies drop rewards, and you can spend them to make your tank tougher.

There is a clear sense of progress in Hills of Steel. You improve your armor and weapons, unlock new tanks with different styles, and face stronger enemies as you go. When a level ends, a larger boss tank with more health can appear, and beating it gives extra coins. The battles start on Earth and later move all the way to the Moon. The game has gold and diamonds as currencies, and the publisher includes optional in-game purchases. Hills of Steel is a single-player game that works on computers and on phones or tablets, with on-screen buttons for touch screens.
hills-of-steel.how_to: Drive your tank across the hills and destroy enemy tanks. On a computer, move with A and D or the arrow keys, press Space to fire and press X to use the booster. On phones and tablets, tap the on-screen buttons instead. Collect rewards from defeated enemies and spend gold on upgrades to handle tougher opponents and bosses.
tips: Do not rush over big hills; a flipped tank is an easy target.
Upgrade your armor early so you survive longer fights.
Save the booster for moments when you need extra speed.
Save up for stronger bosses, since beating them pays more coins.

faq.q: What are the controls in Hills of Steel?
faq.a: Use A and D or the arrow keys to move, Space to shoot and X for the booster. On mobile, use the on-screen buttons.

faq.q: Can I play Hills of Steel on my phone?
faq.a: Yes, it works on phones and tablets with on-screen buttons.

faq.q: Does Hills of Steel have bosses?
faq.a: Yes, a bigger boss tank with more health can show up when a level ends.

cut-the-rope.summary:
Cut the Rope is a logic puzzle game starring Om Nom, a little green creature who loves candy more than anything. In every level a piece of candy hangs from one or more ropes, and Om Nom is waiting below with his mouth open. Your job is to cut the ropes in the right order so the candy swings and drops right into his mouth.

The rules are easy to understand, but the puzzles make you think. Cut too early and the candy falls the wrong way; wait for the right swing and it lands perfectly. Each level is a small physics puzzle, so you learn by watching how the candy moves. Cut the Rope is a friendly choice for kids of all ages who like casual puzzles with a cute character. It is relaxing, but it also rewards patience and clever timing.
cut-the-rope.how_to: Feed the candy to Om Nom in each level. Cut the ropes holding the candy so it swings and falls into his mouth. On a touch screen you slide your finger across a rope to cut it. Watch how the candy swings before cutting, because the timing decides where it will land. If the candy misses, restart the level and try another order.
tips: Watch the candy swing a few times before you cut.
Think about the order of cuts when there is more than one rope.
Cut when the candy is moving toward Om Nom, not away from him.
If a level fails, try changing just one cut at a time.

faq.q: How do you play Cut the Rope?
faq.a: Cut the ropes holding the candy so it falls into Om Nom's mouth. On touch screens, slide your finger across a rope.

faq.q: Who is Om Nom?
faq.a: Om Nom is the little candy-loving creature you need to feed in every level.

gulper-io.summary:
gulper.io is an online snake game where you start as a tiny glowing worm in a crowded arena. Glowing dots are scattered all over the map, and every one you eat makes you a bit longer. The bigger you grow, the more power you have over the other worms on the field.

Defeating rivals is the exciting part of gulper.io. If another worm runs into your body, it is out, so smart players try to trap others by circling around them. Of course, the same can happen to you, so you have to keep moving and watch for worms sneaking close. A speed boost helps you escape danger or cut someone off at the last moment. It is a multiplayer .io game played with the mouse, and it suits kids who like quick thinking, sneaky tactics and a race to become the biggest worm on the map.
gulper-io.how_to: Grow as long as you can by eating glowing dots, and knock out other worms. Move your worm with the mouse; it follows your pointer. Hold the left mouse button for a speed boost. Make other worms crash into your body to defeat them, and avoid running into anyone else's body yourself.
tips: Use the speed boost to cut in front of a rival, then turn away.
Circle around smaller worms to trap them.
Do not boost when you are surrounded; you may crash.
Eat the dots left behind after a worm is defeated to grow fast.

faq.q: Is gulper.io multiplayer?
faq.a: Yes, it is an online game where you play against other worms.

faq.q: How do you speed up in gulper.io?
faq.a: Hold the left mouse button to use a speed boost.

moto-x3m-5-pool-party.summary:
Moto X3M 5 - Pool Party is a summer-themed entry in the Moto X3M motocross series. Like the earlier games, you ride a dirt bike through a string of stunt levels and try to finish each one as fast as you can. This time the theme is a big pool party, so expect a sunny, splashy setting.

The core idea of Moto X3M 5 - Pool Party stays the same: speed matters, but so does control. Ramps and jumps are part of every course, and a careless landing can end your run. You will want to replay levels to learn where the danger is and find faster lines. It is a racing and motorcycle game that suits kids who enjoy stunts and short, intense levels. If you have played other Moto X3M games, you will feel at home right away. The game shows its controls when it starts.
moto-x3m-5-pool-party.how_to: Ride your motocross bike through each level and reach the finish as fast as possible. Control your speed and the angle of your bike so you land jumps safely. Try again whenever you crash and look for quicker paths on later runs. A quick guide to the controls pops up when you begin, so check them before you begin.
tips: Learn a level slowly first, then go for speed.
Land on both wheels to avoid crashing.
Watch for obstacles that appear right after a jump.
Replay levels to improve your times.

faq.q: What is Moto X3M 5 - Pool Party?
faq.a: It is the fifth game in the Moto X3M series, with a pool party theme and timed motocross levels.

faq.q: How do you win in Moto X3M 5 - Pool Party?
faq.a: Reach the end of each level as fast as you can without crashing.

apple-worm.summary:
Apple Worm is a cute brain teaser starring a hungry little worm that loves apples. Each level is a small maze, and you need to crawl through it, eat the apples and reach the portal to escape. It looks sweet and simple, but the puzzles are trickier than they first seem.

What makes Apple Worm clever is the way the worm moves. Your body follows behind you, and eating an apple makes it longer, which changes what you can reach. Gravity and tight spaces mean that one wrong step can leave you stuck, so you have to think carefully before every move. The levels hide sneaky traps, so planning is more important than speed. Apple Worm is a great choice for kids who like puzzles that need patience and careful thinking. The game shows its controls when you start.
apple-worm.how_to: Guide the worm through the maze, eat the apples and reach the portal. Plan each move before you make it, because your body follows behind and grows longer after every apple. Avoid dangers along the way and make sure you do not trap yourself. The game explains its controls as soon as it starts, so check them before playing.
tips: Think about how long the worm will be after eating an apple.
Look at the whole level before your first move.
If you get stuck, restart instead of trying to wiggle free.
Sometimes the apple should be eaten last, not first.

faq.q: How do you play Apple Worm?
faq.a: Move the worm through each maze, eat the apples and reach the portal without getting stuck.

faq.q: Is Apple Worm hard?
faq.a: It starts simple, but many levels hide traps that need careful planning.

happy-glass.summary:
Happy Glass is a creative drawing puzzle with a thirsty glass at its center. In each level, water is about to pour, and the glass is waiting to be filled. You draw lines on the screen to guide the water into the glass, and when it fills up, the glass is happy.

The fun of Happy Glass is that there are many ways to solve a level. A simple line might be enough, or you may need a clever ramp or wall to steer the water around obstacles. Each level asks for a new idea, so you learn to think creatively and test different shapes. The style is light and cheerful, which makes it relaxing to play. It is a casual puzzle game that suits kids who like drawing and solving problems their own way. The game shows how to draw when it starts.
happy-glass.how_to: Draw lines that guide the water into the glass until it is full. Look at where the water will come from and where the glass stands, then draw a path, ramp or wall between them. When you finish drawing, the water flows and follows your lines. If it misses, try a new shape. A quick guide to the controls pops up when you begin.
tips: Short, simple lines often work better than big complicated shapes.
Draw walls to stop water from spilling over the sides.
Think about where the water will land before you draw.
Try a different idea if the same line keeps failing.

faq.q: How do you play Happy Glass?
faq.a: Draw lines to guide the water into the glass and fill it up.

faq.q: Is there only one way to solve a Happy Glass level?
faq.a: No, many levels can be solved in different ways, so you can be creative.

tanuki-sunset.summary:
Tanuki Sunset is a longboard racer where a raccoon rides a longboard down a seaside road. The road is generated as you go, and it is wrapped in a bright synthwave style full of sunset colors. Drifting around narrow corners is the heart of the game.

Scoring in Tanuki Sunset rewards a bit of daring. You collect Tanuki Bits to fill the Bonus Roulette Meter, catch air off ramps and skim close to walls and edges for near-miss bonuses. Cars and obstacles are on the road, so every close call is a small risk. The route takes you past mountains, busy city streets and sandy beaches on Sunset Island, and you can train to pull off tricks like riding backwards. It is a single-player game for the keyboard and mouse that suits kids who like speed, style and chasing big scores.
tanuki-sunset.how_to: Skate downhill, drift around corners and rack up a big score. Move with the WASD keys or the arrow keys. Drift with Space or a mouse button, and press Tab to pause and open the options. Collect Tanuki Bits, avoid cars and obstacles, and pass close to walls for extra points.
tips: Drift often; it helps you take tight corners and score.
Go after Tanuki Bits to fill the Bonus Roulette Meter.
Near misses give points, but do not cut it too close at first.
Watch for cars ahead and plan your line early.

faq.q: What are the controls in Tanuki Sunset?
faq.a: Move with WASD or the arrow keys, drift with Space or a mouse button and pause with Tab.

faq.q: What are Tanuki Bits?
faq.a: They are collectibles that fill your Bonus Roulette Meter.

candy-clicker-2.summary:
Candy Clicker 2 is a sweet and simple clicking game. Every click adds to your candy pile, and the pile just keeps growing. There is cheerful music in the background, and the whole game feels light and fun, like a candy shop that never closes.

The appeal of Candy Clicker 2 is how satisfying it is to watch your numbers go up. Clicker games are easy to start and nice to return to, and this one is all about building the biggest candy collection you can. Your aim is to become a true candy master. It does not need quick reflexes or tricky moves, which makes it a friendly choice for younger kids and for anyone who wants a relaxing game. Play for a few minutes or a little longer, and see how big your candy stash can get.
candy-clicker-2.how_to: Collect as much candy as you can by clicking. Each click adds candy to your total, so keep going to grow your collection. Look for anything you can spend your candy on to speed up your progress. The game shows its controls and options when it starts, so take a quick look at the first screen.
tips: Click at a steady pace instead of tiring your hand out.
Check the screen for ways to boost your candy earnings.
Short sessions are fine; your progress adds up over time.

faq.q: How do you play Candy Clicker 2?
faq.a: Click to collect candy and keep growing your total.

faq.q: Is Candy Clicker 2 good for young kids?
faq.a: Yes, it is simple, calm and does not need fast reactions.

football-legends.summary:
Football Legends is a sports game where you pick your favorite team and take part in a tournament. Only the strongest teams make it to the title, so every match counts. You control a player on the pitch and try to outscore your opponent.

The tournament gives Football Legends a clear goal, since each win brings you closer to the trophy. Matches are short and full of action, so it is easy to jump in for a quick game. You can face computer-controlled opponents and work on your skills as you go. It suits kids who love football and enjoy friendly competition. The game explains its controls when it starts, so you can learn them quickly before the first kickoff. If you like sports games with a bit of energy and a trophy to chase, Football Legends is a good pick.
football-legends.how_to: Choose a team, enter the tournament and win matches to reach the title. Control your player, get the ball and shoot it into the opponent's goal more times than they score in yours. Follow the instructions in the game, which show the controls at the start. Keep winning to move up through the tournament.
tips: Learn the controls in your first match before going for big shots.
Stay close to the ball so your opponent cannot grab it easily.
Try different teams to find one you enjoy.
Do not give up after one loss; practice helps a lot.

faq.q: How do you play Football Legends?
faq.a: Pick a team, control your player and score more goals than your opponent to win tournament matches.

faq.q: Where can I see the controls for Football Legends?
faq.a: The game shows the instructions and controls when it starts.

trap-adventure-2.summary:
Trap Adventure 2 is a tough retro platformer that loves to surprise you. There are 25 levels, and each one is packed with sneaky traps that are waiting for you to make a mistake. The pixel-style look seems friendly, but the challenge is anything but easy.

The fun of Trap Adventure 2 comes from learning. You will fall into traps you never saw coming, laugh, and then try again knowing what to expect. Little by little you memorize where the danger is and get further each time. Precision and fast reactions are a must, so it is best for kids who enjoy a real challenge and do not give up easily. Every finished level feels like a real win. If you like retro platformers and are ready for a few surprises, Trap Adventure 2 is a game that will test your patience in a fun way.
trap-adventure-2.how_to: Make it through all 25 levels by jumping, dodging and avoiding traps. Move carefully, because traps can appear when you least expect them. When you fail, remember where the trap was and plan a better path next time. A quick guide to the controls pops up when you begin, so check them on the first screen.
tips: Expect surprises; move slowly in new areas.
Remember where each trap was so you can avoid it next time.
Stay calm after a fail, since every try teaches you something.
Take a break if a level makes you frustrated, then come back fresh.

faq.q: How many levels does Trap Adventure 2 have?
faq.a: Trap Adventure 2 has 25 levels.

faq.q: Is Trap Adventure 2 hard?
faq.a: Yes, it is a very challenging platformer full of surprise traps.

helix-jump.summary:
Helix Jump is a fast arcade game about a bouncing ball and a tall, twisting tower. The ball bounces on platforms that spiral around the tower, and your job is to help it get all the way down. You do this by turning the tower so the ball can fall through the gaps.

The controls are simple enough to learn in seconds, but the tower is full of tricky sections. Dropping fast feels great, yet one bad move can end the run, so you need to stay focused all the way down. The bright visual effects make each fall look exciting. Helix Jump is great for quick sessions, and every new try is a chance to get deeper than before. It is played with the mouse and suits kids who like simple games that still test their timing and attention.
helix-jump.how_to: Guide the bouncing ball down through the helix tower. Use the mouse to turn the tower so that the gaps in the platforms line up under the ball. Let the ball fall through the openings and avoid the dangerous sections that end your run. Keep going to get as far down as you can.
tips: Turn the tower in small moves rather than big spins.
Look at the next platform before the ball lands.
Do not rush when the gaps are narrow.
Stay focused as you go lower, because mistakes cost the whole run.

faq.q: How do you play Helix Jump?
faq.a: Use the mouse to rotate the tower and let the bouncing ball fall through the gaps toward the bottom.

faq.q: Is Helix Jump easy to learn?
faq.a: Yes, it uses simple controls, but getting far down the tower takes practice.

volley-random.summary:
Volley Random brings the silly random-sports style to volleyball. Floppy ragdoll players bounce around the court, and you try to knock the ball onto the other side and make it land there. Because the physics are so wobbly, rallies can go in very funny directions.

Every match of Volley Random feels a little different. The court, the ball and even the players can change, so you have to adjust and still find a way to score. The controls are just one key per player, which makes it easy to start and fun to share. You can play against a friend on one device, and it also works on phones and tablets with touch controls. It is a quick, goofy sports game that suits kids who like laughing at chaotic moments while still trying to win.
volley-random.how_to: Score points by getting the ball to land on your opponent's side. Player 1 uses the W key and Player 2 uses the up arrow key; your key makes your players jump to hit the ball. On mobile devices and tablets, you can use touch controls. Watch the ball closely and time your jump so your players send it back over the net.
tips: Jump just as the ball comes near, not too early.
Adjust your timing when the court or ball changes.
Keep your eyes on the ball, not just your players.
When playing a friend, try to aim for the open space on their side.

faq.q: Can two players play Volley Random?
faq.a: Yes, Player 1 uses W and Player 2 uses the up arrow key on the same device.

faq.q: Can I play Volley Random on my phone?
faq.a: Yes, it works on phones and tablets with touch controls.

the-superhero-league.summary:
The Superhero League turns you into a hero on a puzzle adventure. Each level gives you a mission, and you need to think your way through it to save the day. It mixes superhero action with brain-teasing puzzles, so you get both excitement and a bit of strategy.

In The Superhero League, you guide your hero through a series of challenging levels. Each one asks you to choose the right path or the right move, so careful thinking matters more than fast clicking. As you clear more missions, your goal is to grow into the most powerful hero. The controls are as easy as a mouse click or a tap, which makes it simple to pick up on a computer or a touch screen. It is a good match for kids who like superheroes, puzzle levels and a little bit of planning.
the-superhero-league.how_to: Complete each mission by solving the puzzle in front of your hero. Click with the mouse or tap the screen to choose your moves. Look at the whole level first and think about which path or action will help your hero win. If a choice goes wrong, restart and try another way.
tips: Study the level before you make your first move.
Think about which option keeps your hero safe.
If you fail, try a different choice next time.
Take your time; there is often a trick to each puzzle.

faq.q: How do you play The Superhero League?
faq.a: Click or tap to guide your hero through puzzle missions and choose the right moves to win.

faq.q: Can I play The Superhero League on a touch screen?
faq.a: Yes, you can tap to play as well as use the mouse.

bartender-the-right-mix.summary:
Bartender: The Right Mix is a silly mixing game where you help Miguel the bartender put together the perfect drink. A shelf full of bottles is in front of you, and you choose which ones to combine and how much of each to pour. Extras like ice or lemon can finish the mix.

The challenge is getting the amounts right. Mixing in the wrong ratios, or combining things that do not go together, leads to some funny bad results. That makes Bartender: The Right Mix part puzzle and part experiment, as you test different combinations to see what works. It is a single-player game played with the mouse, and every round is short. Because the theme is a bar, it suits older kids best. If you enjoy games where you try things out and see what happens, this one has plenty of surprises.
bartender-the-right-mix.how_to: Mix a drink in the right amounts to make Miguel happy. Click to choose items from the shelf. Click and keep the button pressed to pour, and do the same to shake. Add ice or lemon if you like. Watch how much you pour from each bottle, because the wrong ratio or the wrong combination gives a bad result.
tips: Pour in short bursts so you do not overfill.
Try one change at a time to learn what works.
Think about the amounts, not just the ingredients.
Experiment with extras like ice or lemon.

faq.q: How do you play Bartender: The Right Mix?
faq.a: Click to pick ingredients, then press and hold the mouse button to pour and shake until the mix is right.

faq.q: What happens if I mix the wrong drinks?
faq.a: Using the wrong amounts or combinations leads to a bad result, so you can try again.

funny-shooter-2.summary:
Funny Shooter 2 is a first-person 3D shooter with a goofy twist. The enemies are creepy but comically designed, so the battles feel more cartoonish than serious. They come in waves, and each level brings fresh enemies, bosses, weapons and upgrades to keep you on your toes.

Your arsenal in Funny Shooter 2 is huge: pistols, rifles, shotguns, snipers, grenade launchers, bazookas and more, with skins to customize them. Completing achievements and challenges earns extra coins, which you can spend on skills such as more health, a magnet for coins and stronger grenades. The big goal is to defeat every boss. It is played with the keyboard and mouse, and since it is a shooter, it fits older kids best. If you like action games with lots of weapon choices and a silly style, this one has plenty to unlock.
funny-shooter-2.how_to: Survive the waves of enemies and beat every boss. Move with WASD, run with Shift and shoot with the left mouse button. Aim with the right mouse button and reload with R. Throw a grenade with G, switch weapons with the number keys 1 to 7 or the mouse wheel, and pause with Tab. Earn coins to upgrade your skills.
tips: Reload during quiet moments so you are ready for the next wave.
Use grenades on groups of enemies.
Spend coins on health early to survive longer.
Pick a weapon that fits the distance of the enemies.

faq.q: What are the controls in Funny Shooter 2?
faq.a: WASD moves, Shift runs, the left mouse button shoots, the right mouse button aims, R reloads and G throws a grenade.

faq.q: Can you upgrade in Funny Shooter 2?
faq.a: Yes, coins from achievements and challenges can improve skills such as health, the coin magnet and grenade power.

rocket-soccer-derby.summary:
Rocket Soccer Derby mixes soccer with car smashing. Instead of running players, you drive a boosted, demolition-style car around a football pitch and slam it into a giant ball to score goals. The car physics are bouncy and wild, which makes every goal feel like a stunt.

You can jump into a quick game or join the Rocket League competition. In the league, you collect in-game cash and cogs for car upgrades. Everyone begins in the Beginners League and can work up toward the Intermediate and Expert leagues. Nitro and jumps let you reach the ball in the air and surprise your opponent. Rocket Soccer Derby is played with the keyboard and also works on phones and tablets. It is a great pick for kids who love cars, football and fast, noisy matches where anything can happen.
rocket-soccer-derby.how_to: Drive your car into the ball and score more goals than your opponent. Drive with the WASD keys, use Left Shift for nitro and press Space to jump. Press F to change the camera. Play quick games for fun, or enter the league to collect cash and cogs for car upgrades and climb to higher leagues.
tips: Use nitro to reach the ball before your opponent.
Jump to hit high balls toward the goal.
Try different camera views with F to find the one you like.
Spend your earnings on upgrades before moving to a harder league.

faq.q: What are the controls in Rocket Soccer Derby?
faq.a: Drive with WASD, use Left Shift for nitro, Space to jump and F to change the camera.

faq.q: Can I play Rocket Soccer Derby on my phone?
faq.a: Yes, it works on phones and tablets as well as computers.

faq.q: What leagues are there in Rocket Soccer Derby?
faq.a: Players begin in the Beginners League and can move up to the Intermediate and Expert leagues.

bloons.summary:
Bloons is a colorful arcade game about a monkey with a handful of darts and a sky full of balloons. Your job is to help the monkey pop as many balloons as possible. It is simple to understand, which makes it a great pick for younger players.

The challenge in Bloons is all about aiming. Each throw needs the right angle and power to reach the balloons, and a good shot can pop several in a row. You will learn how the darts fly and get better with each try. The game sits in the arcade and puzzle families, so it mixes quick fun with a bit of thinking about where to aim. It is played with the mouse, and each level is short enough for a quick break. If you like games with clear goals and satisfying pops, Bloons is a cheerful choice.
bloons.how_to: Help the monkey pop the balloons by throwing darts at them. Hold the left mouse button to aim your throw, then release it to shoot the dart. Try to line up shots that pass through several balloons at once. Watch where your darts go and adjust your aim for the next throw.
tips: Look for lines of balloons you can pop with one dart.
Take your time to aim before you release.
Learn how far the dart flies at different angles.
Plan your first shot carefully, since it can open up the rest.

faq.q: How do you play Bloons?
faq.a: Hold the left mouse button to aim and release it to throw a dart at the balloons.

faq.q: Is Bloons good for kids?
faq.a: Yes, it is easy to understand and focuses on aiming and popping balloons.

draw-climber.summary:
Draw Climber is a drawing race with a funny problem to solve: a box wants to reach the finish line, but it has no legs. You draw a shape, and that shape becomes the legs that carry the box forward. Whatever you draw is what it walks or rolls on.

That makes Draw Climber a mix of puzzle and race. Some shapes move smoothly over flat ground, while others work better for climbing steps and bumps. Part of the fun is experimenting and seeing how your drawing behaves. You can keep trying different ideas until you find a shape that works well for the track. The publisher says it plays on smartphones and tablets as well as computers. It suits creative kids who enjoy drawing and seeing their ideas come to life in a silly, physics-based way.
draw-climber.how_to: Help the box reach the end of the track by drawing legs for it. Draw a shape, and the box will use it to move forward. If the box gets stuck or moves slowly, try a different shape. Experiment with sizes and forms to find what climbs best. The controls are shown right at the start.
tips: Try a simple round shape first to see how it moves.
Bigger shapes can help climb over tall obstacles.
If one shape gets stuck, draw a new one with a different form.
Watch how the box moves and adjust your drawing to match the ground.

faq.q: How do you play Draw Climber?
faq.a: Draw a shape that becomes the legs of a box, then watch it move toward the finish.

faq.q: Can I play Draw Climber on my phone?
faq.a: According to the publisher, it runs on smartphones and tablets as well as computers.

thief-puzzle.summary:
Thief Puzzle lets you play as a clever thief who solves problems with a swipe. Each level is a small scene with a goal to reach and obstacles in the way. Security systems and tricky setups stand between you and the prize, so you must think before you act.

The secret of Thief Puzzle is precision. You need to plan the right path, avoid danger and make your move at the right moment. Some levels look easy but hide a catch, so it pays to look carefully first. It is a puzzle game rather than an action game, which means you can take your time and think it through. Each level is quick, so it is easy to keep going. Thief Puzzle is a fun choice for kids who like brain teasers with a playful, sneaky theme and enjoy finding clever solutions.
thief-puzzle.how_to: Solve each level by guiding your thief past security and reaching the goal. Swipe to make your moves, choosing a path that avoids traps and alarms. Look at the whole level before you start, then act with care. If something goes wrong, restart and try another route. The controls appear on screen when the game begins.
tips: Study the level before making your first swipe.
Look for hidden dangers near the goal.
Try a different route if your first idea fails.
Precise swipes work better than rushed ones.

faq.q: How do you play Thief Puzzle?
faq.a: Swipe to guide the thief past security systems and reach the goal in each level.

faq.q: Is Thief Puzzle hard?
faq.a: Levels get trickier as you go and need careful planning, but each one is short.

sausage-flip.summary:
Sausage Flip is a goofy physics game where you toss a sausage through the air and try to land it on a fork. The sausage spins and flops in funny ways, so every flip is a little surprise. It sounds silly, and it is, but there is real skill in getting the landing right.

To clear a level in Sausage Flip, you just need to get the sausage onto the fork, lying down or standing up. To earn all three stars, though, you must do it in as few flips as possible, ideally one or two. That makes each level a fun puzzle about power and angle. The game is played by sliding or dragging, so it works with a mouse on a computer and with your finger on phones and tablets. It is perfect for short, playful sessions and for kids who like physics challenges.
sausage-flip.how_to: Flip the sausage so it lands on the fork. Slide or drag to set the direction and strength of each flip, then let go to launch it. The sausage can land lying down or standing up and still pass. For three stars, reach the fork in as few flips as you can, ideally one or two.
tips: Start with gentle flips to see how far the sausage travels.
Plan a route that reaches the fork in one or two flips for three stars.
Watch how the sausage spins and adjust your drag.
Use walls and platforms as stepping stones when needed.

faq.q: How do you get three stars in Sausage Flip?
faq.a: Land the sausage on the fork in as few flips as possible, ideally one or two.

faq.q: Can I play Sausage Flip on my phone?
faq.a: Yes, it works on phones and tablets as well as computers.

moto-x3m-winter.summary:
Moto X3M Winter takes the stunt-bike action of the series into a snowy holiday setting. You ride a dirt bike over icy tracks packed with ramps, explosives, traps and other obstacles, and your goal is to reach the finish line in one piece. It is fast, a little dangerous and full of jumps.

Speed is rewarded in Moto X3M Winter. Finish a level quickly enough and you earn three stars, and those stars unlock new riders. Front flips and backflips also give you extra seconds, so landing stunts is a smart way to improve your time. If you want to prove you are a real pro, try to earn three stars on every level. The game is played with the arrow keys and suits kids who love motorbikes, winter themes and racing against the clock. Each track takes a few tries to learn, which makes beating it feel even better.
moto-x3m-winter.how_to: Reach the finish line of each winter track as fast as you can without crashing. Use the arrow keys to speed up, slow down and tilt your bike in the air.
