Flip forward or backward during jumps to gain extra seconds, but make sure you land on your wheels. Finish fast to earn three stars and unlock new riders.
tips: Learn where the explosives and traps are before you go for speed.
Flip only when you have enough air to complete the turn.
Aim for three stars to unlock new riders.
Tilt your bike to match the slope before landing.

faq.q: How do you unlock riders in Moto X3M Winter?
faq.a: Finish levels fast enough to earn three stars, then use the stars to unlock new riders.

faq.q: What are the controls in Moto X3M Winter?
faq.a: You use the arrow keys to control your bike.

moto-x3m-pool-party.summary:
Moto X3M Pool Party is a sunny, summer-flavored version of the Moto X3M bike stunt racer. You ride a motorbike through a series of challenging levels, chasing high speed and trying not to crash along the way. The pool party theme gives everything a bright, splashy feel.

Like the rest of the series, Moto X3M Pool Party is about balance between being fast and being careful. The levels throw different challenges at you, so you have to learn each track before you can ride it well. Dangerous moments are part of the fun, and nailing a tricky jump feels great. The game uses the arrow keys, so it is easy to understand from the first try. It is a good choice for kids who like extreme sports, quick levels and a game that rewards practice. Play it in short bursts or try to beat every level in one go.
moto-x3m-pool-party.how_to: Ride through each level and get to the finish without crashing. Use the arrow keys to control your bike: speed up, slow down and lean forward or back to keep your balance. Watch the track ahead for jumps and obstacles. If you crash, try again and look for a smoother and faster way through.
tips: Slow down before tricky sections instead of crashing at full speed.
Keep your bike level when you land.
Replay levels to learn them and improve your time.
Watch for obstacles right after jumps.

faq.q: What are the controls in Moto X3M Pool Party?
faq.a: You control the bike with the arrow keys.

faq.q: Is Moto X3M Pool Party hard?
faq.a: The levels are challenging, but they get easier as you learn each track.

moto-pizza.summary:
Moto Pizza puts you on a delivery bike with hot pizzas to drop off. Customers are waiting, and your job is to ride through the streets and get each pizza to them quickly, before you are late. It is part racing game and part parking game, with a fun delivery theme.

Getting there is only half the job in Moto Pizza. When you reach the right place, you need to park your bike in the highlighted area on the road. Then you control the delivery boy on foot and walk the pizza to the customer's door. That mix of riding, careful parking and a short walk makes each delivery feel like a small mission. The game is played with the WASD keys or the arrow keys, and it suits kids who like driving games with a clear goal. Fast, neat deliveries are the key to doing well.
moto-pizza.how_to: Deliver each pizza to the customer as fast as you can. Ride your cargo bike with the WASD keys or the arrow keys and head to the highlighted parking area on the road. Park inside it, then move the delivery boy on foot to the customer's door to hand over the pizza. Try not to waste time, so you are never late.
tips: Slow down near the parking spot so you stop inside the highlighted area.
Plan the shortest route to the customer before you speed off.
Do not bump into things; it costs you time.
Walk straight to the door once you have parked.

faq.q: How do you play Moto Pizza?
faq.a: Ride your bike to the customer, park in the highlighted area and walk the pizza to the door.

faq.q: What keys do you use in Moto Pizza?
faq.a: You use the WASD keys or the arrow keys.

diggy.summary:
Diggy sends you deep under the surface of the Moon as an astronaut hunting for treasure. You dig down through the ground, collect valuable minerals and bring them back to improve your equipment. The deeper you go, the more there is to find.

The challenge in Diggy comes from its unusual controls, which take a little practice, and from the clock that keeps ticking while you explore. You need to decide how far to dig before time runs out and what to spend your earnings on. Each upgrade helps you reach deeper layers and gather more riches on your next trip. The game has an endless exploring feel, so there is always another layer to reach. It is an adventure game that suits kids who like digging, collecting and slowly getting stronger. The game shows the controls when you start.
diggy.how_to: Dig as deep as you can into the Moon and collect precious minerals. Steer your astronaut down through the ground, grab minerals along the way and keep an eye on the timer. Use the money from your finds to upgrade your gear so you can dig deeper next time. You will see the controls on the first screen, and they take a little getting used to.
tips: Practice the controls near the surface before going deep.
Watch the clock so you are not caught out.
Spend your earnings on upgrades that help you dig deeper.
Go for valuable minerals first when you see several at once.

faq.q: How do you play Diggy?
faq.a: Steer your astronaut down into the Moon, collect minerals before time runs out and buy gear upgrades.

faq.q: Are the controls in Diggy hard?
faq.a: They are a bit unusual, so it takes a short time to get used to them.

electric-man.summary:
Electric Man is a stickman fighting game where you battle a series of opponents using punches, kicks and combos. Before you start, you can choose your stickman's name and color and pick a difficulty: easy, normal or pro. That way the game fits beginners as well as experienced fighters.

A tutorial shows you the basic moves before your first real fight, which is helpful because Electric Man has more than one type of attack. There are quick moves for fast strikes and slow-motion moves that feel like something out of an action movie. Mixing both kinds is the key to winning against tougher opponents. The game is played on the keyboard and is a good fit for kids who enjoy action and fighting games with a cool style. Try the easy setting first, then move up when you feel ready.
electric-man.how_to: Defeat your opponents using punches, kicks and combos. Move your stickman with the arrow keys. Use A, S and D for quick moves, and Q, W and E for slow-motion moves. Start with the tutorial to learn the basics, then choose a difficulty level and fight. Mix up your attacks so opponents cannot easily block you.
tips: Do the tutorial first to learn all the moves.
Start on easy and move up to normal or pro later.
Combine quick moves with slow-motion moves for stronger combos.
Keep moving so opponents cannot corner you.

faq.q: What are the controls in Electric Man?
faq.a: Arrow keys move your fighter, A, S and D are quick moves and Q, W and E are slow-motion moves.

faq.q: Does Electric Man have difficulty levels?
faq.a: Yes, you can choose easy, normal or pro.

gold-miner.summary:
Gold Miner is a treasure-hunting puzzle made for kids. In each level, the ground is full of gold nuggets and jewels, and your task is to collect all of them. But be careful: barrels of gunpowder are hidden among the treasures, and you need to stay away from them.

The fun of Gold Miner is in planning your grabs. Some treasures are easy to reach, while others sit close to danger, so you need to think about the order you collect them in. Clearing a whole level without touching a barrel feels great. The game is played with the mouse on a computer or by tapping on phones and tablets, so it works almost anywhere. Its simple rules and calm pace make Gold Miner a nice pick for younger players, while the barrels add just enough challenge to keep older kids interested.
gold-miner.how_to: Collect all the gold nuggets and jewels in each level while avoiding the barrels of gunpowder. Use the mouse on a computer, or tap the screen on a phone or tablet. Look carefully at where each treasure is before you go for it, and pick an order that keeps you away from the barrels. Clear every treasure to finish the level.
tips: Grab the safe treasures first.
Look closely at what is near each jewel before you go for it.
Stay well away from gunpowder barrels.
Take your time; there is no need to rush.

faq.q: How do you play Gold Miner?
faq.a: Collect all the nuggets and jewels in each level while staying away from barrels of gunpowder.

faq.q: Can I play Gold Miner on my phone?
faq.a: Yes, it works on phones and tablets by tapping the screen.

drive-mad-2.summary:
Drive Mad 2 is a 3D driving adventure full of strange and dangerous tracks. You race a sports car across courses packed with traps and moving machines, from swinging sledgehammers to windmills and even bottles in your way. It is wild, a bit silly and very challenging.

Each track in Drive Mad 2 feels like a new puzzle on wheels. You need to figure out when to go fast, when to wait and how to get past each trap without wrecking your car. Timing is everything, especially with obstacles that move. The game is played with a mouse click or a tap, so the controls are simple, and the real challenge comes from reading the track. It is a good fit for kids who liked the first Drive Mad and anyone who enjoys crazy racing courses where every level brings something new.
drive-mad-2.how_to: Drive your car to the end of each track and get past all the traps. Click the mouse or tap the screen to drive. Watch moving obstacles like sledgehammers and windmills, and wait for the right moment before you go. If your car crashes or gets stuck, try the level again with a different timing.
tips: Watch how a trap moves before you drive into it.
Sometimes waiting a second is the fastest way through.
Drive slowly over bumpy or tricky parts.
Remember the tricky spots for your next try.

faq.q: How do you play Drive Mad 2?
faq.a: Click or tap to drive your car through tracks full of traps and reach the finish.

faq.q: Can I play Drive Mad 2 on a touch screen?
faq.a: Yes, you can tap to play as well as click with the mouse.

case-clicker.summary:
Case Clicker is a clicking and collecting game where every click brings you closer to opening another case. Inside the cases are colorful skins, and building up a big collection is the main goal. As you earn more, you can open more cases and grow your income.

There is more to Case Clicker than clicking. You can complete missions, climb ranks and make smart choices about where to put your earnings. Mini-games give you a chance to win extra rewards, which adds some variety. The game is a nice match for kids who like collecting and seeing their numbers rise over time. Because progress adds up, even short play sessions feel worthwhile. Case Clicker is played at your own pace, and the game shows its controls when it starts, so you can figure everything out quickly.
case-clicker.how_to: Click to earn, open cases and build your skin collection. Use your earnings wisely so your income grows faster. Finish missions to move up in rank, and try the mini-games for extra rewards. Keep collecting to make your collection bigger and better. The game explains its controls as soon as it starts.
tips: Complete missions for steady progress.
Think before you spend; some choices raise your income more than others.
Try the mini-games for extra rewards.
Check your collection to see which skins you still want.

faq.q: How do you play Case Clicker?
faq.a: Click to earn, open cases to collect skins, finish missions and move up in rank.

faq.q: Does Case Clicker have mini-games?
faq.a: Yes, it has mini-games that give extra rewards.

drift-bus.summary:
Drift Bus turns a big, heavy bus into a drifting machine. Instead of driving slowly around town, you slide around sharp corners at speed. The controls are about as simple as they get: tapping and holding sends your bus skidding through the turns.

The skill in Drift Bus is timing. Start your drift too early or too late and you will miss the corner, but get it right and your bus glides around in a smooth arc. Along the tracks you can collect coins and use them to unlock new buses. The aim is to reach a top score, so each run is a chance to do a little better than before. Drift Bus is a quick racing game that suits kids who like simple controls, fast turns and the satisfying feeling of a perfect drift.
drift-bus.how_to: Drift your bus around the corners of each track without crashing. Tap and hold to start a drift, then let go to straighten out. Time your drifts so the bus slides neatly around each turn. Collect coins along the way and use them to unlock new buses. Try to beat your top score on every run.
tips: Start your drift just before the corner, not after it.
Let go once the bus is pointing the right way.
Pick up coins when they are on your racing line.
Practice on easy corners to learn the timing.

faq.q: How do you drift in Drift Bus?
faq.a: Tap and hold to make your bus skid around a corner, then let go to straighten out.

faq.q: Can you unlock buses in Drift Bus?
faq.a: Yes, you collect coins and use them to unlock new buses.

moto-x3m-spooky-land.summary:
Moto X3M: Spooky Land is a Halloween-style ride through the stunt-bike world of Moto X3M. The tracks are dark and creepy, with spooky decorations and obstacles that can throw you off your bike. Your job is to ride fast, pull off stunts and make it through each level in one piece.

The stunts in Moto X3M: Spooky Land can feel almost gravity-defying, so landing them takes careful balance. Speed matters, and riding well lets you unlock new creepy gear. The spooky theme is more fun than frightening, so it suits kids who enjoy Halloween vibes and fast motorbike levels. Each track has its own set of hazards to learn, and getting through a hard level after a few tries feels great. If you enjoy racing against yourself and trying again until you nail a run, this is a fun pick.
moto-x3m-spooky-land.how_to: Ride through each spooky track and reach the finish as fast as you can. Keep your bike balanced over jumps, dodge the obstacles and try not to crash. Do stunts when you have enough air and land on your wheels. The controls appear on screen when the game begins, so check the first screen before you ride.
tips: Learn each track slowly before trying to go fast.
Land on both wheels to avoid crashing.
Watch out for obstacles placed right after jumps.
Replay levels to unlock new gear.

faq.q: What is Moto X3M: Spooky Land?
faq.a: It is a Halloween-themed motorbike stunt racer with spooky tracks and obstacles.

faq.q: Can you unlock things in Moto X3M: Spooky Land?
faq.a: Yes, riding well lets you unlock new creepy gear.

gun-mayhem-2.summary:
Gun Mayhem 2 is a chaotic platform fighter where the goal is to knock your opponents off the stage. You can shoot them, blast them with dynamite or push them over the edge before they do the same to you. Every round is fast, loud and full of surprises.

There are several ways to play Gun Mayhem 2. A single-player campaign takes you through a set of battles, custom games let you set up your own matches, and a list of challenges tests your skills. Before you play, you can customize your character's look, including shirt, hat and face, and choose perks and a weapon. Each player has a primary and a secondary weapon, so you can switch tactics in the middle of a fight. It is played on the keyboard and suits older kids who like action games with simple cartoon-style characters.
gun-mayhem-2.how_to: Knock your enemies off the platforms to win. As Player 1, move with the arrow keys, use Z for your primary weapon and X for your secondary weapon. Choose a game mode first, then customize your character's look, perks and weapon. Keep moving so you are not pushed off the edge yourself, and watch where your shots push your rivals.
tips: Stay away from the edges unless you are attacking.
Switch between your primary and secondary weapon as the fight changes.
Try different perks to find one that suits your style.
Use dynamite when enemies are grouped together.

faq.q: What modes does Gun Mayhem 2 have?
faq.a: You can play a single-player campaign, set up custom games or take on challenges.

faq.q: Can I customize my character in Gun Mayhem 2?
faq.a: Yes, you can change the shirt, hat and face, plus perks and weapon.

the-impossible-game.summary:
The Impossible Game is a rhythm-based platformer that lives up to its name. You leap, fly and flip through narrow passages filled with spikes and other dangers. One small mistake sends you back, so the game is all about precision and patience.

What makes The Impossible Game special is its rhythm. The obstacles line up with the beat, so you can feel when to jump instead of only seeing it. After a few tries, you start to learn the patterns and get farther each time. It is very challenging, which is exactly why reaching a new part feels so rewarding. The controls are as simple as using the mouse, and the game also works on phones and tablets. It is a great pick for kids who love tough challenges, music-based games and never giving up until they beat a level.
the-impossible-game.how_to: Get through each level without hitting spikes or falling. Use the mouse to make your character jump and fly at the right moment. Listen to the rhythm, because obstacles often match the beat. When you crash, start again and try to remember where the dangers are. Keep practicing to get farther each time.
tips: Listen to the music; it helps you time your jumps.
Learn the level in small parts instead of all at once.
Stay calm after a crash and try again right away.
Do not jump too early; wait for the right moment.

faq.q: Can I play The Impossible Game on my phone?
faq.a: Yes, it works on phones and tablets as well as computers.

faq.q: Is The Impossible Game really impossible?
faq.a: No, but it is very hard. With practice you can learn the patterns and get much farther.

exhibit-of-sorrows.summary:
Exhibit of Sorrows is a point-and-click adventure set in a strange circus exhibit. It looks whimsical at first, with clowns and colorful displays, but the deeper you go, the more unsettling it becomes. Curiosity pulls you forward, yet poking around too much might cause surprises.

The game sits in the horror category, so it is designed to be a little creepy. You explore each scene, look around carefully and choose what to click on, thinking about what might happen next. Caution is part of the challenge, since not every choice is a safe one. Exhibit of Sorrows is best for older kids who enjoy spooky stories and mystery games, and younger players may find it too eerie. If you like slow, thoughtful exploring and a good mystery, this one will keep you curious. The game shows its controls when it starts.
exhibit-of-sorrows.how_to: Explore the strange circus exhibit and uncover what is going on. Click on objects and areas to look around and move through the story. Think before you click, because your curiosity can trigger unexpected events. Take your time with each scene and pay attention to small details. The game explains its controls as soon as it starts.
tips: Look carefully at every part of a scene before clicking.
Be cautious with choices that seem risky.
Pay attention to small details; they may matter later.
Play with the lights on if you get spooked easily.

faq.q: What kind of game is Exhibit of Sorrows?
faq.a: It is a point-and-click horror adventure set in a creepy circus exhibit.

faq.q: Is Exhibit of Sorrows scary?
faq.a: It is meant to be eerie and unsettling, so it suits older kids better than young ones.

winter-clash-3d.summary:
Winter Clash 3D is an online team shooter with a holiday story. Evil elves want to take over Santa's secret place and summon the Pagan Idol, and it is up to your team to stop them. You play as a mighty Santa, grab your gun and head into battle.

The big mission in Winter Clash 3D is to grab the Pagan Idol from an empty island with a lighthouse and carry it to the Christmas fire. Along the way you face other players, so teamwork and good aim make a big difference. The snowy maps and holiday theme give it a festive look even in the middle of the action. It is a multiplayer game played with the keyboard and mouse, and since it is a shooter, it fits older kids best. If you like team battles with a fun seasonal twist, this one is worth a try.
winter-clash-3d.how_to: Work with your team to capture the Pagan Idol and win the match. Move with the WASD keys, jump with Space and crouch with C. Aim with the right mouse button. Press Tab to see the score table. Stay with your teammates, use cover and push toward the lighthouse island to grab the Idol.
tips: Crouch behind cover when enemies are nearby.
Stick close to your teammates during attacks.
Check the score table with Tab to see how your team is doing.
Aim with the right mouse button for more accurate shots.

faq.q: Is Winter Clash 3D multiplayer?
faq.a: Yes, it is an online team shooter where you play against other players.

faq.q: What are the controls in Winter Clash 3D?
faq.a: WASD moves, Space jumps, C crouches, the right mouse button aims and Tab shows the score table.

stickman-warriors.summary:
Stickman Warriors is a fighting RPG where you train a stickman hero and battle your way up the ranks. Your opponents include powerful Saints, and beating them is how you climb toward the top. The final goal is to reach S rank and become the strongest stickman warrior of all.

Because it is an RPG, Stickman Warriors is not only about button speed. Your stickman has different attributes, and choosing how to improve them is a big part of your strategy. Daily rewards help you grow stronger over time, so returning regularly pays off. Each battle tests both your fighting skills and your planning. It is an action and fighting game that suits kids who like stickman heroes, leveling up and working toward a big goal step by step. The game shows its controls when you start.
stickman-warriors.how_to: Fight your way up the ranks and reach S rank. Battle opponents, including the powerful Saints, and win to climb higher. Improve your stickman's attributes to match your fighting style, and collect daily rewards to get stronger. You will see the controls on the first screen, so check them before your first fight.
tips: Collect your daily rewards to grow faster.
Focus on attributes that fit how you like to fight.
Do not rush into tough opponents before you are ready.
Learn your opponents' moves and adapt your plan.

faq.q: What is the goal in Stickman Warriors?
faq.a: Climb the ranks by winning battles and reach the top S rank.

faq.q: Does Stickman Warriors have daily rewards?
faq.a: Yes, there are daily rewards that help you get stronger.

bubble-hit.summary:
Bubble Hit is a physics-based aiming game with 28 levels to clear. You toss stones at colorful bubbles and try to pop them all. Sounds simple, but there is a catch: black bubbles are dangerous, and you need to avoid hitting them.

Each level of Bubble Hit is a little puzzle about angles and power. The stones bounce and fly with real physics, so a clever shot can pop several bubbles at once. As you go, the challenge grows, and your aim needs to get sharper. Popping bubbles also earns coins, which help you reach a better score. The bright, cheerful visuals make it a friendly pick for kids, and the levels are short, so you can play a few at a time. Bubble Hit is a good choice for anyone who likes aiming games that make you think. A quick guide to the controls pops up when you begin.
bubble-hit.how_to: Pop all the colorful bubbles in each level by throwing stones at them. Aim carefully and think about how the stone will fly and bounce. Avoid the black bubbles, which are dangerous. Collect coins as you pop bubbles to raise your score. A quick guide to the controls pops up when you begin, so check the first screen before playing.
tips: Look for shots that can pop several bubbles at once.
Keep well away from the black bubbles.
Think about bounces before you throw.
Replay levels to collect more coins and improve your score.

faq.q: How many levels does Bubble Hit have?
faq.a: Bubble Hit has 28 levels.

faq.q: What should I avoid in Bubble Hit?
faq.a: Avoid the black bubbles, because they are dangerous.

aquapark-io.summary:
Aquapark.io is a summery water slide race. You and other racers zoom down twisting slides in water parks from around the world, and the goal is to reach the bottom first. It is fast, splashy and packed with fun bumps.

The best part of Aquapark.io is that crashing into your rivals is allowed. You can bump other sliders out of the way, and they can do the same to you, so every race is a bit of a pushing match. Choosing your line on the slide matters too, since staying in the slide is important. Picking the right moment to pass someone can win the race. The game is played with the mouse only, making it easy to start, and each race is short. It is a cheerful, arcade-style game that suits kids who love summer, water parks and fast, playful competition.
aquapark-io.how_to: Race down the water slide and try to be the first to reach the finish. Use the mouse to steer left and right as you slide. Bump into other racers to push them aside, and avoid getting knocked out yourself. Stay on the slide and pick a smart line through the curves.
tips: Steer smoothly through the curves to keep your speed.
Bump rivals when they are next to you near an edge.
Do not steer too hard or you might fly off.
Keep an eye on racers behind you who may try to push you.

faq.q: How do you play Aquapark.io?
faq.a: Steer with the mouse down water slides, bump other racers and try to finish first.

faq.q: Can you crash into other players in Aquapark.io?
faq.a: Yes, smashing and crashing into opponents is part of the game.

boxing-random.summary:
Boxing Random is a goofy boxing game where the rules keep changing. Each round brings something new: sometimes the boxers have extra-long arms, sometimes the ring is icy, and sometimes punches fly like rockets. You never know what is coming next, which is part of the fun.

To score in Boxing Random, you land punches on your opponent's head. The first fighter to reach five points wins. The controls are just one key per player, so it is easy for anyone to jump in, but timing your punches still takes skill. You can play against a friend on the same device, which makes it a great pick for siblings or friends sitting together. It also works on phones and tablets with touch controls. Boxing Random is short, silly and full of surprises, perfect for quick matches and lots of laughs.
boxing-random.how_to: Land punches on your opponent's head to score, and be the first to reach five points. Player 1 uses the W key and Player 2 uses the up arrow key. On mobile devices and tablets, use touch controls. Each round has a new twist, so watch how your boxer moves and time your presses to hit your rival.
tips: Time your punches instead of pressing nonstop.
Adjust to each round's twist, like icy floors or long arms.
Aim for the head; that is how you score.
Watch your rival's rhythm and punch when they are open.

faq.q: Can two players play Boxing Random?
faq.a: Yes, Player 1 uses W and Player 2 uses the up arrow key on one device.

faq.q: How do you win in Boxing Random?
faq.a: Score by punching your opponent's head; the first to five points wins.

faq.q: Can I play Boxing Random on a tablet?
faq.a: Yes, it supports touch controls on phones and tablets.

scary-maze-game.summary:
Scary Maze Game drops you into a dark labyrinth full of zombies. You need to find your way through narrow, twisting halls while the undead close in. Ammo is limited, so every shot matters and you cannot waste bullets.

The tension in Scary Maze Game comes from the tight spaces and the need to think before you act. Should you fight or find another path? Each choice can decide whether you make it out. The game asks for quick thinking and precise aim, and it has a spooky mood that fits players who enjoy a bit of suspense. Because of its zombie theme, it is better suited to older kids than to young players. If you like mazes, survival challenges and games where planning matters as much as reflexes, this could be a good fit. The game shows its controls when it starts.
scary-maze-game.how_to: Find your way out of the zombie-filled maze and survive. Move carefully through the halls, deal with zombies that block your way and save ammo whenever you can. Think about which path to take, since some routes may be safer than others. The controls are shown right at the start, so look at the first screen before you begin.
tips: Do not waste ammo on zombies you can avoid.
Move slowly around corners.
Try to remember the paths you have already taken.
Take a breath and plan your next move when it gets tense.

faq.q: What is Scary Maze Game about?
faq.a: You explore a dark maze full of zombies, use limited ammo wisely and try to escape alive.

faq.q: Is Scary Maze Game scary?
faq.a: It has a spooky zombie theme and suspense, so it suits older kids better.

penalty-shooters-3.summary:
Penalty Shooters 3 is a soccer game focused on the most nerve-racking moment in football: the penalty shootout. You take turns shooting at the goal and diving to save your opponent's shots. Every kick is a one-on-one battle between shooter and goalkeeper.

Timing and precision decide who wins in Penalty Shooters 3. You need to place your shots well and react quickly when it is your turn in goal. Strategic power-ups add an extra twist, giving you a boost when you use them at the right moment. There is also a clock to keep in mind, so you cannot think forever. Win enough shootouts and you can become the champion. It is a sports game that suits kids who love football and enjoy quick, intense matches. The game shows its controls when it starts, so you can learn them before the first kick.
penalty-shooters-3.how_to: Win penalty shootouts by scoring goals and stopping your opponent's shots. When you shoot, aim carefully and time your kick. When you are in goal, react quickly to block the ball. Use power-ups at good moments and keep an eye on the clock. The game explains its controls as soon as it starts.
tips: Mix up where you aim so the goalkeeper cannot guess.
Save power-ups for important kicks.
Watch the ball closely when you are in goal.
Do not wait too long; the clock is ticking.

faq.q: How do you play Penalty Shooters 3?
faq.a: Take turns shooting penalties and saving shots, using timing and power-ups to win.

faq.q: Does Penalty Shooters 3 have power-ups?
faq.a: Yes, strategic power-ups can help you score and block.

speedy-golf.summary:
Speedy Golf is a quick golf game that lets you finish all 18 holes of a par 72 course within a few minutes. It is made for short sessions, with easy controls and smooth 3D graphics. There is even a caddy who does the math for you.

The controls in Speedy Golf are built around taps. You aim with the left and right arrows on the screen, then tap three times to swing. The caddy suggests what to do, but be warned: the advice is not always the best, so sometimes you should trust your own judgment. You can play in portrait or landscape mode. Speedy Golf is a single-player game with a relaxed pace that fits kids who want to try golf without long, slow rounds. It is a fun way to learn the basics of aiming and power.
speedy-golf.how_to: Play all 18 holes and try to finish with a great score. Tap the on-screen left and right arrows to line up your shot. Then tap three times to swing and hit the ball. Listen to the caddy's suggestions, but think for yourself, because the advice is not always perfect. Try to get the ball in the hole with as few shots as possible.
tips: Check your aim before you start the swing.
Do not always follow the caddy; use your own judgment.
Practice the three-tap swing to get a steady rhythm.
Fewer shots per hole means a better score.

faq.q: How do you swing in Speedy Golf?
faq.a: Aim with the left and right arrows, then tap three times to swing.

faq.q: How long is a round of Speedy Golf?
faq.a: A full round of 18 holes on a par 72 course takes only a few minutes.

papas-burgeria.summary:
Papa's Burgeria puts you in charge of a busy burger restaurant. You write down orders, cook patties on the grill, pile on toppings and sauces, and serve each burger to your wacky customers. The trick is moving between the different stations so every order is ready on time and made just right.

As the days go by in Papa's Burgeria, customers get pickier and the line gets longer. You need to juggle grilling, building and serving while keeping an eye on the lobby. Good burgers earn tips, and you can spend them on restaurant upgrades, such as items that make waiting easier or keep burgers warm, as well as hats and furniture. A customer book even shows the preferences of your regulars. It is played with the mouse and is a great pick for kids who like cooking, time management and building up their own little restaurant.
papas-burgeria.how_to: Make burgers exactly the way customers order them. Use the left mouse button to select, drag and move ingredients. Take the order, put patties on the grill and flip them so they cook just right. Add the toppings and sauces from the ticket, then serve the burger. After each level, spend your tips on upgrades.
tips: Check the order ticket before you start building.
Do not leave patties on the grill too long.
Spend tips on upgrades that help with busy days.
Check the customer book to learn what regulars like.

faq.q: How do you play Papa's Burgeria?
faq.a: Take orders, grill and flip patties, add toppings and serve burgers to earn tips.

faq.q: What can you buy in Papa's Burgeria?
faq.a: You can spend tips on restaurant upgrades, hats and furniture for the lobby.

dta-6.summary:
DTA 6 is a chaotic sandbox adventure where you decide what happens. You explore a surreal city full of floppy ragdoll characters who talk in memes, gather weapons and cause all kinds of mayhem. There is no strict path to follow, so your own imagination sets the rules.

The ragdoll style makes everything in DTA 6 wobble and fall in funny ways, and controlling your character's limbs is part of the challenge. You can wander, experiment and see what silly situations you can create. It is an open, goofy game rather than a serious one. Because it includes weapons and over-the-top action, it is best suited to older kids. If you enjoy sandbox games where you set your own goals and laugh at unexpected physics, DTA 6 offers a lot of freedom. The game shows its controls when it starts.
dta-6.how_to: There is no single goal in DTA 6; you explore the city and create your own fun. Move around, collect weapons and interact with the ragdoll characters. Practice controlling your character, since the floppy limbs can be tricky at first. The controls appear on screen when the game begins, so look at the first screen before you begin.
tips: Spend a few minutes just learning how your character moves.
Explore different parts of the city to find new things.
Set yourself small goals to keep things interesting.
Do not worry about falling over; it is part of the fun.

faq.q: What kind of game is DTA 6?
faq.a: It is a ragdoll sandbox adventure where you explore a city and make your own fun.

faq.q: Is there a goal in DTA 6?
faq.a: Not a fixed one; it is a sandbox, so you choose what to do.

chicken-scream.summary:
Chicken Scream is a platformer you control with your voice. Instead of pressing keys, you make sounds, and a lively little chicken reacts to how loud you are. A soft whisper makes it walk gently forward, while a big shout sends it leaping into the air.

That unusual idea makes Chicken Scream very funny to play, especially with family or friends nearby. Getting past obstacles means finding the right volume at the right moment, and the challenges get harder as you go. Shout too early and you might jump into trouble; whisper too long and you may not make it across a gap. It is a playful way to practice control, and it usually ends with lots of laughter. Since the game listens through a microphone, your browser will likely ask for permission before you start. It is a great pick for kids who want something different from a normal platformer.
chicken-scream.how_to: Guide the chicken past the obstacles using only your voice. Speak quietly or whisper to make the chicken walk forward, and shout to make it jump. The louder you are, the bigger the jump. Allow microphone access when your browser asks, then find the right volume for each obstacle and keep the chicken moving.
tips: Try a few quiet and loud sounds first to see how the chicken reacts.
Use short shouts for small jumps and longer ones for big gaps.
Play in a quiet room so background noise does not move the chicken.
Keep a steady whisper to walk without jumping by accident.

faq.q: How do you control Chicken Scream?
faq.a: You use your voice: whisper to walk and shout to jump.

faq.q: Does Chicken Scream need a microphone?
faq.a: Yes, the game reacts to your voice, so you need a microphone and must allow access in your browser.

cut-the-rope-2.summary:
Cut the Rope 2 continues the candy-chasing story of Om Nom, the little green creature with a big sweet tooth. This time Om Nom is not alone, because his brothers are hungry too. Your mission is the same tasty one: cut the ropes so the candy ends up in the right mouth.

Each level in Cut the Rope 2 is a small physics puzzle. The candy hangs and swings from ropes, and you need to choose when and where to cut so it drops just right. Slicing at the wrong moment can send it flying off the screen, so patience pays off. The game uses slide and tap controls, which feel natural on touch screens. It is a calm puzzle game that suits kids who enjoyed the first Cut the Rope, as well as anyone who likes cute characters and brain-teasing levels that can be solved in a few minutes.
cut-the-rope-2.how_to: Feed the candy to Om Nom and his brothers in every level. Slide across a rope to cut it, and tap when the game asks you to interact with an object. Watch how the candy swings and pick the right moment to cut so it falls toward the hungry mouth. If it misses, restart and try a different order.
tips: Watch the swing of the candy before making the first cut.
Plan the order of cuts when several ropes are holding the candy.
Restart quickly if the candy goes the wrong way.
Try a different timing if the same plan keeps failing.

faq.q: How do you play Cut the Rope 2?
faq.a: Slide to cut ropes and tap to interact, so the candy drops into Om Nom's mouth.

faq.q: Who do you feed in Cut the Rope 2?
faq.a: You feed Om Nom and his brothers.

soccer-dash.summary:
Soccer Dash is a puzzle twist on football. Instead of running around a big pitch, you plan each kick through levels full of obstacles. Every swipe matters, because the right path is what gets the ball into the net.

The coolest part of Soccer Dash is its slow-motion kicks. They give you time to think and plan your next move while the action is paused in the air. That makes the game feel like a mix of sports and maze solving: you look at the level, figure out the route and then put it into action. Quirky animations keep things fun, and each level brings a fresh idea to solve. It is a great fit for kids who like football but also enjoy games that make them think. The game shows its controls when it starts, so you can begin right away.
soccer-dash.how_to: Score a goal in each level by planning your kicks around the obstacles. Swipe to send the ball in the direction you want. Use the slow-motion moments to think about the next move before you make it. Find the path that avoids blockers and leads to the goal. The controls are shown right at the start.
tips: Use the slow-motion time to plan, not just to react.
Look at the whole level before your first swipe.
Try a different route if one path keeps getting blocked.
Short, careful swipes are easier to control.

faq.q: How do you play Soccer Dash?
faq.a: Swipe to kick the ball, use slow-motion moments to plan and steer around obstacles to score.

faq.q: Is Soccer Dash a sports game or a puzzle?
faq.a: It is both: a football theme with maze-like puzzle levels.

road-of-the-dead.summary:
Road of the Dead is a racing game with a horror twist. You drive across a wasteland overrun by zombies, trying to survive while the undead swarm the road. Speed helps, but keeping your vehicle in one piece matters even more.

The danger in Road of the Dead keeps rising as you go, so you need to adapt quickly. Dodging zombies is key, and every hit takes a toll on your vehicle's health. That makes each drive a balance between going fast and driving smart. The controls are simple, so you can focus on reacting to what appears in front of you. Because of the zombie theme, it suits older kids who enjoy a bit of spooky action. If you like racing games where survival is the main goal, this one offers plenty of tense moments. The game shows its controls when it starts.
road-of-the-dead.how_to: Drive through the zombie-filled wasteland and survive as long as you can. Steer around the undead, keep your vehicle's health from running out and react to the growing danger. Do not just race; drive carefully so you avoid damage. You will see the controls on the first screen, so check them before you hit the road.
tips: Dodge zombies instead of driving straight through them.
Keep an eye on your vehicle's health.
Slow down a little when the road gets crowded.
Look ahead so you can steer early.

faq.q: What is Road of the Dead about?
faq.a: You drive through a zombie-infested wasteland and try to survive while keeping your vehicle intact.

faq.q: Is Road of the Dead scary?
faq.a: It has a horror and zombie theme, so it fits older kids better.

color-lines.summary:
Color Lines is a block puzzle where you arrange bright, colorful pieces on a grid. When you complete a line, it clears and frees up space for more blocks. The idea is easy to understand, but the board can fill up quickly if you do not plan ahead.

What keeps Color Lines interesting is the rising challenge. Each move can make things easier or harder later, so thinking a few steps ahead is the key skill. You will start to notice patterns and learn where certain pieces fit best. The colorful look makes it pleasant to play, and there is no rush, so you can take your time with each decision. According to the publisher, it works across devices, so you can play on a computer, phone or tablet. Color Lines is a great choice for kids who enjoy calm, thoughtful puzzles and the satisfying moment when a full line disappears.
color-lines.how_to: Place the blocks on the grid to complete full lines and clear them. Each cleared line frees space for more pieces. Plan ahead so you always have room for the next block, and avoid leaving awkward gaps. Keep going for as long as you can to get a high score. The controls are shown right at the start.
tips: Keep some open space for bigger pieces.
Finish lines that are almost full first.
Avoid leaving single empty squares.
Think one or two moves ahead.

faq.q: How do you play Color Lines?
faq.a: Place blocks on the grid to complete lines, which then clear to make room.

faq.q: Can I play Color Lines on a phone?
faq.a: According to the publisher, it works across devices, including phones and tablets.

heart-box.summary:
Heart Box is a puzzle adventure starring a lovable robot. Each level is a little machine of moving parts, boxes and objects, and you need to use them cleverly to help the robot get through. The answers are rarely obvious, so you will need to experiment.

The fun of Heart Box comes from playing with physics. You move and use objects in the level to open paths and solve problems, and each new stage adds fresh ideas to figure out. The bright graphics make it pleasant to look at while you think. It is a great pick for kids who like puzzle games that reward curiosity and creative thinking. You can take your time, try things out and learn from each attempt. When you finally see how a level works, it feels very satisfying. The game shows its controls when it starts.
heart-box.how_to: Help the robot solve each level by using the objects around it. Look at what can be moved or used, then try different ideas to clear a path. Physics plays a big role, so watch how things fall, roll or push. If something does not work, restart and try another approach. The controls are shown right at the start.
tips: Look at every object in the level before you start.
Test your ideas; it is okay to fail and try again.
Watch how objects move to learn the physics.
Think about the order you use things in.

faq.q: What is Heart Box about?
faq.a: You help a lovable robot solve physics puzzles by using objects in each level.

faq.q: Is Heart Box good for kids?
faq.a: Yes, it is a friendly puzzle game that encourages curiosity and creative thinking.

sandwich-runner.summary:
Sandwich Runner is a food-filled running game with a hungry customer to feed. You dash along paths packed with tasty treats, collecting the good stuff and dodging anything spoiled. The better your haul, the happier your diner.

The paths in Sandwich Runner get trickier as you go, so you need sharp steering to grab the right food and avoid the bad bits. Fiery power-ups add a burst of excitement, and quirky animations make each run feel lively. It is a casual game, so it is easy to understand and quick to play, with short runs that are perfect for breaks. The bright, silly style suits younger players, while the rising challenge keeps older kids interested. If you like runner games with a fun food theme, Sandwich Runner is a tasty choice. The game shows its controls when it starts.
sandwich-runner.how_to: Run along the path and collect tasty food for the hungry diner. Steer to grab the good treats and avoid spoiled ones. Pick up power-ups when you see them for an extra boost. The paths get harder as you go, so stay focused. The controls appear on screen when the game begins, so check the first screen.
tips: Look ahead to spot spoiled food early.
Grab power-ups when they are easy to reach.
Do not chase every treat if it means hitting something bad.
Keep your movements smooth and controlled.

faq.q: How do you play Sandwich Runner?
faq.a: Run along the path, collect good food, avoid spoiled food and use power-ups.

faq.q: Is Sandwich Runner easy?
faq.a: It starts simple but gets harder as the paths become more challenging.

my-parking-lot.summary:
My Parking Lot is a traffic puzzle where the cars are stuck and it is your job to get them out. The lot is packed, and each car needs a clear path to the exit. Move them in the wrong order and they bump into each other.

The challenge in My Parking Lot is planning. You look at how the cars are arranged, find which one can leave first and work your way through the jam. Drag controls make it simple to move cars, so all your focus goes into thinking. As you progress, the puzzles get more complex, with more cars and trickier layouts. It is a calm brain game that suits kids who enjoy logic puzzles and the satisfying feeling of clearing a messy board. Each level is a short mental workout, so it is easy to play a few in a row.
my-parking-lot.how_to: Clear the parking lot by getting every car out without crashes. Drag a car to send it toward an exit, but first make sure its path is free. Start with cars that are not blocked, then move the others once space opens up. The puzzles get harder as you go, so plan before every move.
tips: Find the car that can leave without hitting anything and start there.
Look at the whole lot before your first move.
If you are stuck, think about which car blocks the most others.
Restart if a level goes wrong rather than forcing it.

faq.q: How do you play My Parking Lot?
faq.a: Drag cars toward the exits in the right order so none of them collide.

faq.q: Does My Parking Lot get harder?
faq.a: Yes, the puzzles become more complex as you progress.

brainrot-merge-2.summary:
Brainrot Merge is a silly merging game full of odd creatures. You drop them into a space, and when two of the same kind touch, they merge into a new and even stranger hybrid. Each merge brings a surprise, so part of the fun is seeing what comes next.

The physics in Brainrot Merge make things bounce, roll and pile up in funny ways. You need to think about where to drop each creature so matching ones can meet, while keeping the space from getting too crowded. It is easy to start but takes a bit of planning to do well. The absurd humor makes it a light, goofy game for short brain breaks. Kids who like merging games, odd characters and a little chaos will feel right at home. The game shows its controls when it starts, so you can figure out how to drop the creatures quickly.
brainrot-merge-2.how_to: Drop creatures and merge matching ones into new, stranger hybrids. Choose where to drop each creature so it can land next to its twin. When two of the same kind touch, they combine. Keep the space from filling up by merging often and planning your drops. A quick guide to the controls pops up when you begin.
tips: Drop creatures near matching ones to merge them quickly.
Keep bigger creatures on one side to leave room.
Think about how things will bounce before you drop.
Do not let the space get too full.

faq.q: How do you play Brainrot Merge?
faq.a: Drop creatures and let matching ones touch so they merge into new hybrids.

faq.q: Is Brainrot Merge a puzzle game?
faq.a: Yes, it is a physics merging puzzle with a silly, absurd theme.

grand-prix-hero.summary:
Grand Prix Hero is a racing game that takes you across several continents in a big Grand Prix series. You speed down busy roads, weave through traffic and try to finish each race strong. Along the way you collect coins, which help you improve your car before the following race.

Boosting at high speed is a big part of Grand Prix Hero, but so is staying alert, because traffic can appear quickly. Upgrades make your car better as you go, so each race feels like a step toward becoming the true Grand Prix Hero. The controls are simple: arrow keys or WASD on a computer, and touch steering on phones and tablets. It is a fast, fun arcade racer that suits kids who love cars and want quick races they can pick up anywhere. Each new race gives you another chance to collect more coins and climb higher.
grand-prix-hero.how_to: Race through every stage of the Grand Prix series, weave around traffic and pick up coins as you go. On a computer, steer with the arrow keys or WASD. On phones and tablets, use touch to steer. Boost when the road is clear, then spend your coins on car upgrades before the following race.
tips: Boost only when you have room ahead.
Grab coins along your path but do not crash for them.
Upgrade your car between races.
Watch traffic early and change lanes in time.

faq.q: Can I play Grand Prix Hero on my phone?
faq.a: Yes, it works on phones and tablets with touch steering.

faq.q: What are the controls in Grand Prix Hero?
faq.a: Use the arrow keys or WASD on a computer, or touch to steer on mobile.

fall-words.summary:
Fall Words is a word puzzle where the letters you type turn into real objects. Each letter falls and lands with physics, so the words you choose can build bridges, knock things over or fill gaps. Your goal is to solve each puzzle and gather the stars.

There is a heartwarming story too. Fall Words follows an alien on a sweet journey, and your clever words help move the tale forward. Choosing a word is not just about spelling; you have to think about how its letters will fall and stack. That makes the game a creative mix of vocabulary and strategy. It is a great fit for kids who like words, puzzles and stories, and it is a fun way to practice typing. The game shows how everything works when it starts, so you can jump straight in.
fall-words.how_to: Type words to solve each puzzle and collect the stars. The letters you type fall into the level with physics, so think about their shape and where they will land. Use them to build paths, push objects or fill spaces. If a word does not work, try another one. The controls are shown right at the start.
tips: Think about how the letters will stack before you type.
Short words can be easier to control.
Try different words if your first idea fails.
Look for stars and plan words that help you reach them.

faq.q: How do you play Fall Words?
faq.a: Type words whose letters fall into the level, and use them to solve puzzles and collect stars.

faq.q: Does Fall Words have a story?
faq.a: Yes, it follows a heartwarming story about an alien.

mr-bullet.summary:
Mr Bullet is a shooting puzzle where clever aim matters more than speed. Each level sets up enemies, ninjas and other bad guys, and you need to take them down with precise shots. Often, the challenge is to do it with just one bullet.

What makes Mr Bullet a puzzle is the way shots can bounce and objects can fall. You need to study the level and find the smartest angle, not just the most direct one. As you travel to new places, you will rescue hostages and try special weapons like grenade launchers. The spy and action theme gives it a playful, movie-like feel. It is played with the mouse and suits older kids who enjoy aiming puzzles and figuring out tricky shots. Each level is short, so it is easy to try again until you find the perfect angle.
mr-bullet.how_to: Defeat all the enemies in each level with as few shots as possible. Use the mouse to aim and shoot. Study the level first and look for angles where your shot can bounce or knock things onto enemies. Be careful not to hit hostages. Try to clear each level with just one shot when you can.
tips: Look for bounce angles instead of only shooting straight.
Use falling objects to take out more than one enemy.
Avoid hitting hostages.
Take your time to aim; there is no rush.

faq.q: How do you play Mr Bullet?
faq.a: Aim with the mouse and shoot enemies, using bounces and falling objects to clear each level.

faq.q: Can you finish Mr Bullet levels with one shot?
faq.a: Many levels challenge you to do it with a single shot.

stickman-hook-2.summary:
Stickman Hook 2 lets you play as a spider-like stickman who swings through levels with a grappling hook. You latch on, swing forward and let go to fly through the air. Bumpers bounce you around, and obstacles stand in your way.

The main skill in Stickman Hook 2 is timing your release. Let go at the right moment and you soar to the next hook; let go too early or too late and you miss. Chaining swings and bounces together lets you pull off acrobatic tricks in a row. There is an online element as well, and the goal is to be the first to cross the finish line. The controls are touch-based and easy to learn. It is a great choice for kids who liked the first Stickman Hook and want more swinging action with a bit of competition.
stickman-hook-2.how_to: Swing through each level and reach the finish line first. Press and hold the screen to hook your stickman to a grapple point, and release to let go and fly forward. Use bumpers to bounce higher and avoid obstacles along the way. Time your releases so you reach the next hook and keep your momentum.
tips: Let go when you are swinging upward for more distance.
Use bumpers to gain height.
Do not hold on too long or you will swing backward.
Watch for obstacles before you release.

faq.q: How do you play Stickman Hook 2?
faq.a: Press and hold to hook onto a grapple point and release to fly forward toward the finish.

faq.q: Is Stickman Hook 2 online?
faq.a: Yes, it has an online mode where you try to be the first to cross the finish line.

super-onion-boy-2-2.summary:
Super Onion Boy 2 is a retro-style platformer with a brave little hero on a big mission. A powerful beast has taken your friend, and you set out across colorful levels to rescue them. Along the way you meet enemies, find treasures and face tough bosses.

The adventure in Super Onion Boy 2 is packed with classic platform fun. You can gain superpowers that change your hero, dig up hidden treasures and look for secret paths that lead to surprises. Outsmarting enemies is just as important as jumping well, and the bosses will test everything you have learned. The bright, old-school look gives it a cheerful feel. It is a great pick for kids who love retro platformers, exploring every corner of a level and beating a big boss at the end. The game shows its controls when it starts, so you can begin your rescue right away.
super-onion-boy-2-2.how_to: Save your captured friend by making it through each level, one stage at a time. Jump across platforms, avoid or defeat enemies and collect treasures. Use superpowers when you get them, and look for secret paths. Beat the bosses to move forward in your quest. You will see the controls on the first screen.
tips: Explore levels to find hidden treasures and secret paths.
Watch how enemies move before you jump near them.
Use your superpowers at the right time.
Learn a boss's pattern before going on the attack.

faq.q: What is the goal in Super Onion Boy 2?
faq.a: You need to save your friend, who was taken by a strong beast, by beating levels and bosses.

faq.q: Does Super Onion Boy 2 have bosses?
faq.a: Yes, you face tough bosses during the adventure.

ninja-parkour-multiplayer.summary:
Ninja Parkour Multiplayer turns you into a fast, nimble ninja racing across obstacle courses. The courses keep changing, so you never know exactly what is coming. Precise jumps and quick reactions are what you need to make it to the end.

The aim in Ninja Parkour Multiplayer is to be faster than your opponents. Every jump counts, and a single slip can cost you the lead. Because the landscape shifts, you have to read the course as you go and adjust your moves on the spot. That keeps every race fresh and exciting. It is an action-packed parkour game that suits kids who love speed, jumping challenges and testing their reflexes. If you dream of becoming the top ninja champion, this is your chance to show your skills. The game shows its controls when it starts, so check them before your first run.
ninja-parkour-multiplayer.how_to: Race through the obstacle course and finish ahead of your opponents. Run, jump and land precisely on platforms. The course keeps changing, so watch what is ahead and react fast. If you fall, get back on track as quickly as possible. The game explains its controls as soon as it starts, so look at the first screen before you race.
tips: Focus on clean jumps rather than rushing.
Look ahead to spot changes in the course.
Keep moving; hesitating can cost you the lead.
Practice tricky jumps until they feel natural.

faq.q: What is Ninja Parkour Multiplayer about?
faq.a: You race as a ninja through changing obstacle courses and try to beat your opponents.

faq.q: What skills do you need in Ninja Parkour Multiplayer?
faq.a: Precise jumps and fast reactions help you most.

neon-rider.summary:
Neon Rider puts you on a glowing bike racing through bright digital worlds. The tracks shine with neon light, but they are also full of hazards that can send you crashing. You need tight control and quick reflexes to get through.

Physics plays a big role in Neon Rider. Your bike reacts to slopes, jumps and landings, so you have to manage your speed and balance carefully. Along the way, you can collect treasures while dodging danger. The tracks keep changing, which keeps each ride fresh. If you crash, you simply start again and try to do better, and every run teaches you something new. It is a racing game that suits kids who like stylish visuals, physics challenges and the thrill of finally clearing a hard track. The game shows its controls when it starts.
neon-rider.how_to: Ride your neon bike through each track, collect treasures and avoid hazards. Control your speed and balance so you land jumps safely. If you crash, try again and learn from the mistake. The controls are shown right at the start, so check them on the first screen before you ride.
tips: Slow down before tricky jumps.
Land with your bike level to avoid crashing.
Collect treasures only when it is safe.
Learn the track over several runs.

faq.q: What kind of game is Neon Rider?
faq.a: It is a physics-based bike racing game with glowing neon tracks.

faq.q: What do you do in Neon Rider?
faq.a: Ride through tracks, collect treasures and avoid hazards without crashing.

12-minibattles.summary:
12 MiniBattles is a party game packed with quick duels for two players. Instead of one long match, you and a friend jump between different mini-games picked at random, such as soccer or a sniper duel. Each one is short, fast and full of silly physics.

The magic of 12 MiniBattles is its one-button control. Every game uses just a single key per player, so anyone can join in right away. But simple controls do not mean easy wins: timing and quick thinking still decide who comes out on top. The retro graphics give it a fun, old-school look, and the random game order keeps things surprising. It is a perfect pick for siblings or friends sitting at the same computer who want to see who is better across lots of different challenges. Expect plenty of laughs and rematches.
12-minibattles.how_to: Beat your friend in a series of randomly chosen mini-games. Player 1 uses the A key and Player 2 uses the L key. Each mini-game uses just that one key, so watch what your character does when you press it. Learn the trick of each game quickly and time your presses better than your opponent.
tips: Figure out what your key does in each new mini-game.
Do not press nonstop; timing usually wins.
Watch your friend's moves and react.
Play several rounds; every mini-game needs a different trick.

faq.q: Can two players play 12 MiniBattles?
faq.a: Yes, it is made for two players on the same device: Player 1 uses A and Player 2 uses L.

faq.q: What games are in 12 MiniBattles?
faq.a: It has a mix of mini-games chosen at random, for example soccer and a sniper duel.

commando-force-2.summary:
Commando Force 2 is a first-person shooter with plenty of action. You can join team battles or try free-for-all matches where everyone fights for themselves. There are different maps to learn and lots of weapons to try.

Progress is a big part of Commando Force 2. A Battle Pass lets you unlock rewards as you play, so there is always something to aim for. Learning the maps and finding the weapons that suit you helps you play smarter. The controls are smooth and easy to start with, but getting really good takes practice and strategy. Because it is a shooter, it is best for older kids who enjoy fast action and team play. If you like games where you can improve over time and earn new rewards, this one gives you plenty to work toward. The game shows its controls when it starts.
commando-force-2.how_to: Pick team battles or free-for-all and win your matches. Move around the map, aim carefully and take down opponents while avoiding damage. Try different weapons to find your favorite, and play matches to unlock Battle Pass rewards. You will see the controls on the first screen, so take a look before your first match.
tips: Learn the maps so you know where to find cover.
Try different weapons to see what suits you.
Stick with your team in team battles.
Keep moving so you are harder to hit.

faq.q: What modes does Commando Force 2 have?
faq.a: You can play team battles or free-for-all matches.

faq.q: Does Commando Force 2 have a Battle Pass?
faq.a: Yes, playing lets you earn rewards from the Battle Pass.

save-the-doge.summary:
Save the Doge is a drawing puzzle where you protect a cute dog from angry bees. In each level, bees are about to swarm, and you need to draw lines that shield the doge until they give up. Your drawing is the only thing standing between the pup and the stingers.

The fun of Save the Doge is that you can solve each level in your own way. A simple wall might work, or you might need a smarter shape to block bees from every side. Each level is a new puzzle that tests both your imagination and your problem-solving. It is calm, creative and very cute, which makes it a great pick for younger kids as well as older ones. If you enjoy drawing games where you can experiment and see what happens, Save the Doge is a sweet choice. The game shows its controls when it starts.
save-the-doge.how_to: Protect the doge from the bee swarm by drawing a shield. Draw a line or shape around the dog before the bees arrive. When you finish, the bees attack, and your drawing needs to keep them away until they give up. If the bees get through, try a new shape. You will see the controls on the first screen.
tips: Make sure your drawing covers every side the bees can reach.
Simple, solid shapes often work best.
Look at where the bees come from before you draw.
Try a different shape if the bees keep getting through.

faq.q: How do you play Save the Doge?
faq.a: Draw lines to protect the dog from the bees until they stop attacking.

faq.q: Is Save the Doge good for young kids?
faq.a: Yes, it is a calm, cute drawing puzzle that suits younger players.

raft-wars-2.summary:
Raft Wars 2 is a level-based shooting game built on a fun family story. Together with your brother Simon, you guard a treasure, and enemies of all kinds are trying to take it. From your raft, you fire back and keep your loot safe.

Aiming is the main skill in Raft Wars 2. Each shot needs the right angle and strength to reach the target, so you learn to judge distance as you play. Some shots are easy, while others need clever thinking. The levels give you a clear goal each time, and the playful style keeps things light. It is played with the mouse and suits kids who like aiming games and cartoon adventures. If you have played the first Raft Wars, you will recognize the idea of defending the treasure. The game shows more details about each level when it starts.
raft-wars-2.how_to: Protect your treasure by shooting at the enemies. Use the mouse: click and draw to set your shot, then let go to fire. Think about the angle and power before each shot so it lands on target. Take out the enemies in each level to keep your treasure safe and move on.
tips: Adjust the angle a little after each miss.
Watch where your shots land to judge power.
Target the most dangerous enemies first.
Take your time to aim; careful shots work better.

faq.q: How do you shoot in Raft Wars 2?
faq.a: Click and draw with the mouse to aim, then release to shoot.

faq.q: What is Raft Wars 2 about?
faq.a: You and your brother Simon defend your treasure from enemies.

god-of-light.summary:
God of Light is a glowing puzzle game about guiding beams of light. Each level is a dark scene with mirrors and obstacles, and your task is to bend the light so it reaches dormant flowers and brings them back to life. When a level is solved, the screen fills with a beautiful light show.

The puzzles in God of Light ask for both creativity and strategy. You need to figure out how to angle mirrors and route the beam around obstacles to reach every target. Each level has its own twist, so you keep learning new tricks as you go. The calm mood and pretty visuals make it relaxing to play, even when a puzzle takes a while to crack. It is a great fit for kids who enjoy logic puzzles, light and color, and that moment when everything suddenly lines up. The game shows its controls when it starts.
god-of-light.how_to: Guide the beam of light to the dormant flowers in each level. Use mirrors and other objects to bend the light around obstacles. Try different angles until the beam reaches every target and the flowers come back to life. A quick guide to the controls pops up when you begin, so check the first screen before playing.
tips: Trace the path of the light from start to end in your head.
Work backward from the flower to find the right path.
Adjust one mirror at a time to see the effect.
Be patient; some levels need several tries.

faq.q: How do you play God of Light?
faq.a: Guide a beam of light with mirrors around obstacles to reach and revive the flowers.

faq.q: Is God of Light relaxing?
faq.a: Yes, it has a calm mood and pretty visuals, even when the puzzles get tricky.

miner-cat.summary:
Miner Cat is an underground adventure starring a cat with a pickaxe. You dig through colorful layers, break blocks and uncover hidden treasures. There is always something new waiting behind the next block, which makes digging deeper exciting.

As you collect more treasures in Miner Cat, you can upgrade your pickaxe and expand your backpack. Better tools help you dig faster, and a bigger backpack lets you carry more before heading back. The game also includes crafting, so you can turn what you find into useful items. It is a cozy, charming mining game that suits kids who enjoy collecting, upgrading and exploring at their own pace. There is no hurry, so you can take your time and enjoy each discovery. The game shows its controls when it starts, so you can grab your pickaxe and start digging.
miner-cat.how_to: Dig through the underground, break blocks and collect treasures. Move carefully through the terrain and mine as much as your backpack can hold. Use what you find to upgrade your pickaxe and expand your backpack so you can dig deeper and carry more. Try crafting to make useful items. The controls appear on screen when the game begins.
tips: Upgrade your pickaxe early to dig faster.
Expand your backpack so you can carry more treasure.
Explore different areas to find surprises.
Try crafting with the items you collect.

faq.q: What do you do in Miner Cat?
faq.a: You dig underground as a cat, collect treasures, upgrade your tools and craft items.

faq.q: Can you upgrade in Miner Cat?
faq.a: Yes, you can upgrade your pickaxe and expand your backpack.

escaping-the-prison.summary:
You wake up locked in a cell, and the only way out is through your own clever choices. Escaping the Prison is a stick figure adventure where every scene gives you a handful of options, and you have to guess which one will actually get you past the guards. Some ideas are smart, some are silly, and some go wrong in very funny ways.

The fun comes from trying odd gadgets and seeing what happens. Strange tools like teleporters, gear that messes with gravity and even a toilet plunger can show up as choices. Pick the wrong one or react too slowly, and you may end up back behind bars. Escaping the Prison is a quick puzzle game for anyone who likes trial and error, goofy surprises and a little bit of planning.
escaping-the-prison.how_to: Your goal is to get your stick figure out of the prison alive. Each scene offers a few actions, and you click the one you think will work. Everything is done with the mouse: read the situation, pick an option and watch the result. Some moments are timed, so you need to decide quickly. If a choice fails, you can try again and learn from it.
tips: Look at every option before you click, because the funniest one is not always the right one.
Remember which choices failed so you don't repeat them on the next try.
Keep your hand on the mouse during fast moments, since slow reactions can send you back to the cell.
Think about what each gadget would really do in that spot before you use it.

faq.q: How do you play Escaping the Prison?
faq.a: You choose actions with your mouse in each scene and try to find the path that leads out of the prison. Wrong choices send you back, so you learn as you go.

faq.q: Is Escaping the Prison hard?
faq.a: It is more about guessing and quick decisions than skill. Most players need a few tries to find the right path.

santa-clicker.summary:
Santa's bag is empty, and it is your job to fill it. Santa Clicker is a holiday idle game where each click adds presents, and the presents you earn pay for upgrades that make every click count for more. Before long you are not just tapping alone, because helpers can join in and keep the gifts coming. It is a cheerful way to get into the Christmas mood.

Elves and reindeer can be recruited to work for you, so the present pile keeps growing even when you take a break from clicking. There is also the North Pole to explore, plus cozy Christmas pictures and music in the background. Santa Clicker is a relaxed pick for winter evenings, and it is easy to come back to whenever you want to watch the numbers grow a little more.
santa-clicker.how_to: The goal in Santa Clicker is to collect as many presents as you can. Click to add gifts to Santa's bag, then spend them on upgrades that boost your clicks. Recruit elves and reindeer to produce presents automatically. A quick guide to the controls pops up when you begin, so follow the on-screen hints to find your way around.
tips: Buy your first helpers early, because automatic presents add up faster than clicking alone.
Compare upgrade prices and pick the one that gives the biggest boost for the cost.
Save up for bigger upgrades instead of spending every present right away.
Check back after a break to see how many gifts your helpers made.

faq.q: What is Santa Clicker about?
faq.a: You click to collect gifts for Santa and buying upgrades, then hire elves and reindeer to help.

faq.q: Can I play Santa Clicker outside of Christmas?
faq.a: Of course. The game has a holiday theme, but you can play it any time of the year.

geometrix.summary:
Shapes are coming at you fast, and you have to turn into the right one before they hit. In Geometrix, your character can switch between different shapes, and you defeat enemies by matching their form at the moment you collide. Get it right and the enemy is gone. Get it wrong and you lose health.

The game has more than 40 levels, and each one asks for sharper reactions than the last. Early stages give you time to think, while later ones throw shapes at you quickly. Geometrix is a short, focused casual game that trains your eyes and your timing. It suits players who like simple rules with a real challenge, and it is great for quick play sessions when you only have a few minutes. Quick thinking matters more than anything else.
geometrix.how_to: Your goal is to survive each level by matching the shape of every enemy you crash into. Watch what is coming, switch to the same shape and let the collision happen. A mismatch costs health points, so stay alert. A quick guide to the controls pops up when you begin, so check the opening screen to learn how to change shapes.
tips: Look ahead at the next enemy instead of only the one right in front of you.
Switch shapes a little early so you are ready before the collision.
Stay calm in later levels, because panicking leads to wrong matches.
Replay early levels if you want to practice your timing.

faq.q: How many levels does Geometrix have?
faq.a: Geometrix has over 40 levels that slowly get harder.

faq.q: What happens if I pick the wrong shape in Geometrix?
faq.a: Colliding with an enemy in the wrong shape costs you health points.

piece-of-cake-merge-and-bake.summary:
Emily has a dream: turn a little café into something special. In Piece of Cake: Merge & Bake, you help her by combining ingredients on a cooking table. When two matching items meet, they merge into something better, and step by step you create the dishes that keep customers happy. It is a mix of a merge puzzle and running a small business.

There is more than cooking, too. Emily's café sits in a big mansion with family secrets waiting to be uncovered, so the story moves forward as you play. You can also expand your cooking table to make room for more merges. Piece of Cake: Merge & Bake works on computers and on phones or tablets, which makes it a calm puzzle game to enjoy at home or on the go.
piece-of-cake-merge-and-bake.how_to: Your goal is to merge ingredients and grow Emily's café. Drag an item onto a matching one to combine them into a new ingredient or dish. On a computer, use the mouse to drag items and click buttons. On a phone or tablet, tap buttons and drag items with your finger. Use your creations to finish orders and expand the table.
tips: Keep your cooking table tidy so you always have space for new merges.
Look for pairs before dragging, so you don't waste moves.
Expand your table when you can, because more space means more combinations.
Follow the story goals to learn more about the mansion and its secrets.

faq.q: Can I play Piece of Cake: Merge & Bake on my phone?
faq.a: Yes, it works on phones and tablets. You tap buttons and drag items with your finger.

faq.q: How do you merge items in Piece of Cake: Merge & Bake?
faq.a: Drag one ingredient onto an identical one, and they combine into something new.

dragon-simulator-3d.summary:
Ever wondered what it would be like to be a dragon? Dragon Simulator 3D lets you find out. You fly over a colorful fantasy world, breathe fire and take part in big battles. There is a lot of open sky, so you can glide around as long as you like and look at the land below. Diving low and climbing high feels great once you get used to it.

Life as a dragon is not all peaceful, though. Humans are a threat, and you need to survive, grow stronger and build a dragon legacy. You can also form alliances along the way. Dragon Simulator 3D is a 3D adventure for kids who love fantasy creatures and want the freedom of flying wherever they choose, with some action mixed in. It plays right in your browser, so there is nothing to install.
dragon-simulator-3d.how_to: Your goal is to survive as a dragon, grow stronger and deal with the humans who threaten you. Fly around the world, use your fire breath in battles and work on evolving your dragon. You will see the controls on the first screen, so check the first screen to learn how to fly and attack. Take it slow at first.
tips: Spend some time just flying around to get used to moving in 3D.
Pick your battles carefully while your dragon is still young.
Use your fire breath at the right distance so it actually hits.
Look for ways to grow and evolve, since a stronger dragon survives longer.

faq.q: What do you do in Dragon Simulator 3D?
faq.a: You play as a dragon, fly through a fantasy world, fight with fire breath and try to survive and evolve.

faq.q: Is Dragon Simulator 3D a 3D game?
faq.a: Yes, the world and the dragon are in 3D, so you can fly freely in every direction.

body-drop-3d.summary:
A crash test dummy is ready, and you control the chaos. Body Drop 3D is a physics game where you aim balls at a floppy ragdoll and try to cause as much damage as possible. The dummy flops, tumbles and bounces in silly ways, which is a big part of the fun. Each new hit can look totally different from the last one.

You only get a limited number of balls, so each shot matters. Trying different angles can lead to bigger crashes, and new scenes open up as you go. Body Drop 3D is a cartoonish, over-the-top simulation, more funny than gory, and it rewards clever thinking about how things fall. If you enjoy seeing physics do strange things, this one is worth a few rounds. It plays right in your web browser.
body-drop-3d.how_to: Your goal is to cause the most damage to the crash test dummy using a limited number of balls. Aim carefully, launch your shots and watch the ragdoll react. Try new angles to get bigger results. The controls are shown right at the start, so check the first screen to learn how to aim and fire.
tips: Test a few angles before deciding which one gives the biggest crash.
Don't fire all your balls at once; watch how the dummy moves first.
Hit the dummy when it is off balance to send it flying further.
Try new scenes as they unlock, since each one gives different chances.

faq.q: How do you play Body Drop 3D?
faq.a: You aim balls at a ragdoll crash test dummy and try to cause as much damage as you can with a limited number of shots.

faq.q: Is Body Drop 3D violent?
