faq.a: It uses a cartoon crash test dummy and silly ragdoll physics, so it feels more goofy than scary.

stick-defenders.summary:
Waves of enemies are marching toward your base, and your stickmen are the only thing standing in the way. Stick Defenders is a merge defense game where you combine two matching fighters to create a stronger one. The better your lineup, the longer your walls hold.

Along with merging, you can upgrade your attack, make your walls tougher and try bonus extras like a prize wheel that hands out helpful items. Timing matters, too, since special skills become ready after a cooldown and should be used before the enemies pile up. Stick Defenders mixes simple drag-and-drop play with real strategy, so it suits both quick sessions and longer runs where you try to survive as long as possible. Each wave tests whether your setup is strong enough.
stick-defenders.how_to: Your goal is to keep the enemy waves away from your base for as long as you can. Use the left mouse button, or your finger on a touch screen, to select and drag units. Place a unit over its exact twin to combine the pair into a stronger defender. Spend rewards on upgrades and walls, and use skills when they are ready.
tips: Merge whenever you can, because one strong unit usually beats two weak ones.
Don't forget to fix and upgrade your walls between waves.
Use your skills as soon as the cooldown ends if enemies are getting close.
Spin the bonus wheel when it is available for extra help.

faq.q: How do you merge units in Stick Defenders?
faq.a: Pick up a stickman and let go over a matching one. The two join into a single, stronger defender.

faq.q: What is the goal of Stick Defenders?
faq.a: You hold off wave after wave of attackers and try to last as long as possible.

pill-soccer.summary:
The players look like little pills, but the matches are serious. Pill Soccer is a quick soccer game where you jump, run and kick to send the ball into the goal. The simple shapes make the physics bouncy and a bit unpredictable, so every match feels different. Matches are short, so a full game fits into a few minutes.

The best part is that you can play with a friend on the same keyboard. Pill Soccer has a 2 Player mode where each person uses their own keys, so it is easy to set up a match on one computer. There are also matches against other opponents when you want to play alone. Pill Soccer is a fun choice for short breaks and friendly rivalries at home. It is best on a computer, since it uses the keyboard.
pill-soccer.how_to: Score more goals than your opponent. In 2 Player mode, Player 1 jumps with the Up Arrow, moves with the Left and Right Arrows, kicks with P or the Down Arrow and uses K for the super bonus. Player 2 jumps with W, moves with A and D and kicks with S. Time your jumps and kicks to hit the ball toward the goal.
tips: Jump just before the ball reaches you to get a strong header.
Stay between the ball and your own goal when you are defending.
Save the super bonus for a moment when you are close to the goal.
Practice the timing of your kick, because hitting too early sends the ball the wrong way.

faq.q: Can two players play Pill Soccer?
faq.a: Yes. Pill Soccer has a 2 Player mode where both players share one keyboard with different keys.

faq.q: What are the controls in Pill Soccer?
faq.a: Player 1 uses the arrow keys plus P or Down to kick and K for the bonus. Player 2 uses W to jump, A and D to move and S to kick.

tasty-blue.summary:
You start as a small goldfish with a very big appetite. Tasty Blue is an underwater game about eating, growing and eating some more. Everything smaller than you is food, and every snack makes you a little bigger, so the ocean slowly turns from scary to yours.

The trick is knowing what you can eat and what can eat you. Early on you need to swim away from bigger creatures, but as you grow, those same enemies can become your next meal. Tasty Blue is simple to understand and fun to keep playing, because you always want to see how big your goldfish can get. It is a relaxed but exciting game for kids who love the sea. Each round is a little different, depending on what swims your way.
tasty-blue.how_to: Your goal is to grow as big as you can by eating things smaller than you. Swim around, gobble up food and stay away from creatures that are larger than your fish. As you grow, you can start eating enemies that once chased you. The controls appear on screen when the game begins, so check the first screen to learn how to swim.
tips: Only go after things that are clearly smaller than you.
Keep moving so bigger creatures can't trap you.
Grow slowly and safely at first instead of taking risks.
Watch the edges of the screen for danger coming in.

faq.q: What do you do in Tasty Blue?
faq.a: You play as a hungry goldfish, eat things smaller than you and grow bigger while avoiding larger enemies.

faq.q: Can I eat the enemies in Tasty Blue?
faq.a: Yes, once your fish grows big enough, you can eat enemies that used to be dangerous.

hedgies.summary:
A run-down house in a quiet valley needs a new start, and a hardworking hedgehog is ready to help. Hedgies is a cozy farming game where you plant crops, make useful goods and slowly turn an empty plot into a lively home. Your hedgehog can also cook and fish, so there is always something to do.

Hedgies is a single-player game, and it moves at a gentle pace. There is no rush, only steady progress as your farm grows and the valley becomes more beautiful. It works on phones and tablets as well as computers, so you can check on your crops wherever you are. Kids who like calm games about building and caring for a place will feel right at home in Hedgies. Each small job adds up to a home you can be proud of.
hedgies.how_to: Your goal is to bring a forgotten piece of land back to life as a busy farm. Grow crops, craft goods, cook meals and go fishing with your hedgehog. Use what you make to improve your home and the valley around it. The controls are shown right at the start, and on phones and tablets you play by tapping. Take your time and enjoy the cozy pace.
tips: Plant crops early so they can grow while you do other tasks.
Try cooking and fishing too, not only farming, to get more out of each day.
Check what each task needs before you start it.
Keep improving your home a little at a time.

faq.q: Can I play Hedgies on my phone?
faq.a: Yes, Hedgies works on phones and tablets as well as computers.

faq.q: Is Hedgies a multiplayer game?
faq.a: No, Hedgies is a single-player farming game.

cat-runner.summary:
A scary monster is right behind you, and your cat has to keep running. Cat Runner is an endless runner set in bright, colorful places. You dash forward, jump over or dodge things in your way and grab power-ups that help you go further. The faster you go, the harder it gets to react.

Since the run never ends, the challenge is to see how far you can make it before you trip up. Each attempt teaches you a bit more about timing and reading the path ahead. Cat Runner has cute pictures and fast action, which makes it a good fit for kids who like quick reflex games and cats. It is easy to start a new run whenever you want to beat your last score. It plays straight in your browser, too.
cat-runner.how_to: Your goal is to run as far as you can while a monster chases you. Avoid obstacles, collect power-ups and keep your cat moving. A quick guide to the controls pops up when you begin, so check the first screen to see how to jump and dodge. Keep your eyes on the path ahead and react quickly, because the speed builds up the longer you survive.
tips: Look a little ahead on the track so obstacles don't surprise you.
Grab power-ups when it is safe, but don't crash just to reach one.
Stay relaxed as the speed increases, since tense hands make mistakes.
Try to beat your own distance a little each run.

faq.q: What kind of game is Cat Runner?
faq.a: Cat Runner is an endless runner where your cat escapes from a monster while dodging obstacles.

faq.q: Does Cat Runner ever end?
faq.a: No, it is an endless runner, so you keep going until you hit an obstacle.

falling-ballz.summary:
Shapes are moving up the screen, and you need to smash them before they climb too high. Falling Ballz is an arcade game about aiming well and thinking one step ahead. You send balls toward the moving shapes and try to smash them in time. Every shot is a small decision about angle and timing.

What makes Falling Ballz tricky is that the shapes keep moving, so a shot that looks perfect can miss. Good players guess where a shape will be, not where it is now. The game blends quick reactions with a bit of planning, and there is no fixed end, so you can keep playing to improve. It is a nice choice for kids who like aim-and-shoot puzzles. Short rounds make it a handy game for a quick break.
falling-ballz.how_to: Your goal is to smash every moving shape while it is still below the top edge. Aim your balls, fire and try to predict where each shape will move. You will see the controls on the first screen, so check the first screen to see how to aim and shoot. Deal with the highest shapes first.
tips: Aim at where a shape is going, not where it is right now.
Deal with shapes closest to the top first.
Use bounces off the walls to reach hard spots.
Take a breath before each shot instead of firing too fast.

faq.q: How do you play Falling Ballz?
faq.a: You aim and fire balls at moving shapes and try to smash them while they are still low on the screen.

faq.q: Does Falling Ballz have an ending?
faq.a: The action keeps going, so you can play as long as you like and try to do better each time.

stack-ball.summary:
A ball sits on top of a tall tower, and your job is to bring it all the way down. Stack Ball is a helix-style arcade game where the ball smashes through colored platforms as the tower turns. It is quick to learn and hard to put down. The colors and the smashing sound make it very satisfying.

The catch is the black tiles. Hitting a black part of a platform ends your run, so you need to watch the tower spin and pick the right moments to smash through. Stack Ball is played with just the mouse, which makes it simple to pick up. It is great for short breaks and for anyone who enjoys games about timing and focus. Each run takes just a minute or two.
stack-ball.how_to: Your goal is to get the ball to the bottom of the tower without landing on a black tile. Use the mouse to make the ball smash through the colored platforms. Stop when a black section comes under the ball and continue when it is safe. The tower keeps spinning, so pay attention to what is coming up under the ball.
tips: Watch the tower rotate and time your smashes for the colored parts.
Let go when you see black tiles coming up below.
Don't rush at the start; get a feel for the speed first.
Short taps can be safer than holding when the tower is crowded with black tiles.

faq.q: How do you play Stack Ball?
faq.a: You use the mouse to make the ball crash through colored platforms on a spinning tower while avoiding black tiles.

faq.q: What happens if I hit a black tile in Stack Ball?
faq.a: Landing on a black tile ends your run, so you have to start again.

foot-chinko.summary:
Soccer meets bouncing balls in Foot Chinko. Instead of running across a field, you aim your kick and watch the ball bounce its way toward the goal. The bright 2D look keeps things cheerful, while the levels make you think about angles and power. Each level feels like a small puzzle with a ball and a net.

There are more than 90 levels, and the opponents can be pretty silly, including a goalkeeper duck. Winning matches earns you trophies, so there is always a reason to try the next stage. Foot Chinko is a sports game that also feels like a puzzle, which makes it a good pick for kids who like soccer but also enjoy figuring out the perfect shot. Some shots need a few tries before they land perfectly.
foot-chinko.how_to: Your goal is to win each match by scoring goals past quirky opponents. Aim your shot, kick the ball and let it bounce toward the net. You will see the controls on the first screen, so check the first screen to learn how to aim and shoot. If a shot misses, change the angle a little and try again until it goes in.
tips: Think about where the ball will bounce before you kick.
Try small changes in angle if a shot keeps missing.
Watch how the goalkeeper moves and shoot when there is an opening.
Replay levels to earn more trophies.

faq.q: How many levels are in Foot Chinko?
faq.a: Foot Chinko has more than 90 levels.

faq.q: Is Foot Chinko a soccer game?
faq.a: Yes, it is a soccer game where bouncing shots and aiming play a big role.

ragdoll-soccer.summary:
The players in Ragdoll Soccer are floppy, wobbly and very hard to control, which is exactly why it is so funny. This physics soccer game turns every match into a messy scramble for the ball. Your goal is simple: stay in one piece and score. Players flop around, fall over and launch through the air at the worst moments.

You can play alone in a puzzle mode or challenge a friend in a 2 player match on the same keyboard. Each player uses their own keys, so it is easy to share one computer. Ragdoll Soccer is all about silly moments, surprising bounces and lots of laughing, and it works best on a computer since it uses the keyboard. Getting used to the floppy movement takes a few rounds.
ragdoll-soccer.how_to: Score goals while keeping your floppy player together. Player 1 moves with W, A, S and D and releases the launch rope with the Space Bar. Player 2 moves with the Arrow Keys and releases the launch rope with L. Use the rope to launch toward the ball, then push it into the goal. Have fun with it.
tips: Release the launch rope at the right moment to fly toward the ball.
Small moves often work better than big swings with a ragdoll body.
Stay close to your own goal when your opponent has the ball.
Try puzzle mode alone first to learn how the physics work.

faq.q: Can two players play Ragdoll Soccer?
faq.a: Yes. Ragdoll Soccer has a 2 player match where both players use the same keyboard.

faq.q: What are the controls in Ragdoll Soccer?
faq.a: Player 1 uses W, A, S, D and the Space Bar. Player 2 uses the Arrow Keys and L to release the launch rope.

mx-offroad-master.summary:
Hills, dirt and big jumps are waiting in MX Offroad Master. This 3D bike game puts you on rough ground where you race down steep slopes and fly off ramps. Keeping your balance is just as important as going fast. Every course has its own mix of hills and ramps to learn.

You can change the look of your rider and bike, pick up treasures along the courses and ride alone or together with a friend. The tracks get more demanding as you go, so practice pays off. MX Offroad Master is a fun driving game for kids who love bikes, jumps and the thrill of landing a big leap without falling over. Landing a jump cleanly is one of the best feelings in the game.
mx-offroad-master.how_to: Your goal is to finish each offroad course without crashing. Ride down slopes, launch off ramps and keep your bike balanced when you land. Collect treasures on the way and use them to customize your rider and bike. The game explains its controls as soon as it starts, so check the first screen before your first ride. Have fun.
tips: Slow down a little before big ramps so you can control your landing.
Keep your bike level in the air to avoid crashing.
Grab treasures when they are on your path, but don't risk a fall for them.
Practice tough courses a few times to learn their bumps.

faq.q: Can two players play MX Offroad Master?
faq.a: Yes, the game lets you ride solo or with a friend.

faq.q: Can I customize my bike in MX Offroad Master?
faq.a: Yes, you can customize both your rider and your bike.

refuge-solitaire.summary:
Refuge Solitaire is a calm card game with mountain views in the background. You build sequences of cards, stacking them in order from kings down to aces, and try to clear the game. It is a quiet puzzle where planning matters, but luck still plays its part. The pace is slow, so there is always time to think.

The Alpine scenery gives Refuge Solitaire a peaceful feeling, so it is nice for relaxing after school or at the end of the day. Every deal is different, which keeps each game fresh. If you like classic card games and want something slow and thoughtful, Refuge Solitaire is a good place to start. It is a nice way to practice patience and planning.
refuge-solitaire.how_to: Your goal is to arrange the cards in sequences from king down to ace. Move cards to build these stacks and try to clear the layout. Think before each move, since the order of cards can block you. The controls appear on screen when the game begins, so check how to move cards on the first screen.
tips: Look for moves that uncover hidden cards.
Try to free kings early, because they start new sequences.
Don't rush; sometimes waiting for the right card is better.
Plan two or three moves ahead when you can.

faq.q: How do you play Refuge Solitaire?
faq.a: You build card sequences from kings down to aces and try to complete the layout.

faq.q: Is Refuge Solitaire a luck game?
faq.a: It mixes strategy and chance. Good planning helps, but the deal also matters.

icy-purple-head-2.summary:
Icy Purple Head is back, sliding through a frozen world. In Icy Purple Head 2, you turn your character into ice so it can glide across tricky courses. The whole game is about timing your clicks, so it is easy to start but tough to master. Every click needs to happen at just the right moment.

There are 30 levels, each with its own set of dangerous obstacles. Turn to ice at the wrong moment and you won't make it. Turn at the right moment and you slide straight to the goal. Icy Purple Head 2 runs right in your browser with nothing to install, which makes it great for quick play. It suits kids who like clever puzzle levels and careful timing. A failed try only costs a few seconds, so it is easy to keep going.
icy-purple-head-2.how_to: Your goal is to guide Icy Purple Head safely to the end of each level. Click to turn your character into ice so it slides through the course, and time your clicks to avoid obstacles. Watch the level carefully before you start, since good timing is everything. Restart as often as you need.
tips: Watch the whole level before your first click.
Turn to ice only when you need to slide, not all the time.
Restart quickly if a run goes wrong and try different timing.
Remember the tricky spots in each level for your next try.

faq.q: How many levels does Icy Purple Head 2 have?
faq.a: Icy Purple Head 2 has 30 levels.

faq.q: How do you play Icy Purple Head 2?
faq.a: You click to turn your character into ice so it slides through the course, timing it to avoid obstacles.

faq.q: Do I need to download Icy Purple Head 2?
faq.a: No, it plays in your browser with no download or sign-up needed.

gladiator-fights.summary:
Step into an ancient Roman arena and get ready to fight. Gladiator Fights is an action game where you battle one opponent after another using a mix of attacks and dodges. Every fight is a test of timing and smart choices. The fights feel like a movie scene, with lots of action and tension.

Winning helps you climb the ranks of gladiators, and the arenas are designed to look like places from history. Some opponents fight differently than others, so you need to adjust your plan. Gladiator Fights is best for older kids who enjoy combat games with a strategy side. It is less about mashing buttons and more about knowing when to strike and when to step back. Patience in a fight often pays off more than speed.
gladiator-fights.how_to: Your goal is to defeat your opponents in the arena and rise through the gladiator ranks. Use attacks and evasive moves to win each fight. Watch your opponent closely and react to their moves. A quick guide to the controls pops up when you begin, so check the first screen to learn your attacks. Stay patient.
tips: Dodge first and attack when your opponent leaves an opening.
Don't attack non-stop; wild swings leave you open.
Study each new opponent, since they may fight in a different way.
Keep an eye on your health and play safer when it is low.

faq.q: What is Gladiator Fights about?
faq.a: You fight opponents in ancient Roman-style arenas and work your way up through the gladiator ranks.

faq.q: Is Gladiator Fights for kids?
faq.a: It is a combat game, so it fits older kids who are fine with arena fighting.

save-the-pets.summary:
A cute dog is in trouble, and only you can protect it. In Save the Pets, you draw lines on the screen to build shields and walls that keep the pup safe. Angry bees, hot lava, sharp spikes and bombs are all trying to reach your furry friend. The dog is counting on you.

Each level is a small puzzle. You need to think about where the danger will come from and draw just the right shape to block it. A careless line can leave a gap, so precision matters. Save the Pets is a clever arcade game for kids who like drawing puzzles and animals, and it is fun to replay levels to find a better solution. Some levels have more than one way to win.
save-the-pets.how_to: Your goal is to keep the dog safe from every danger in the level. Draw lines to block bees, lava, spikes and bombs. Think about where the threats will come from before you draw. The controls are shown right at the start, so check how drawing works on the first screen.
tips: Look at the whole level before you start drawing.
Cover every side the bees could reach the dog from.
Keep your lines closed with no gaps.
Draw quickly but carefully once you have a plan.

faq.q: How do you play Save the Pets?
faq.a: You draw lines to protect a dog from bees, lava, spikes and bombs.

faq.q: Is Save the Pets a puzzle game?
faq.a: Yes, each level is a small drawing puzzle that needs some planning.

slope-city.summary:
Your ball is rolling down a long chain of slopes, and it is speeding up the whole time. Slope City is an endless running game where you steer left and right to stay on track. The rules are simple, but the speed makes it very exciting. The path twists and turns in ways that keep you guessing.

As the ball goes faster, your reactions get tested more and more. One wrong move and you fall off the edge. Slope City is a hyper casual game, so you can start a new run in seconds and try to go further than before. It is great for players who love fast reflex games and quick challenges, and it is played with the keyboard. It is best on a computer.
slope-city.how_to: Your goal is to roll as far as you can without falling off the slopes. Press A or the Left Arrow to steer left and D or the Right Arrow to steer right. The ball keeps speeding up, so react quickly and stay on the track. The game gets faster the longer you last, so keep focused.
tips: Use small taps to steer instead of holding the key down.
Keep your eyes a little ahead of the ball.
Stay near the middle of the path when you can.
Relax your hands when the speed goes up.

faq.q: What are the controls in Slope City?
faq.a: Use A or the Left Arrow to steer left, and D or the Right Arrow to steer right.

faq.q: Does Slope City end?
faq.a: No, it is an endless running game, so you keep going until you fall off.

mr-racer-car-racing.summary:
Fast supercars, busy roads and lots of racing are waiting in MR RACER : Car Racing. You weave through traffic at high speed and try to beat your rivals. The controls are easy to learn, so you can focus on the thrill of the race. Passing other cars at top speed is a big part of the fun.

There is plenty to do: a Challenge Mode with 100 levels, a Chase Mode with no level limit and a Career Race Mode where you try to become a racing legend. There are 15 supercars to drive, and you can upgrade them and change their paint and wheels. This game is a good choice for kids who love cars and want lots of races to try.
mr-racer-car-racing.how_to: Your goal is to win races and beat the traffic. Press W or the Up Arrow to accelerate, A or the Left Arrow to steer left, D or the Right Arrow to steer right and S or the Down Arrow to brake. Press H to honk the horn. Use your winnings to upgrade and customize your cars.
tips: Brake a little before tight gaps in traffic.
Upgrade your car when you can, since better performance helps in later levels.
Stay calm and steer smoothly at high speed.
Try different modes to find the one you like most.

faq.q: What modes does MR RACER : Car Racing have?
faq.a: It has Challenge Mode with 100 levels, Chase Mode with unlimited levels and Career Race Mode.

faq.q: How many cars are in MR RACER : Car Racing?
faq.a: There are 15 supercars, and you can upgrade and customize them.

faq.q: What are the controls in MR RACER : Car Racing?
faq.a: Use W or Up to accelerate, A or Left and D or Right to steer, S or Down to brake and H for the horn.

hockey-hero.summary:
It is just you, the puck and a tough goalie. Hockey Hero is a shootout game where every shot counts. You get 10 attempts to score as many points as possible, and the goalie is doing everything to stop you. Each try is a quick one-on-one moment.

Speed and aim are what win here. A quick, well-placed shot has a much better chance than a slow one straight at the keeper. After your 10 shots, your score can go up against others on the leaderboard, which gives you a reason to try again and beat your best. Hockey Hero is short, simple and exciting, so it is perfect for a quick sports break. It is a great way to see how good your aim really is.
hockey-hero.how_to: Your goal is to score as many points as you can in 10 shootout attempts. Aim your shot, fire it fast and try to get the puck past the goalie. The controls are shown right at the start, so check the first screen to learn how to aim and shoot.
tips: Aim for the corners, where the goalie has a harder time reaching.
Watch how the goalie moves before you shoot.
Mix up where you shoot so the goalie can't guess.
Use all 10 attempts carefully, since every point counts.

faq.q: How many shots do you get in Hockey Hero?
faq.a: You get 10 attempts to score as many points as possible.

faq.q: Does Hockey Hero have a leaderboard?
faq.a: Yes, you can aim for a high spot on the leaderboard with your score.

moto-x3m-halloween.summary:
Moto X3M Halloween takes the famous stunt bike racing and moves it into a spooky land. You speed along wild tracks, do flips in the air and try not to crash into the creepy traps waiting on the course. Explosions and big crashes are part of the fun. Some tracks are full of surprises. Speed is your friend, but so is control.

Each level is a new challenge with its own obstacles, so you have to learn the track and find the safest, fastest way through. The Halloween theme gives the usual daring jumps a spooky new look. Moto X3M Halloween is played with the arrow keys, which makes it a great keyboard game for kids who like speed, stunts and a little bit of spooky scenery.
moto-x3m-halloween.how_to: Your goal is to reach the finish of each level as fast as you can without crashing. Use the arrow keys to control your bike: speed up, slow down and tilt to balance your jumps. Land on your wheels to keep going, and avoid the deadly obstacles along the track.
tips: Tilt your bike in the air so you land on both wheels.
Slow down before a trap if you aren't sure what is coming.
Learn each track by playing it a few times.
Flips look cool, but only do them when you have enough height.

faq.q: What are the controls in Moto X3M Halloween?
faq.a: You control the bike with the arrow keys.

faq.q: Is Moto X3M Halloween scary?
faq.a: It has a Halloween look, but it is a stunt bike racing game, not a horror game.

basket-champs.summary:
In Basket Champs, being tall doesn't win games. Skill and smart plays do. This basketball game lets you pick a team, take on rivals and try to score more points to move up through championships. Matches are quick, so you can play a few in a row.

Basket Champs is made to work on any device, so you can play on a computer, a tablet or a phone. Each match is a chance to sharpen your shooting and your game plan, and every championship you win brings a new challenge. It is a fun sports game for kids who love basketball and want quick matches with a goal to chase. Beating a tough rival feels great, and it pushes you to try for the next title. Since it is a simulator, getting better comes down to practice.
basket-champs.how_to: Your goal is to outscore your rivals and win championships. Pick your team, then shoot and play smart to score more than the other side. A quick guide to the controls pops up when you begin, so check the first screen to learn how to move and shoot. Practice your shots in the first matches.
tips: Take your time aiming instead of throwing the ball right away.
Watch how your rivals play and find their weak spots.
Try different teams to see which one suits your style.
Keep going after a loss; each match teaches you something.

faq.q: Can I play Basket Champs on my phone?
faq.a: Yes, the game is made to be playable on any device, including phones and tablets.

faq.q: What is the goal of Basket Champs?
faq.a: You choose a team, beat your rivals and move up through championships.

bike-mania.summary:
Hop on your motorcycle and hit the road in Bike Mania. Your job is to ride along the track and grab the gold you find along the way. It sounds simple, but bumps, hills and jumps make staying on the bike a challenge. Gold pieces are spread along the road for you to collect.

Bike Mania is a keyboard racing game, so it plays best on a computer. Balancing your bike is just as important as speeding up, because a bad landing can send your rider tumbling. It is a fun pick for kids who like motorcycles and short levels they can replay to do better. Every level gives you a chance to get a little better at balancing. It is a short and simple game, which makes it perfect for a quick play.
bike-mania.how_to: Your goal is to steer your motorbike along the road and grab all the gold. Use the W, A, S and D keys to control the bike. Speed up on flat parts, slow down before tricky spots and keep your bike balanced over bumps and jumps. Keep your balance at all times.
tips: Don't go full speed all the time; control is more important.
Lean your bike to land jumps on both wheels.
Pick up gold only when it is safe to reach.
Replay a level to learn where the hard spots are.

faq.q: What are the controls in Bike Mania?
faq.a: Bike Mania is played with the W, A, S and D keys.

faq.q: What is the goal of Bike Mania?
faq.a: You steer a motorbike down the road and pick up all the gold you can.

water-color-sort.summary:
Several tubes are filled with mixed-up colored water, and your job is to sort it out. Water Color Sort is a calm puzzle where you pour water from one tube to another until each one holds a single color. It looks simple, but the later puzzles really make you think. Each finished tube feels like a small win.

The main rule is that you can only pour onto the same color or into an empty space. That means the order of your moves matters a lot. Water Color Sort is great for training your planning skills, and it never rushes you. If you like quiet brain games with satisfying results, this one is easy to enjoy. Bigger puzzles may need many moves.
water-color-sort.how_to: Your goal is to make every tube contain only one color. Tap or click a tube to pick it, then choose another tube to pour into. Water can go onto the same color or into an empty tube. Follow the game instructions at the start, and plan your moves so you don't get stuck.
tips: Use empty tubes wisely, since they give you room to move colors around.
Plan a few pours ahead before you begin.
Finish one color at a time when you can.
If you get stuck, restart and try a different order.

faq.q: How do you play Water Color Sort?
faq.a: You pour colored water between tubes until each tube holds only one color.

faq.q: Is Water Color Sort hard?
faq.a: The first puzzles are easy, but later ones need more planning.

cut-the-rope-time-travel.summary:
Candy, ropes and a hungry little hero come together in Cut the Rope Time Travel. This time the adventure jumps through history, and you help feed lollipops to the hero's ancestors in different time periods. Each period of time has its own look.

As the name suggests, the main idea is cutting ropes at the right moment so a hanging lollipop swings and drops into the right mouth. Getting the timing and the order of cuts right is what solves each puzzle. Cut the Rope Time Travel is a playful puzzle game that rewards careful thinking, and its cute style makes it a great fit for younger players as well as older kids. Sometimes the answer is simple, and sometimes you need a clever trick.
cut-the-rope-time-travel.how_to: Your goal is to deliver the lollipop to the hungry characters. Cut ropes to let the candy swing and fall, and think about where it will land before you cut. The game explains its controls as soon as it starts, so watch the first level to see how cutting works. Some puzzles need a few tries.
tips: Watch how the candy swings before making your cut.
Think about the order of cuts when there are several ropes.
Try again with different timing if the candy misses.
Take your time; there is usually a clever solution.

faq.q: What is Cut the Rope Time Travel about?
faq.a: You travel through time and feed lollipops to the hero's ancestors by cutting ropes.

faq.q: How do you play Cut the Rope Time Travel?
faq.a: You cut ropes so the lollipop swings and drops into the character's mouth. The controls are shown in the game.

wall-painter.summary:
Grab your brush, because every wall needs a fresh coat of color. Wall Painter is a puzzle game where you guide your brush around different structures and try to paint every surface. It mixes planning with a bit of creativity. Every brush stroke brings a little more color.

The levels start easy and become more complex, so you need to think about the path you take. Painting yourself into a corner is a real problem here. Wall Painter is good for kids who like games where you see your progress right on screen, and it is satisfying to watch a gray wall turn into a bright, colorful one. Each new level is a fresh shape to cover. Careful planning beats speed here.
wall-painter.how_to: Your goal is to paint every surface in each level. Move your brush across the structure and plan a route that covers everything. Later levels need more careful planning. The game explains its controls as soon as it starts, so check the first screen to learn how to move the brush. Take your time.
tips: Look at the whole structure before you start painting.
Plan a route so you don't have to go back over finished parts.
Start from corners or edges, which are easy to miss.
Restart if your path gets messy and try a new route.

faq.q: How do you play Wall Painter?
faq.a: You move a brush over structures and try to paint every surface.

faq.q: Does Wall Painter get harder?
faq.a: Yes, levels become more complex and need more planning.

endless-car-chase.summary:
The police are on your tail and they never give up. Endless Car Chase is a racing game where you drive through busy streets and try to escape as long as you can. Sharp turns and quick thinking are your best friends. Every turn could be the one that helps you escape.

Power-ups along the way can help you stay ahead, and you can customize your car to make it your own. Since the chase never ends, the goal is to get a higher score each time. Endless Car Chase is a fast, exciting choice for kids who love cars and want to test their driving reflexes. Each run is quick, so you can keep trying to break your record.
endless-car-chase.how_to: Your goal is to escape the police for as long as possible and set a high score. Drive through the streets, make sharp turns and collect power-ups to help you get away. A quick guide to the controls pops up when you begin, so check the first screen to learn how to steer.
tips: Make sharp turns to shake off the police cars behind you.
Grab power-ups when they are on your way.
Avoid crashing into obstacles, since they slow you down.
Customize your car to fit the way you like to drive.

faq.q: What is the goal of Endless Car Chase?
faq.a: You escape from the police for as long as you can and try to get a high score.

faq.q: Can I customize my car in Endless Car Chase?
faq.a: Yes, you can customize your ride.

car-crash-test.summary:
Some games are about driving carefully. Car Crash Test is the opposite. Here you smash cars on purpose and watch them crumple thanks to real-time physics and detailed 3D graphics. The crashes look very real thanks to the physics.

Every crash earns coins, which you can use to unlock new cars and try other tracks. You can even slow down time to see a big wreck up close. Car Crash Test is pure arcade fun for kids who like seeing how things break, and since it is all just cars and machines, it stays playful rather than scary. Each new car and track gives you fresh ways to cause a spectacular smash. It is the kind of game where trying something wild is encouraged.
car-crash-test.how_to: Your goal is to cause impressive crashes and earn coins. Drive your car into obstacles and other objects, then use the coins to unlock new cars and tracks. Try slow motion to watch the wreck. The game explains its controls as soon as it starts, so check the first screen to learn how to drive. Watch the crash closely.
tips: Pick up speed before a crash to make it bigger.
Try different angles to see which crash earns the most.
Save coins to unlock new cars.
Use slow motion to see exactly what happens in a wreck.

faq.q: What do you do in Car Crash Test?
faq.a: You crash cars on purpose to earn coins, then unlock new cars and tracks.

faq.q: Is Car Crash Test a 3D game?
faq.a: Yes, it uses 3D graphics and real-time physics.

real-cars-in-city.summary:
There is a lot to choose from in this 3D driving game. You get 20 sports cars, 36 racetracks and several areas to explore, including an area for free driving, one for police chases and one for crash derby. Each area is made for a different kind of fun.

The driving feels realistic, and you can buy new cars and improve them as you play. Race against computer drivers or simply drive around the city at your own pace. Real Cars in City uses the keyboard, so it is best on a computer. Kids who love cars will find plenty of ways to spend time behind the wheel here. Driving well against computer opponents takes some practice. Free driving is a relaxed way to start.
real-cars-in-city.how_to: Your goal depends on the mode: win races, escape in the police chase, survive the crash derby or just drive freely. Move with the Arrow Keys or W, A, S and D, press Shift for nitro and press C to change the camera view. Use your rewards to buy and upgrade cars.
tips: Save nitro for straight roads where you can use the extra speed.
Try the free ride area first to learn how the cars handle.
Switch the camera view with C if you can't see the road well.
Upgrade one car at a time to make it really strong.

faq.q: How many cars and tracks are in Real Cars in City?
faq.a: There are 20 sports cars and 36 racetracks.

faq.q: What are the controls in Real Cars in City?
faq.a: Use the Arrow Keys or W, A, S, D to drive, Shift for nitro and C to change the camera.

stickman-fighter-epic-battle.summary:
Your stickman hero walks into the arena, and a line of warriors is waiting. Stickman Fighter: Epic Battle is a simple fighting game where you hit to the left or right to beat each opponent. A health bar is always on screen, so you know how close you are to losing. Each win brings you closer to clearing the arena.

Every enemy is different, which keeps the fights interesting. The controls are easy: click or tap on one side of the screen, or use the arrow keys. That makes the game playable with a mouse, a keyboard or a touch screen. Stickman Fighter: Epic Battle is for older kids who like quick, cartoon-style action with stick figures. Quick reactions win most fights.
stickman-fighter-epic-battle.how_to: Your goal is to beat all the warriors you face. Stand in front of an opponent to start the fight, then click or touch the left or right side of the screen, or press the arrow keys, to hit in that direction. Keep an eye on your life bar so you don't run out of health.
tips: Hit toward the side where the enemy is coming from.
Don't tap wildly; missed hits can leave you open.
Watch each new enemy, since they all behave differently.
Check your life bar often during long fights.

faq.q: What are the controls in Stickman Fighter: Epic Battle?
faq.a: Click or touch the left or right side of the screen, or use the arrow keys, to hit.

faq.q: Can I play Stickman Fighter: Epic Battle with touch?
faq.a: Yes, you can tap the sides of the screen to fight.

egg-clicker.summary:
Every tap gives you eggs, and every egg brings you closer to a giant egg empire. Egg Clicker is a simple idle game where you collect eggs, spend them on upgrades and watch your collection grow faster and faster. The early game is all about tapping, but it quickly turns into planning.

There is more strategy than you might expect. Choosing the right upgrades at the right time makes a big difference, and new mechanics appear as you go. The game can also keep making progress while you are away. Egg Clicker is easy for anyone to pick up, and it is fun to come back and see how many eggs you have gathered. Watching your empire grow is the main reward.
egg-clicker.how_to: Your goal is to collect as many eggs as possible and build your egg empire. Tap or click to gather eggs, then invest them in upgrades that boost your earnings. Keep unlocking new options as your collection grows. A quick guide to the controls pops up when you begin. Check back often to see your progress.
tips: Buy upgrades that produce eggs automatically early on.
Compare prices before spending so you get the best boost.
Come back after a break to collect the eggs earned while you were away.
Try new mechanics as soon as they unlock.

faq.q: What is Egg Clicker?
faq.a: Egg Clicker is an idle clicker game where you collect eggs and buy upgrades to grow your egg empire.

faq.q: Does Egg Clicker keep going while I'm away?
faq.a: Yes, the game has offline progress, so eggs can keep adding up.

thumb-fighter.summary:
Two thumbs, one button each and a lot of laughing. Thumb Fighter is a silly action game built around one-button battles. You face off in thumb-to-thumb duels, and every clash is quick and funny. Rounds are over fast, so you can play again and again.

The best way to play is with a friend or family member, which makes Thumb Fighter a great party game. Since there is only one button to worry about, anyone can join in, no matter their age. Thumb Fighter is all about short, playful matches, so it is perfect for when you want a fast laugh together. Kids and grown-ups can play on equal terms, which makes it fair for everyone. Losing a round is never a big deal, because the next one starts right away.
thumb-fighter.how_to: Your goal is to win the thumb duel. Each player uses one button to attack, so time your presses to beat your opponent. The game shows which button each player uses when it starts, so check the first screen before the match. Get ready, press at the right time and see who wins.
tips: Time your button presses instead of mashing all the time.
Watch your opponent and strike when they are open.
Play a few rounds to learn the rhythm of the fight.
Have fun with it; this game is made for laughs.

faq.q: Can two players play Thumb Fighter?
faq.a: Yes, Thumb Fighter is made for duels with friends or family.

faq.q: How many buttons do you need in Thumb Fighter?
faq.a: Battles use just one button per player, so it is easy for anyone to play.

tactical-penguin.summary:
Pelicans are swooping in to steal the colony's fish, and the penguins need a defender. Tactical Penguin is a missile defense game where you launch penguins to stop the hungry birds before they grab the food. The penguins are counting on you to keep their food safe.

It is not just about firing fast. Blizzards and changing winds affect your shots, so you need good timing and smart aiming. The challenge keeps growing as more pelicans arrive. Tactical Penguin is a fun twist on a classic style of arcade game, and it is a good fit for kids who like strategy mixed with quick reactions. Every round tests how well you can plan and react at the same time. Good aim saves the day.
tactical-penguin.how_to: Your goal is to protect the penguin colony's fish from the pelicans. Launch penguins to hit the birds before they reach the food. Think about wind and snow when you aim. The controls appear on screen when the game begins, so check the first screen to learn how to launch. Stay calm.
tips: Aim a little ahead of the pelicans, since they keep moving.
Watch the wind and adjust your shots.
Stop the closest pelicans first.
Don't waste launches when no bird is near.

faq.q: What is Tactical Penguin about?
faq.a: You defend a penguin colony's fish supply by launching penguins at pelicans.

faq.q: Does the weather matter in Tactical Penguin?
faq.a: Yes, blizzards and shifting winds affect your launches.

money-rush.summary:
Run, choose and watch your pile of cash grow. Money Rush is an arcade game built on quick decisions. As you move forward, you pass through gates, and each gate changes how much money you have. Watching the money pile up is very satisfying.

The smart move is to pick the gates with the biggest multipliers. A good choice can make your fortune jump, while a poor one slows you down. Money Rush is easy to understand and fast to play, which makes it a good pick for kids who like simple games and a little bit of math in action. Each run only takes a short time, so it is easy to play again and try for a bigger fortune.
money-rush.how_to: Your goal is to collect as much money as possible. Move toward the gates with the highest multipliers and avoid the ones that cost you. Make your choices quickly as the gates come up. The controls are shown right at the start, so check how to move on the first screen.
tips: Read the numbers on each gate before choosing.
Multipliers usually beat small additions when you already have money.
Decide early so you have time to steer.
Try to beat your total on every new run.

faq.q: How do you play Money Rush?
faq.a: You move through gates and choose the ones with the highest multipliers to grow your money.

faq.q: Is Money Rush hard?
faq.a: It is simple, but it tests how quickly you can make good choices.

flip-bottle.summary:
Can you make a bottle flip and land standing up? Flip Bottle turns this popular trick into a simple casual game. You use the mouse to send the bottle spinning and hope it lands just right. Getting a perfect landing feels great. Practice makes perfect.

It takes a bit of practice to get the feel for how much power to use. Too much and the bottle falls over, too little and it doesn't turn enough. Flip Bottle is quick to play and easy to restart, making it a nice way to spend a few minutes and test your timing. There are no complicated rules, so even young players can enjoy it. It runs in your browser, so you can play right away.
flip-bottle.how_to: Your goal is to flip the bottle so it lands upright. Use the mouse to control your flip, and try to find the right amount of power. Keep practicing to land more flips in a row. Watch how the bottle spins in the air, and change your next flip based on what happened. Small changes make a big difference.
tips: Start with gentle flips and add power slowly.
Remember what worked on your last good flip.
Stay calm; rushing usually leads to a fall.
Try to land several flips in a row for a challenge.

faq.q: How do you play Flip Bottle?
faq.a: You use the mouse to flip a bottle and try to make it land standing up.

faq.q: Is Flip Bottle easy?
faq.a: It is easy to start, but landing the bottle every time takes practice.

fish-evolution.summary:
Put two fish together and something new swims out. Fish Evolution is a merge puzzle game where combining matching sea creatures turns them into new, more amazing ones. Each merge brings a surprise. You never know what the next fish will look like.

There is a strategy side, too, since you need to protect your watery world while you grow your collection. The ocean is full of bright colors and many different species to discover. Fish Evolution is a relaxed but thoughtful game for kids who like animals, collecting and seeing what happens next. Seeing each new creature appear is part of the reward. Planning which fish to merge next keeps your brain busy. It is a nice game to play at your own pace.
fish-evolution.how_to: Your goal is to merge fish to create new sea creatures and protect your underwater world. Combine matching fish to make them evolve, and plan your merges to keep growing. The controls are shown right at the start, so check the first screen to learn how to merge. Keep merging to see new species.
tips: Merge matching fish as soon as you can to free up space.
Plan ahead so you have pairs ready to combine.
Look out for new species and see what they can do.
Don't forget to protect your aquatic home while merging.

faq.q: How do you play Fish Evolution?
faq.a: You merge matching fish so they evolve into new sea creatures.

faq.q: Is Fish Evolution a puzzle game?
faq.a: Yes, it is a merge puzzle game with some strategy.

milk-the-cow.summary:
Life on the farm starts early, and the cows are waiting. In Milk the Cow, you tap quickly to milk the cows on a pretty farm. The faster you tap, the more milk you collect. The farm is bright and friendly.

Each level brings new challenges and bonuses that help you milk even faster. The controls are simple, and the cartoon cows are cute, so anyone can jump in. Milk the Cow is a light, cheerful game for younger players and anyone who likes quick tapping fun with a farm theme. It is a nice break between harder games, and the levels are short. You can always come back to try for a faster time. Getting quicker is the main challenge.
milk-the-cow.how_to: Your goal is to milk the cows as fast as you can. Tap or click quickly to fill up the milk, and use the bonuses each level gives you. Try to finish levels faster as you go. A quick guide to the controls pops up when you begin. Keep tapping and watch the milk fill up.
tips: Tap in a steady rhythm instead of in random bursts.
Use bonuses as soon as they show up.
Rest your hand between levels.
Try to beat your time on levels you already finished.

faq.q: How do you play Milk the Cow?
faq.a: You tap quickly to milk the cows and collect as much milk as possible.

faq.q: Is Milk the Cow good for young kids?
faq.a: Yes, the controls are simple and the farm theme is friendly.

pop-it-master.summary:
Pop, pop, pop. Pop It Master is a calm game all about pressing bubbles on colorful toys. Every click makes a satisfying pop, and there is no timer pushing you to hurry. Each toy looks different. Each pop is soft and satisfying.

There are 140 different toys to discover, and you can work on completing whole collections at your own speed. Pop It Master is a nice way to relax after school, take a break from harder games or just enjoy the simple feeling of popping bubbles. It is easy enough for anyone to play. Collecting all the toys gives you a long-term goal, while each single toy only takes a moment. There is no way to lose, so you can just enjoy the popping.
pop-it-master.how_to: Your goal is to pop all the bubbles on each toy and complete your collections. Click on the bubbles to pop them, then move on to the next toy. Take as much time as you like. The game explains its controls as soon as it starts. There are no time limits, so relax and pop.
tips: Pop the bubbles in a pattern to make sure you don't miss any.
Try to unlock all 140 toys over time.
Play at a slow pace if you want to relax.
Finish a collection before starting a new one.

faq.q: How many toys are in Pop It Master?
faq.a: There are 140 unique toys to discover.

faq.q: Is Pop It Master relaxing?
faq.a: Yes, it has no rush and is made for calm, stress-free popping.

halloween-hop.summary:
Spooky paths, hidden traps and plenty of candy fill Halloween Hop. You hop across eerie places, collecting sweets while trying not to fall into danger. Each jump needs good timing. Candy is waiting for you on the way. Watch out for traps on every path.

The game is all about rhythm and precise taps. Get into a steady beat and your character will bounce safely from spot to spot. Along the way there are festive surprises to find. Halloween Hop has a spooky look but plays like a fun jumping game, so it suits kids who enjoy Halloween and quick reflex challenges. The levels are short, so you can try again quickly after a mistake. Collecting candy makes every run feel rewarding. It is fun in any season.
halloween-hop.how_to: Your goal is to hop across the landscape, avoid traps and collect candy. Tap at the right moments to jump, and try to keep a steady rhythm. The game explains its controls as soon as it starts, so check the first screen before your first jump. Look ahead to see where the next safe spot is.
tips: Find a rhythm and keep your taps steady.
Look ahead for traps before you jump.
Grab candy when it is safely on your path.
Take a breath and restart if you lose your timing.

faq.q: What is Halloween Hop?
faq.a: It is a Halloween jumping game where you hop across spooky places, avoid traps and collect candy.

faq.q: Is Halloween Hop scary?
faq.a: It has a spooky theme, but the gameplay is about jumping and collecting candy.

concrete-boots.summary:
Concrete Boots is a strategy game set in a gritty gangster world. You run an underground business, try to grow it and keep a step ahead of both rival gangs and the police. Managing your resources is a big part of the job. Every choice can change the balance of power.

This is a game about planning rather than fast action. You decide where to expand, how to handle rivals and when to play it safe. Because of its crime theme, Concrete Boots fits older players best. Those who like management games and careful decisions will find plenty to think about. The game is slow and thoughtful, so you can take your time with each decision. Getting ahead of rivals is very rewarding.
concrete-boots.how_to: Your goal is to grow your empire while outsmarting rivals and the police. Manage your resources, plan your moves and expand step by step. You will see the controls on the first screen, so read the first screens to learn how the menus work. Watch your resources and plan carefully. There is no rush.
tips: Grow slowly at first so you don't run out of resources.
Keep an eye on your rivals and plan around them.
Avoid drawing too much attention from the police.
Think a few turns ahead before making big moves.

faq.q: What kind of game is Concrete Boots?
faq.a: It is a strategy and management game with a mafia theme.

faq.q: Is Concrete Boots for kids?
faq.a: Because of its crime theme, it is better for older players.

alpha-guns.summary:
Meet Max, a hero ready for tough missions. Alpha Guns is an action shooter where you take on challenging enemies, improve your weapons and work through intense levels. Good aim and smart tactics both matter. Each level brings tougher enemies. Max is ready for action.

If a mission doesn't go as planned, you can replay earlier ones to try a better strategy. Upgrading your weapons helps with harder fights later on. Alpha Guns is aimed at older kids who like action games and want a challenge that rewards practice and careful play. Missions get harder as you go, so steady progress and better weapons go hand in hand. It is a game where practice really shows. Getting through a hard mission feels great.
alpha-guns.how_to: Your goal is to complete each mission as Max and defeat your enemies. Aim carefully, think about tactics, and upgrade your weapons between levels. Replay old missions to improve. The game explains its controls as soon as it starts, so check the first screen to learn how to move and shoot. Keep practicing.
tips: Upgrade your weapons whenever you can afford it.
Take careful aim instead of shooting at random.
Replay earlier missions to practice and improve your strategy.
Watch how enemies move before you attack.

faq.q: Who do you play as in Alpha Guns?
faq.a: You play as a hero named Max.

faq.q: Can I replay missions in Alpha Guns?
faq.a: Yes, you can replay past missions to improve your strategy.

mineclicker.summary:
Blocks, monsters and a lot of clicking: that is MineClicker. In this blocky adventure, every click either hits a mob or digs up resources. The more you gather, the more you can upgrade, and the stronger your clicks become. There is always something to upgrade.

You can also recruit helpers who work for you, which brings an idle side to the game. Levels get harder as you go, and boss battles come with a timer, so you have to deal enough damage before time runs out. MineClicker mixes fast clicking with smart upgrade choices, and it is a good pick for kids who like block-style worlds and watching their power grow. Each new level brings stronger mobs and better rewards.
mineclicker.how_to: Your goal is to defeat mobs, mine resources and move through tougher levels. Click to attack and collect, spend what you earn on upgrades and recruit helpers. In boss battles, beat the boss before the timer runs out. The controls are shown right at the start. Keep upgrading. Then keep clicking.
tips: Upgrade your click power early so mobs go down faster.
Hire helpers to keep resources coming while you focus on fights.
Collect as much as you can on a level before moving on.
Get stronger before a boss fight so the timer isn't a problem.

faq.q: How do you play MineClicker?
faq.a: You click to fight mobs and mine resources, then use them for upgrades and helpers.

faq.q: Does MineClicker have boss fights?
faq.a: Yes, there are boss battles with a timer.

vortelli-s-pizza-delivery.summary:
The pizzas are hot, the customers are hungry and the clock is ticking. In Vortelli's Pizza Delivery, you drive through busy streets and try to get every order to the door on time. Drifting around corners helps you save precious seconds. Every second counts.

Traffic and tricky obstacles stand in your way, so you need to find the right mix of speed and care. Happy customers mean better rewards, and bumping into everything won't help. Vortelli's Pizza Delivery is a fun racing game with a tasty twist, perfect for kids who like driving games with a clear mission. Learning the roads helps you find faster routes over time. Each delivery is a small race against the clock. Customers love fast delivery.
vortelli-s-pizza-delivery.how_to: Your goal is to deliver pizzas quickly and keep customers happy. Drive through the city, use drifts to take corners fast and avoid traffic and obstacles. You will see the controls on the first screen, so check the first screen to learn how to drive and drift. Get there fast and safely.
tips: Plan your route to the customer before speeding off.
Drift around sharp corners instead of slowing down too much.
Avoid crashes, since they cost you time.
Don't drive too wild; careful driving keeps customers happy.

faq.q: What is Vortelli's Pizza Delivery about?
faq.a: You drive around the city and deliver hot pizzas to customers before time runs out.

faq.q: Can you drift in Vortelli's Pizza Delivery?
faq.a: Yes, drifting is an important skill for getting around corners fast.

mysolar.summary:
In mySolar, you are in charge of your very own solar system. You collect points, grow your system and take part in space battles against rival solar systems. Every choice you make shapes how strong your corner of space becomes. It is a big job for a young space ruler.

The game is a mix of arcade action and planning. You need to manage your resources well and decide when to grow and when to fight. mySolar is a good fit for kids who love space and enjoy games where thinking ahead pays off. Every battle you win helps your system grow. Exploring the stars can also reveal new chances to collect points. Growing from a small system to a big empire is the main reward.
mysolar.how_to: Your goal is to grow your solar system and defeat rival solars. Collect points to expand, manage your resources and battle other systems. The controls are shown right at the start, so check the first screen to learn how to move and fight. Grow step by step. Then keep expanding your system.
tips: Grow your system before picking big fights.
Keep an eye on your resources so you don't run out.
Attack rivals that are smaller than you first.
Explore to find more points to collect.

faq.q: What do you do in mySolar?
faq.a: You build and run a solar system of your own, gather points and battle rival solars.

faq.q: Is mySolar a strategy game?
faq.a: It mixes arcade action with strategy and resource management.

ice-bricks.summary:
A snowball is bouncing around, and it is up to you to keep it in play. Ice Bricks is a frosty arcade game in the style of classic brick breakers, with icy obstacles and a cool winter look. Each hit sends the snowball zooming in a new direction.

You can play alone or face a friend in a two-player duel, where you try to outplay each other with smart shots. The challenge keeps rising as you go, so quick reflexes and good aim are a must. Ice Bricks is great for kids who like old-school arcade games and want something they can share with a friend. The icy theme makes it a fun winter game, but you can play it any time of year.
ice-bricks.how_to: Your goal is to control the bouncing snowball and outplay the challenge or your opponent. Keep the snowball moving, break through obstacles and aim your bounces carefully. The game explains its controls as soon as it starts, including the keys for two players. Practice alone first, then challenge a friend once you feel ready.

tile-jumper-3d.summary:

runaway-toad.summary:

Each merge takes you further into a beautiful universe. You need a bit of strategy to plan good merges, but there is no rush. Planet Merge is great for kids who love space and want a calm game with satisfying results. It is a nice game for winding down at the end of the day. Exploring the universe one merge at a time feels very peaceful. There is always another planet to make. Space fans will love it. There is no wrong way to enjoy it.
planet-merge.how_to: Your goal is to merge matching planets to create new, more powerful ones. Plan your merges carefully to keep growing. The controls appear on screen when the game begins, so check the first screen to learn how to combine planets. Keep merging to discover new celestial wonders, and enjoy the calm pace of the game.
tips: Keep matching planets close together.
Plan ahead so you don't run out of space.
Aim for bigger planets with each merge.
Take your time; there is no hurry.

faq.q: How do you play Planet Merge?
faq.a: You merge matching planets to create new, more powerful ones.

faq.q: Is Planet Merge relaxing?
faq.a: Yes, it is a calm puzzle game with no rush.

klondike-solitaire-paradise.summary:
Klondike Solitaire Paradise is a calm card game built on the most famous kind of solitaire. Your job is to sort a full deck into four piles, one for each suit, starting with the ace and finishing with the king. Cards on the table are stacked in columns, and you can only place a card on one that is one rank higher and of the other color.

What makes Klondike Solitaire Paradise a bit tougher is that it deals three cards at a time from the stock, so the card you need is sometimes hidden under two others. That means you have to plan a little and not grab every move right away. It runs in your web browser with no download, so it is easy to start a quick round. If you like thinking games where patience matters more than speed, Klondike Solitaire Paradise is a relaxing pick.
klondike-solitaire-paradise.how_to: The goal is to move all 52 cards to the four foundation piles, sorted by suit from ace up to king. In the columns, stack cards in falling order with red and black taking turns. When you run out of moves, draw from the stock pile, which turns over three cards at once. The game shows how to pick up and move cards when it starts.
tips: Turn over face-down cards in the columns as early as you can, because they hide the cards you need.
Move aces and twos to the foundation piles right away.
Only put a king into an empty column, since nothing else can start one.
Before drawing from the stock, check the table for a move you might have missed.

faq.q: How do you win Klondike Solitaire Paradise?
faq.a: You win when all four suits are built up from ace to king on the foundation piles.

faq.q: Why is the three-card draw harder?
faq.a: Only the top card of each three is playable, so cards can stay buried longer and you need to plan ahead.

faq.q: Can I play it on a phone?
faq.a: The game runs in a browser and its makers say it works on many devices, so you can try it on a phone or tablet.

stickman-epic.summary:
Stickman Epic is an action adventure where a tiny stick hero takes on big fights. Before you start, you pick one of three characters, and each one plays a little differently. As you win, you can improve their armor so they can take more hits in later battles.

The adventure is split into 15 levels, and some of them end with a tricky boss who needs more than button mashing to beat. Each hero also has special abilities, so a big part of Stickman Epic is learning when to use them instead of wasting them early. The world has a colorful pixel style that keeps things light even when the fights get tough. If you enjoy short levels, steady upgrades and boss battles, Stickman Epic gives you a clear goal: get your stickman through every stage and beat each boss on the way.
stickman-epic.how_to: Choose one of the three stickman heroes and fight your way through the levels. Defeat the enemies in each stage, save your special abilities for dangerous moments, and use what you earn to upgrade armor. Bosses wait at key points, so learn their attacks before going all in. The game explains its controls as soon as it starts.
tips: Try each of the three characters to find the one that fits how you like to play.
Upgrade armor before a boss level so you can survive a few extra hits.
Watch a boss for a while to learn its attack pattern before rushing in.
Keep a special ability ready for when enemies crowd around you.

faq.q: How many levels does Stickman Epic have?
faq.a: The game has 15 levels to fight through.

faq.q: Can I choose my character in Stickman Epic?
faq.a: Yes, you can pick one of three different stickman heroes.

faq.q: Can I play it on a phone?
faq.a: It runs in the browser, so you can try it on a phone or tablet, but touch support isn't confirmed, so a computer is the safest choice.

noob-playground.summary:
Noob Playground is a sandbox, which means there is no mission to finish and no clock ticking. You get a play area, a set of crash-test dummies and a pile of wild toys, and then it is up to you what happens next. Want to see what happens when a dummy meets a strange gadget? Try it and watch.

That freedom is the whole point of Noob Playground. Some players build silly setups, others just spawn things and enjoy the chaos, and nobody tells you that you are doing it wrong. Because there are no levels to clear, a short session can be as fun as a long one. Noob Playground suits kids who like experimenting and making up their own games inside a game. If you have ever wanted a toy box where breaking things is allowed, this is it.
noob-playground.how_to: There is no fixed goal in this sandbox. Spawn crash-test dummies and the different toys and gadgets, place them around the playground, and see how they react to each other. Mix things up to create funny chain reactions. The game shows how to pick and place items when it starts.
tips: Try one new toy at a time so you can see exactly what it does.
Set up a chain of objects and trigger the first one to see how far the chaos goes.
Give yourself small challenges, like launching a dummy as far as possible.
If the screen gets too messy, clear it and start fresh.

faq.q: Is there a goal in Noob Playground?
faq.a: No, it is a free sandbox with no tasks, so you make your own fun.

faq.q: What can you do in Noob Playground?
faq.a: You can summon crash-test dummies and use many destructive toys to experiment.

italian-brainrot-coloring.summary:
Italian Brainrot Coloring turns the silly Italian brainrot characters into pictures you can fill with color. There are 12 drawings to choose from and a palette of 15 bright colors, so you can make the same picture look totally different each time.

You can also change the brush size. A big brush is handy for filling large areas quickly, and a small one helps with the tiny details near the lines. There is no timer and no score, so Italian Brainrot Coloring is a relaxed way to spend a few minutes being creative. It works well for younger kids who are just learning to color neatly, and older players can try wild color ideas just for fun. Once you finish one picture, pick another from the set and keep going. Italian Brainrot Coloring is simple, calm and all about your own style.
italian-brainrot-coloring.how_to: Pick one of the 12 pictures, choose a color from the 15 on offer and start painting. Change the brush size when you need to switch between big areas and small details. There is no time limit, so finish whenever you like. The game shows how to pick colors and paint when it starts.
tips: Fill the big areas first with a large brush, then switch to a small one for details.
Try an unusual color scheme, like a purple shark or a green banana.
Pick colors that sit next to each other in the palette for a calm look.
Zoom in with your eyes on the edges and go slowly near the lines.

faq.q: How many pictures are in Italian Brainrot Coloring?
faq.a: There are 12 illustrations to color.

faq.q: Can I change the brush size?
faq.a: Yes, you can make the brush bigger or smaller to color large areas or fine details.

faq.q: Is there a time limit?
faq.a: No, you can color at your own pace.

skateboard-surf.summary:
Skateboard Surf is an endless running game set on a busy street. You ride your skateboard forward, dodge the obstacles in your way and grab as many coins as you can. The longer you last, the higher your score climbs.

One nice twist: losing your board does not end the run right away. Your character keeps going on foot, so you still have a chance to keep the score growing. That makes Skateboard Surf a bit more forgiving than many runners, but the street keeps throwing new obstacles at you. On a computer you use the arrow keys, and on a touch screen you swipe, which makes it easy to play anywhere. Every run is a new chance to beat your best score, and Skateboard Surf is great for quick sessions when you only have a few minutes.
skateboard-surf.how_to: Your goal is to travel as far as possible and collect coins along the way. Use the arrow keys on a keyboard, or swipe on a touch screen, to jump over obstacles and dive under them. If you lose your skateboard, keep running on foot. The run ends when you crash for good.
tips: Keep your eyes a little ahead of your character so you can react early.
Don't chase every coin if it means jumping into an obstacle.
After losing your board, play extra carefully to stretch the run.
Use short practice runs to learn which moves work for each obstacle.

faq.q: What are the controls in Skateboard Surf?
faq.a: Use the arrow keys to jump and dive, or swipe if you play on a touch screen.

faq.q: What happens if I lose my skateboard?
faq.a: You can keep running on foot, so the game goes on.

faq.q: Can I play Skateboard Surf on my phone?
faq.a: Yes, the game supports swiping, so it can be played on touch screens.

tetra-blocks.summary:
Tetra Blocks is a block puzzle that mixes a classic grid game with a bit of sudoku thinking. You drag pieces onto a 9 by 9 board and clear them by filling a full row, a full column or one of the 3 by 3 squares. Every clear makes room for the next pieces.

There are two ways to play Tetra Blocks. In Challenge mode, the board hides special star blocks, and your goal is to collect all of them by clearing the lines they sit in. In High score mode there is no target, just you trying to rack up as many points as you can before the board fills. That makes Tetra Blocks good for both short focused puzzles and longer relaxed sessions. It rewards planning: the best players always leave space for the awkward shapes that are coming.
tetra-blocks.how_to: Drag each block onto the board and drop it in a free spot. Fill a whole row of 9, a whole column of 9 or a 3 by 3 square to clear it. In Challenge mode, clear the lines that hold the star blocks to collect them all. In High score mode, keep clearing to earn points.
tips: Keep the middle of the board open, because big pieces need space.
Try to clear a row and a square at the same time for a bigger clear.
Place awkward shapes along the edges first.
In Challenge mode, focus on the lines with star blocks instead of random clears.

faq.q: How do you clear blocks in Tetra Blocks?
faq.a: Fill a full row, a full column or a 3 by 3 square, and those blocks disappear.

faq.q: What game modes are in Tetra Blocks?
faq.a: There is a Challenge mode with star blocks to collect and a High score mode.

trimat.summary:
Trimat is a quick space arcade game that tests how fast you can react. Lasers, bombs and other dangers fill each level, and your job is to slip past them without getting hit. It looks simple, but the obstacles follow patterns that get trickier as you go.

The key to Trimat is timing. Instead of panicking, watch how each danger moves, find the gap and go. You play by tapping or clicking, so the controls are easy to learn and all the challenge comes from your reflexes. Short levels make it easy to try again after a mistake, and each attempt teaches you a bit more about the rhythm of the stage. If you like arcade games where you feel yourself getting better with every try, Trimat is a fun little challenge set in a cosmic world.
trimat.how_to: Your goal is to get through each level without touching the lasers, bombs and other hazards. Tap or click to move and dodge at the right moment. Watch how each obstacle moves before you go, and pick the safest gap. If you get hit, try the level again. Short levels make retries quick.
tips: Wait a moment at the start of a level to see the obstacle pattern.
Most hazards repeat, so count the beats between them.
Don't rush: a well-timed move beats a fast one.
If one part keeps beating you, focus only on that part next try.

faq.q: How do you control Trimat?
faq.a: You tap or click to move and dodge the obstacles.

faq.q: What kind of game is Trimat?
faq.a: It is a fast arcade game set in space where you avoid lasers, bombs and other hazards.

santa-haircut.summary:
In Santa Haircut, Santa Claus gets ready for the holidays in your salon. You can style his hair, try different colors and then dress him in holiday clothes and add fun extras to finish the look. Want a classic Santa or something totally wild? It is your call.

There is no timer and no score, so Santa Haircut is a relaxed dress-up game where experimenting is the goal. Try one style, change your mind and try another. The cheerful Christmas setting makes it a nice pick for the winter season, but it is fun any time of year. Younger kids can enjoy simply trying things out, while older players can aim for a perfect themed look. Santa Haircut is about creativity, not winning, so every result is a good one.
santa-haircut.how_to: Start by styling and coloring Santa's hair any way you like. Then dress him in holiday clothes and extras to complete his holiday look. There is no time limit, so take as long as you want and change things as often as you like. The game shows how to use each tool when it starts.
tips: Decide on a theme first, like snowy, classic red or rainbow Santa.
Try a hair color that matches the outfit for a neat look.
Experiment freely, since you can always change things back.
Finish with accessories, as they can change the whole style.

faq.q: What do you do in Santa Haircut?
faq.a: You style and color Santa's hair, then dress him in holiday clothes and extras.

faq.q: Is there a time limit in Santa Haircut?
faq.a: No, you can take your time and experiment.

chicken-math.summary:
Chicken Math is a gentle learning game where cute chickens help you practice adding and subtracting. As the chickens move around, you work out simple sums, so the numbers feel like part of a story instead of a worksheet.

The game keeps things easy on purpose. It is aimed at young learners who are just getting used to numbers, and it also suits children in special education who benefit from a calm pace. Because the math is simple, kids can focus on understanding what adding and taking away really mean. Chicken Math is a nice way to practice a few problems at home or as a short break from school work. Parents can play along and talk about each answer together. With friendly characters and no pressure, Chicken Math helps make early math feel friendly.
chicken-math.how_to: Watch the chickens and solve the simple addition and subtraction problems the game shows you. Count how many chickens join or leave, then choose the right answer. Take your time, since the goal is to learn, not to rush. The game shows how to answer when it starts. There is no rush at all.
tips: Count the chickens out loud if it helps you keep track.
Remember that adding means more chickens and subtracting means fewer.
Use your fingers to check an answer before you pick it.
Play a few rounds each day instead of many at once.

faq.q: What age is Chicken Math for?
faq.a: It is made for young learners who are starting with addition and subtraction.

faq.q: What math does Chicken Math teach?
faq.a: It practices simple addition and subtraction.

sigma-clicker.summary:
Sigma Clicker is a clicker game where every tap earns you sigmas, the game's currency. At first you collect them one by one, but you can spend them on upgrades that make each click worth more. Soon the numbers start to climb much faster.

The fun of Sigma Clicker is in the choices. Should you buy a cheap upgrade now or save up for a stronger one? Picking well makes your progress speed up a lot. The rules are very simple, so you can start right away, and there is always another goal just ahead. Clicker games like this one are great for short breaks, because even a few minutes of tapping moves you forward. If you enjoy watching numbers grow and planning the next upgrade, Sigma Clicker has plenty to keep you busy.
sigma-clicker.how_to: Click or tap to collect sigmas. Spend them on upgrades that boost how many sigmas you get, then keep clicking to afford even bigger upgrades. Your goal is to grow your total as high as possible. The game shows where the upgrade buttons are when you start. Keep going to unlock stronger boosts.
tips: Buy a few cheap upgrades early to speed things up.
Compare the price and the boost before buying.
Save up for a big upgrade when the small ones stop helping much.
Take short breaks between tapping sessions to rest your fingers.

faq.q: How do you play Sigma Clicker?
faq.a: Click to collect sigmas and spend them on upgrades that make each click stronger.

faq.q: What are sigmas?
faq.a: Sigmas are the points you collect and spend in the game.

animal-clicker.summary:
