faq.a: Yes, the battles are turn-based.

bug-match.summary:
Bug Match is a match-three puzzle full of colorful insects. You swap neighboring bugs so at least three matching insects line up, and each match clears them away.

The clock is always running in Bug Match, so speed matters. Smart matches can earn you bonus time, and combos look great as the board lights up. As you keep going, the challenge gets tougher, so you need to spot good moves faster. It is a fun twist on the classic match-three idea, with a buggy theme that kids will enjoy. Quick rounds make it a nice game for short breaks. The key question is simple: how many insects will you clear before the clock hits zero? If you like fast puzzles, Bug Match is a buzzing good time.
bug-match.how_to: Swap two neighboring bugs so three or more matching insects line up. Matching clears them from the board and scores points. Make strategic matches to earn bonus time and keep the game going. Try to match as many bugs as possible before the timer ends. The game shows how to swap when it starts.

faq.a: Swap bugs so at least three matching insects line up.

faq.a: Yes, you play against a clock, but good matches can earn bonus time.

swing-up.summary:
Swing Up is a simple tap game about climbing higher. Each tap sends you swinging toward the sky, and obstacles try to stop your progress.

The goal in Swing Up is to go as high as you can and set a new high score. That needs good timing and steady reflexes, because a tap at the wrong moment can send you straight into trouble. The colorful look keeps things cheerful even when the game gets tough. It is easy to learn, which makes it good for short breaks, but getting really far takes practice. Every run teaches you a little more about the timing. If you like one-tap challenges and enjoy trying to climb a leaderboard, Swing Up is a fun game to play again and again.
swing-up.how_to: Tap to swing toward the top and keep climbing. Avoid the obstacles in your path by tapping at the right time. Each run ends when you hit something, so try to climb a little higher every time. Watch the obstacles closely and stay calm as you go. Practice will help your timing get better.

faq.q: What is the goal of Swing Up?
faq.a: Climb as high as possible for a high score.

pro-basket.summary:
Pro Basket is a basketball shooting game where your goal is to sink perfect shots. You aim, adjust and release, trying to get the ball in the hoop again and again.

The controls in Pro Basket are simple: tap, drag and let go. The fun is in learning exactly how far to pull for each shot. As you play, you earn points that can be spent in the shop on features that improve your game. There are achievements to unlock, which give you extra goals beyond just scoring. Each session feels like a mix of practice and progress, since you get better at aiming while also unlocking new things. If you like basketball and enjoy games where skill slowly improves with practice, Pro Basket is a good fit.
pro-basket.how_to: Touch the ball, pull back and let go to shoot. Adjust how far and in which direction you drag to aim each shot. surfer-cat.summary:
Surfer Cat stars a cat riding the waves on a surfboard. Out on the ocean, you collect seashells and dodge colorful obstacles that pop up in your way.

The waves in Surfer Cat move and sway, so staying balanced and in control is part of the challenge. As you keep going, the difficulty grows, and you need sharp reflexes to keep the ride going. The happy music and bright visuals make it a cheerful game, perfect for kids who love animals and the beach. Collecting shells gives you a goal on each run, and dodging obstacles keeps you focused. If you want a fun, relaxed adventure with a bit of challenge, Surfer Cat is a breezy choice for a short play break.
surfer-cat.how_to: Surf with your cat, collect seashells and avoid the marine obstacles. Move with the rhythm of the waves and react quickly when something appears ahead. tricky-test.summary:
Tricky Test is a puzzle game that loves to trick you. The answers are often not what you expect, so you need to think in unusual ways to solve each challenge.

Some puzzles in Tricky Test can be solved by shaking or tilting things, and you collect coins along the way. A playful story connects the challenges, and cute animations make every solution fun to watch. The game rewards curiosity: try touching or moving different things on screen, because the obvious answer is often wrong. It is a great game for kids who like riddles and brain teasers, and it can be fun to solve together with friends or family. If you enjoy puzzles that make you laugh and say "I should have known," Tricky Test is a good pick.

cookie-master.summary:
Cookie Master lets you run your own little bakery. You bake and decorate different kinds of cookies, then sell them to customers who each have their own wishes.

The secret to success in Cookie Master is listening to your customers. If your cookie matches what they asked for, they are happy, and you grow as a baker. As you progress, you unlock more advanced tools that let you personalize your treats even more. That means your cookies can get fancier and more creative over time. If you love baking and decorating, Cookie Master is a sweet way to be creative.

hex-wars.summary:
Hex Wars is a 3D strategy game where you start as a lone soldier and slowly build up your power. The world is split into hexagon tiles, and your goal is to grow your territory step by step.

In Hex Wars, balance is everything. You harvest resources, build important structures and expand into new tiles, all while computer-controlled enemies try to stop you. Grow too fast and you might leave yourself weak; grow too slowly and enemies get ahead. Using your strength wisely lets you take back land and reach safety. It is a thoughtful game that rewards planning over rushing. If you like strategy games where you start small and build something big, Hex Wars offers a satisfying journey from one soldier to a strong territory.

shark-killer.summary:
Shark Killer puts you in charge of a shark trying to become the top predator of the sea. Gulp down little fish to grow stronger and heal, and stay away from anything bigger than you.

The ocean in Shark Killer is full of color, but also danger. Larger creatures can hurt you, so you need quick reflexes to dodge them and smart planning to choose what to chase. It is a simple idea that keeps you on your toes, and every round is a chance to grow larger than before. If you like ocean games where you start small and grow strong, Shark Killer is a fun dive.

cat-mart.summary:
Cat Mart lets you run a supermarket where everyone is a cat. Cute cat workers stock the shelves, and cat customers stroll in to shop, and you are the boss who keeps it all running.

Managing Cat Mart means juggling a few jobs at once. You need to keep supplies on the shelves, make sure the store runs smoothly and decide when to expand. doctor-teeth.summary:
Doctor Teeth puts you in the dentist's chair, but this time you are the one holding the tools. Patients arrive with tooth troubles, and it is up to you to make their smiles shine again.

The game is made up of quick mini-games. You use different dental tools, fight off nasty germs and fix problems one step at a time. Doctor Teeth makes visiting the dentist feel fun instead of scary, and it can even help kids understand why brushing and checkups matter. The bright visuals keep everything friendly. If you like pretend-play games about helping others, Doctor Teeth is a cheerful way to become a dental hero and send each patient home with a perfect smile.

faq.a: You act as a dentist, use tools, fight germs and fix patients' teeth.

metro-escape.summary:
Metro Escape is a mystery escape game set in a dark subway station. You are trapped, and the only way out is to search, think and solve your way through.

The station hides lots of secrets. You need to find hidden items, figure out how they help and solve puzzles and riddles to move forward. Metro Escape rewards careful players who look everywhere and think about how clues connect. It suits older kids and teens who enjoy mysteries and escape-room style puzzles. animal-racing.summary:
Animal Racing is a cheerful racing game where cute animals are the drivers. You pick your favorite animal racer and zoom along bright, colorful tracks.

snowboard-girl.summary:
Snowboard Girl takes you to snowy slopes for a fast ride downhill. You guide a snowboarder down the mountain, staying on your board and steering clear of dangers.

The obstacles in Snowboard Girl can end a run fast, so you need to watch ahead and react in time. Keeping your balance is important, and picking up speed helps you go farther. train-master.summary:
Train Master is a puzzle game where you drive a train and pick up passengers. It sounds relaxing, but there is one rule that keeps you alert: no crashes. Cars and people cross the tracks, and you have to avoid hitting them.

pew-pew-dose.summary:

taxi-pick-up.summary:

running-dino.summary:
Running Dino sends you dashing through prehistoric lands as a quick little dinosaur. Predators are on the hunt, and obstacles block your way, so you need to keep running and stay sharp.

faq.a: No, it is a solo cycling challenge.

bell-madness.summary:
Bell Madness is a goofy 2D arcade game about ringing doorbells and annoying the neighbors. You play the prankster, and your job is to mix up bell-ringing combos to see how the people inside react.

The reactions are the best part of Bell Madness. Some neighbors get grumpy, some get funny, and some reactions are downright explosive. There are many combos to try, so it pays to experiment and see what happens. Since it is just a game, there are no real consequences, only laughs. The quick wit and creativity you bring decide how wild things get. It is a light and silly game that is fun for short sessions. If you like games with a playful sense of humor, Bell Madness is a cheeky way to have fun (just keep the pranks inside the game).
bell-madness.how_to: Ring doorbells in different combinations and watch how the neighbors react. Try out lots of combos to discover new and funny reactions. Be creative and experiment, since each choice can lead to a different result. You will see the controls on the first screen, so check them before your first prank.
tips: Try a new combo each time to see more reactions.
Keep track of combos that cause the funniest results.
Mix fast and slow ringing.
Remember: pranks stay in the game, not on real neighbors.

faq.q: What do you do in Bell Madness?
faq.a: You ring doorbells in different combos to see the neighbors' funny reactions.

faq.q: Is Bell Madness a 2D game?
faq.a: Yes, it is a 2D arcade game.

junior-chess.summary:
Junior Chess is a friendly way to learn and practice chess. You play against a computer opponent, and you can set the difficulty so the game is not too easy and not too hard.

A helpful feature in Junior Chess shows you where pieces can move. That makes it great for beginners who are still remembering how each piece works, and it helps you think about your options before committing. As you get better, you can raise the difficulty and try to outsmart a tougher opponent. Planning ahead and capturing pieces with smart moves are the keys to winning. The game runs on many devices, so you can practice wherever you are. If you want to grow your chess skills step by step, Junior Chess is a patient teacher.
junior-chess.how_to: Play chess against the computer. Choose a difficulty that fits your level. Select a piece to see where it can move, then plan your move. Try to capture your opponent's pieces and checkmate their king. Raise the difficulty as you improve. The game shows how to select and move pieces when it starts.
tips: Start on an easy setting and move up slowly.
Use the move hints to learn how each piece moves.
Protect your king before going on the attack.
Think about what your opponent can do after your move.

faq.q: Is Junior Chess good for beginners?
faq.a: Yes, it shows possible moves and lets you choose an easy difficulty.

faq.q: Can you change the difficulty in Junior Chess?
faq.a: Yes, you can adjust the difficulty.

faq.q: Can I play Junior Chess on a phone?
faq.a: Its makers say it works on any device, so you can try it on a phone or tablet.

froggee.summary:
Froggee is a quick jumping game starring a hungry frog. The ponds spin, and you need to hop from place to place to grab tasty treats without falling in.

Timing is everything in Froggee. Jump too early or too late and the spinning pond will throw you off. Each successful hop brings you closer to the next snack, and the game rewards careful, precise leaps. Rounds are short, which makes it easy to keep trying after a slip. The bright colors and cute frog make it a fun pick for kids, while the timing challenge keeps older players interested too. Once you get the rhythm of the spinning ponds, the game becomes really satisfying. If you like quick reflex games, Froggee is a fun one to hop into.
froggee.how_to: Make your frog jump across spinning ponds to collect treats. Watch the spin and time each jump carefully so you land safely. A badly timed jump means a fall. Keep going and try to grab as many treats as you can. You will see the controls on the first screen, so check them first.
tips: Watch one full spin before you jump.
Jump when your landing spot is coming toward you.
Don't rush, since timing beats speed.
Try again quickly after a fall to keep the rhythm.

faq.q: What do you do in Froggee?
faq.a: You jump across spinning ponds to collect treats.

faq.q: Is Froggee hard?
faq.a: It needs precise timing, but rounds are short and easy to retry.

fruit-clicker.summary:
Fruit Clicker is a pixel-art clicker game where every tap earns you FruitCoins. Collect enough and you can unlock all sorts of upgrades that speed up your progress.

The pixel style gives Fruit Clicker a retro feel, but the game plays like a modern clicker. You decide where to spend your FruitCoins: on stronger clicks, on power-ups or on other boosts. Smart choices make your coin pile grow much faster. Keep going, and you may discover hidden treasures tucked into the game as a reward for sticking with it. Like most clickers, it is easy to play in short bursts, and you can always see progress. If you enjoy watching numbers grow and planning upgrades, Fruit Clicker is a fun, fruity way to spend a few minutes.
fruit-clicker.how_to: Click or tap to collect FruitCoins. Spend them on upgrades and power-ups that help you earn more. Plan your purchases to grow your coins as fast as possible. Keep playing to find hidden treasures and keep your coin total climbing. The game shows where to click and how to buy upgrades when it starts.
tips: Buy upgrades that boost each click early on.
Compare costs before spending FruitCoins.
Save up for bigger power-ups when small ones stop helping.
Keep playing to uncover hidden treasures.

faq.q: What are FruitCoins in Fruit Clicker?
faq.a: FruitCoins are the currency you earn by clicking and spend on upgrades.

faq.q: Does Fruit Clicker have upgrades?
faq.a: Yes, you can unlock upgrades and power-ups.

italian-brainrot-clicker-game.summary:
Italian Brainrot Clicker Game is a fast and silly clicker based on the Italian brainrot meme characters. The more you click, the more you discover in this strange and funny world.

Along the way you meet odd characters, such as Orangotan Pineapple or Bananini Chimpanzini, which is half the fun for anyone who knows the memes. The game is all about speed, so quick clicking pushes you forward and tests your reflexes. It is chaotic, colorful and not meant to be taken seriously. The simple rules make it easy for anyone to start right away, and short sessions are perfect for a quick laugh. If you like meme humor and clicker games, Italian Brainrot Clicker Game mixes both into one wild and goofy package. How fast can your fingers go in Italian Brainrot Clicker Game?
italian-brainrot-clicker-game.how_to: Click as quickly as you can to move forward and meet the strange Italian brainrot characters. The faster you click, the more progress you make. Keep an eye on the screen to see new characters appear. The game shows any extra controls and upgrades when it starts, so take a quick look.
tips: Use quick, steady clicks rather than random bursts.
Take short breaks to rest your hand.
Watch for new characters as you progress.
Try to beat your own speed each session.

faq.q: Which characters are in Italian Brainrot Clicker Game?
faq.a: You meet odd characters, for example Orangotan Pineapple or Bananini Chimpanzini.

faq.q: How do you play Italian Brainrot Clicker Game?
faq.a: Click rapidly to make progress in the brainrot world.

valiant-knight.summary:
Valiant Knight follows a brave but rather poor knight who hopes a princess will fall for him. To prove himself, he sets out on a quest full of coins, traps and hidden secrets.

Each level in Valiant Knight asks you to collect coins while staying away from sharp spikes and other dangers. Some traps are hard to see, and turning barrels add extra trouble, so you need to watch carefully. Exploring pays off, because there are hidden treasures to find for players who look around. The story is light and funny, giving the adventure a sweet goal. Levels get trickier as you go, so you will need to think about each move. If you enjoy platform adventures with a touch of romance and humor, Valiant Knight is a charming quest to try.
valiant-knight.how_to: Guide the knight through each level, collecting coins and avoiding spikes, turning barrels and hidden traps. Look around for secret treasures. Reach the end of each level to continue the quest for the princess. Take your time on tricky parts and keep an eye out for traps you can't see at first. The game explains its controls as soon as it starts.
tips: Move slowly in new areas to spot hidden traps.
Watch how the barrels turn before passing them.
Check corners for hidden treasures.
Collect coins only when it is safe.

faq.q: What is the story of Valiant Knight?
faq.a: A knight without much money sets off on a quest so a princess will love him.

faq.q: What dangers are in Valiant Knight?
faq.a: Spikes, turning barrels and hidden traps.

daddy-rabbit.summary:
Daddy Rabbit is a cute but spooky adventure about a dad on a rescue mission. His baby bunnies are lost in an underground maze, and zombies wander the tunnels.

To bring the bunnies home safely, this brave dad has to be both careful and quick. Staying close to the little ones keeps them safe, and moving quietly helps avoid getting the zombies' attention. When trouble does come, a tap lets Daddy Rabbit throw a mighty carrot punch. The maze is full of twists, so you need to plan your route. The mix of sweet characters and gentle spookiness makes it fun rather than truly scary. If you like adventure games with a caring hero and a bit of action, Daddy Rabbit is a charming rescue story to play.
daddy-rabbit.how_to: Guide Daddy Rabbit through the underground maze to find and rescue his bunnies. Stay close to the babies and sneak carefully to avoid waking the zombies. Tap to throw a carrot punch when you need to fight. Bring all the bunnies to safety to complete each level. Plan your path through the maze.
tips: Keep the baby bunnies close behind you.
Move carefully near zombies.
Save your carrot punch for when you really need it.
Learn the maze layout to find safe paths.

faq.q: What is the goal in Daddy Rabbit?
faq.a: Rescue the baby bunnies from the underground maze while avoiding zombies.

faq.q: How do you fight in Daddy Rabbit?
faq.a: Tap to make Daddy Rabbit throw carrot punches.

fruitmaster.summary:
FruitMaster is a throwing game where you take aim at fruit. Juicy targets fill each level, and your job is to hit all of them using a limited number of throws.

Because your throws are limited in FruitMaster, every shot counts. You need to aim carefully and think about which fruit to hit first. Each level has a new mix of fruit, so you never face exactly the same challenge twice. The levels slowly get trickier, asking for more precision. The bright, juicy graphics make every single hit feel satisfying. It is easy to start, but clearing the harder levels takes skill and patience. If you like aiming games where you plan your shots, FruitMaster is a fresh and fruity challenge.
fruitmaster.how_to: Aim and throw to hit the fruits on the screen. You only have a limited number of throws, so plan each one carefully. Try to hit every fruit in the level to move on. Later levels get trickier and need more precision. The game shows how to aim and throw when it starts.
tips: Take a moment to aim before every throw.
Go for fruits that are hardest to reach first while you still have throws.
Learn each level's layout if you need to retry.
Don't waste throws on risky shots.

faq.q: What is the goal in FruitMaster?
faq.a: Hit all the fruits in each level with a limited number of throws.

faq.q: Does FruitMaster get harder?
faq.a: Yes, the stages become trickier as you play.

funny-nose-surgery.summary:
Funny Nose Surgery is a silly doctor game where you help a girl named Mia with her runny, snotty nose. It is gross in a funny way, and kids usually love it.

You take care of Mia step by step with simple, fun treatments. Each task is easy to understand, so even young players can follow along without trouble. After the treatment, you can get creative and decorate Mia's nose with wacky stickers. Along the way, kids learn about basic health routines, like keeping their nose clean. Funny Nose Surgery mixes laughs with a little bit of learning, which makes it a great game for younger children. The colorful style keeps everything cheerful. If you like pretend doctor games with a goofy twist, Funny Nose Surgery is a fun way to play doctor.
funny-nose-surgery.how_to: Help Mia by doing simple treatments for her snotty nose, one step at a time. Use the tools the game offers and follow along until her nose is better. When you finish, decorate her nose with funny stickers. The game shows how to use each tool when it starts, so watch the hints.
tips: Follow the treatment steps in order.
Watch for hints showing which tool to use next.
Get creative with the stickers at the end.
Talk about healthy habits while you play.

faq.q: Who do you help in Funny Nose Surgery?
faq.a: You treat Mia's snotty nose.

faq.q: Can you decorate in Funny Nose Surgery?
faq.a: Yes, you can decorate Mia's nose with wacky stickers.

moto-maniac.summary:
Moto Maniac is a motorbike game set on busy port docks. You race over obstacles at top speed while keeping out of the water and making sure your rider's head stays safe.

The docks are full of tricky ramps and gaps, and balance is everything in Moto Maniac. Leaning too far forward or back can send you flipping or splashing into the sea. You need to find the right speed and angle for each obstacle. The controls are simple, which lets you focus on balancing and timing. Each run is a chance to get farther and faster. You can pause any time with the P key. If you like physics-based bike games where control matters as much as speed, Moto Maniac is a fun challenge.
moto-maniac.how_to: Ride across the docks and clear the obstacles in the shortest time possible. Press Up or W to drive forward and Down or S to go backward. Use Left or A and Right or D to tilt your bike. Stay out of the sea and keep your rider's head safe. Press P to pause.
tips: Tilt the bike to land on both wheels.
Slow down before big drops.
Keep your rider's head away from low objects.
Practice tricky parts until you find the right speed.

faq.q: What are the controls in Moto Maniac?
faq.a: Up or W drives forward, Down or S goes backward, Left or A and Right or D tilt the bike, and P pauses.

faq.q: What is the goal in Moto Maniac?
faq.a: Cross the docks quickly and stay dry.

love-tester.summary:
Love Tester is a short game for fun: you type in names and it tells you how well they match. It is a joke more than a science, so it is best for laughing with friends, not for taking the result seriously. Each try takes only a few seconds.

The game is built for touch screens, so it works very well on a phone or tablet. There is nothing to learn and no levels, which makes it an easy pick when you only have a minute and want a smile.
love-tester.how_to: Tap to start, then enter the names and let the game test them. The game shows a result as a love score. Try different names or pairs, for example friends, pets or favorite characters, and compare the scores.
tips: Treat the result as a joke – it cannot really predict anything.
Try the names of friends, pets or favorite characters and see who gets the highest score.
Play on a phone or tablet, because the game uses touch.
Show the score to a friend and let them guess which names you tried.

faq.q: Is Love Tester real?
faq.a: No. It is a fun game that makes up a score for the names you enter. It cannot tell anything real about love or friendship.

faq.q: Can I play Love Tester on my phone?
faq.a: Yes, the game is made for touch screens, so it works on phones and tablets.

faq.q: Can I test friends or pets instead of a crush?
faq.a: Yes, you can enter any names you like, such as friends, siblings, pets or favorite characters.

tank-trouble.summary:
Tank Trouble puts you in a tank in a small maze. You drive around the walls, line up your shot and try to hit the other tank before it hits you. In Solo mode you play against Laika, a master of war, and in multiplayer you can challenge a friend or two on the same device.

The battlefields are mazes, so the walls matter as much as the guns. You have to think about where the other tank can come from, and a shot can be used cleverly around a corner. Rounds are quick and easy to start again, which makes it a great game to take turns with friends.
tank-trouble.how_to: In Solo mode, drive your tank through the maze and shoot Laika, your opponent. In multiplayer on one keyboard, player 1 drives with the WASD keys and shoots with Q, player 2 uses the arrow keys and space, and player 3 plays with the mouse. Use the walls for cover and try to hit the other tank first.
tips: Use the walls as cover and peek out only when you are ready to shoot.
Think about where the other tank can come from before you move around a corner.
Keep moving, because a tank that stands still is easy to hit.
Take turns with friends and play several rounds to see who wins the most.

faq.q: Can I play Tank Trouble with a friend?
faq.a: Yes. You can play multiplayer with one or two friends on the same device. Player 1 uses WASD and Q, player 2 uses the arrow keys and space, and player 3 can play with the mouse.

faq.q: Can I play Tank Trouble alone?
faq.a: Yes. In Solo mode you play against Laika, a master of war.

faq.q: Is Tank Trouble free?
faq.a: Yes, you can play it free in your browser with no download.

gin-rummy.summary:
Gin Rummy is a classic card game for two players, and this version lets you play against the computer. You try to collect your cards into sets and runs and get rid of the cards that do not fit. The computer adjusts to your level as you play, so it stays interesting whether you are new or already good.

The game saves your progress, so you can leave and come back later. It is a calm game of planning and memory – you watch which cards your opponent takes and which they throw away, and that tells you what to keep. It is a good way to learn a real card game that is played all around the world.
gin-rummy.how_to: Play against the computer. On your turn you take a card and then discard one, trying to build sets of the same number and runs of cards in a row in the same suit. Cards that are not part of a set or run count against you. Watch what your opponent picks up, because it shows what they need.
tips: Watch which cards your opponent picks up and which they discard.
Keep cards that can make both a set and a run.
Throw away high cards that do not fit anywhere early.
Take your time – the game saves, so you can think and come back.

faq.q: How many players does Gin Rummy have?
faq.a: Gin Rummy is a game for two players. In this version you play against the computer.

faq.q: Does the game save my progress?
faq.a: Yes, the game has auto-save and resume, so you can come back later.

faq.q: Is the computer opponent hard?
faq.a: The computer adjusts to your playing level, so it stays challenging without being unfair.

mini-dash.summary:
Mini Dash is a retro-style platform game where you play a small blob. Its special skill is the air dash: while you are in the air you can dash left or right to avoid obstacles and reach coins. Learning when to jump and when to dash is the whole game, and it is easy to start but takes practice to master.

You collect the coins in each level, and there is also a speedrun mode to test how fast you can finish. It works with a mouse on a computer and with touch on a phone or tablet.
mini-dash.how_to: On a computer, press X or the left mouse button to jump, and C or the right mouse button to jump too. In the air, press X or the left mouse button to dash left, and C or the right mouse button to dash right. On a phone, touch the left or right side to jump, then touch left or right in the air to dash that way. Collect the coins and avoid obstacles.
tips: Jump first, then dash – the dash only works in the air.
Wait for the right moment instead of dashing as soon as you leave the ground.
Try the speedrun mode when you know a level well.
Learn the layout of a level, because obstacles stay in the same place.

faq.q: How do you dash in Mini Dash?
faq.a: Jump first, then press the dash button while you are in the air. On a computer, use X or the left mouse button to dash left and C or the right mouse button to dash right. On a phone, touch left or right in the air.

faq.q: Can I play Mini Dash on my phone?
faq.a: Yes, the game has touch controls for phones and tablets.

faq.q: Is there a speedrun mode?
faq.a: Yes, Mini Dash has a speedrun mode to test how quickly you can finish.

classic-snake.summary:
Classic Snake takes the idea of the old snake game and keeps it simple: you eat small dots to become bigger, and you try to build the biggest snake on the leaderboard. As your snake grows it is harder to steer without bumping into things, so every dot makes the game a little more exciting.

The controls are just a mouse click or a tap, so it starts immediately on a computer or a phone. Rounds are short, which makes it easy to try again and beat your own record.
classic-snake.how_to: Click with the mouse or tap the screen to play and steer your snake. Eat the small dots to grow longer. Try to become the biggest snake on the leaderboard.
tips: Eat dots near you first so you grow safely.
Leave yourself space to turn as your snake gets longer.
Plan a path before you go for a dot far away.
Play a few rounds and try to beat your own best length.

faq.q: How do you play Classic Snake?
faq.a: Click or tap to steer your snake, eat the small dots to grow longer and try to get the biggest snake on the leaderboard.

faq.q: Can I play Classic Snake on my phone?
faq.a: Yes, the game works with a tap, so it works on phones and tablets.

faq.q: Is Classic Snake free?
faq.a: Yes, you can play it free in your browser with no download.

checkers.summary:
Checkers is a classic strategy game, and every move counts. You move your pieces across the board, capture your opponent's pieces by jumping over them and try to get a piece to the far side so it is crowned and can move in any direction. Captures are mandatory, which means you can plan traps and force your opponent into moves.

It is easy to learn and takes a long time to master. The game rewards thinking ahead: before each move, look at what it allows your opponent to do next. It is a good game for practising planning, patience and careful thinking.
checkers.how_to: Move your pieces forward across the board and capture opponent pieces by jumping over them. If a capture is possible, you must make it. When one of your pieces reaches the far side of the board it is crowned and can then move in any direction. Win by capturing all the opponent's pieces or leaving them with no moves.
tips: Think about what your move lets your opponent do next.
Use the mandatory capture rule to set traps.
Keep your pieces together so they protect each other.
Try to crown a piece, because a crowned piece is much more powerful.

faq.q: Is capturing mandatory in Checkers?
faq.a: Yes, in this game you must capture when a capture is possible. This is what makes traps and planning possible.

faq.q: What happens when a piece is crowned?
faq.a: A piece that reaches the far side of the board is crowned and can move in any direction.

faq.q: Can I learn Checkers here?
faq.a: Yes, the rules are simple, and playing a few games is a good way to learn.
